name: charFun_inv_sqrt_mul_sum
statement:
lemma charFun_inv_sqrt_mul_sum (hindep : iIndepFun X P)
    (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) {n : ℕ} {t : ℝ} :
    charFun (P.map (fun ω ↦ (√n)⁻¹ * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, X k ω)) t =
      (charFun (P.map (X 0)) ((√n)⁻¹ * t)) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have mX n := (hident n).aemeasurable_fst
  rw [charFun_map_mul_comp, (hindep.restrict _).charFun_map_fun_finsetSum_eq_prod (fun _ _ ↦ mX _)]
  · simp [fun i ↦ (hident i).map_eq]
  · exact Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum _ fun _ _ ↦ mX _

name: tendsto_charFun_inv_sqrt_mul_pow
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_pow_exp_of_isLittleO_sub_add_div
  suffices (fun (n : ℕ) ↦ charFun (Measure.map X P) ((√n)⁻¹ * t) -
      (1 + (-(((√n)⁻¹ * t) ^ 2 / 2) : ℂ))) =o[atTop] fun n ↦ ((√n)⁻¹ * t) ^ 2 by
    have aux : (fun (n : ℕ) ↦ ‖(1 / n : ℂ)‖) = fun (n : ℕ) ↦ ‖(1 / n : ℝ)‖ := by simp
    rw [← Asymptotics.isLittleO_norm_right, aux, Asymptotics.isLittleO_norm_right]
    refine .of_const_mul_right (c := t ^ 2) ?_
    convert! this using 4 with n <;> norm_cast <;> simp [field]
  have : Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) ↦ (√n)⁻¹ * t) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    rw [← zero_mul t]
    exact .mul_const t (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp <| Real.tendsto_sqrt_atTop.comp <|
      tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop)
  convert! (taylor_charFun_two hX h0 h1).comp_tendsto this using 2
  simp
  ring

name: tendstoInDistribution_inv_sqrt_mul_sum
statement:
theorem tendstoInDistribution_inv_sqrt_mul_sum (hY : HasLaw Y (gaussianReal 0 1) P')
    (h0 : P[X 0] = 0) (h1 : P[X 0 ^ 2] = 1) (hindep : iIndepFun X P)
    (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) :
    TendstoInDistribution (fun (n : ℕ) ω ↦ (√n)⁻¹ * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, X k ω) atTop Y
      (fun _ ↦ P) P' where
  forall_aemeasurable n
proof:
:=
    .const_mul (Finset.aemeasurable_fun_sum _ fun _ _ ↦ (hident _).aemeasurable_fst) _
  tendsto := by
    refine ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_iff_tendsto_charFun.2 fun t ↦ ?_
    rw! [hY.map_eq]
    simpa [charFun_inv_sqrt_mul_sum hindep hident, charFun_gaussianReal, neg_div] using
      tendsto_charFun_inv_sqrt_mul_pow (hident 0).aemeasurable_fst h0 h1 t

name: tendstoInDistribution_inv_sqrt_mul_var_mul_sum_sub
statement:
private theorem tendstoInDistribution_inv_sqrt_mul_var_mul_sum_sub
    (hY : HasLaw Y (gaussianReal 0 1) P')
    (hX : Var[X 0; P] ≠ 0) (hindep : iIndepFun X P)
    (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun (n : ℕ) ω ↦ (√(n * Var[X 0; P]))⁻¹ * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, X k ω - n * P[X 0]))
      atTop Y (fun _ ↦ P) P'
proof:
:= by
  have mX0 := (hident 0).aemeasurable_fst
  have intX0 : Integrable (X 0) P := memLp_one_iff_integrable.1 <|
    (memLp_two_of_variance_ne_zero mX0.aestronglyMeasurable hX).mono_exponent (by simp)
  have (n : ℕ) ω : (√(n * Var[X 0; P]))⁻¹ * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, X k ω - n * P[X 0]) =
      (√n)⁻¹ * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (X k ω - P[X 0]) / √Var[X 0; P] := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp [field]
  simp_rw [this]
  convert! tendstoInDistribution_inv_sqrt_mul_sum hY ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [integral_div, integral_sub intX0 (by simp)]
    simp
  · simp only [Pi.pow_apply, div_pow]
    rw [integral_div, ← variance_eq_integral mX0, Real.sq_sqrt (variance_nonneg _ _), div_self hX]
  · exact hindep.comp (fun _ x ↦ (x - P[X 0]) / √Var[X 0; P]) (by fun_prop)
  · convert! fun n ↦ (hident n).comp (u := fun x ↦ (x - P[X 0]) / √Var[X 0; P]) (by fun_prop)

name: tendstoInDistribution_inv_sqrt_mul_sum_sub
statement:
@[wikidata Q190391]
theorem tendstoInDistribution_inv_sqrt_mul_sum_sub
    (hY : HasLaw Y (gaussianReal 0 Var[X 0; P].toNNReal) P')
    (hX : MemLp (X 0) 2 P) (hindep : iIndepFun X P)
    (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) :
    TendstoInDistribution
      (fun (n : ℕ) ω ↦ (√n)⁻¹ * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, X k ω - n * P[X 0]))
      atTop Y (fun _ ↦ P) P'
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := eq_or_ne Var[X 0; P] 0
  · have : ∀ᵐ ω ∂P, ∀ n, X n ω = P[X 0] := by
      refine ae_all_iff.2 fun n ↦ ?_
      convert! (ae_eq_integral_of_variance_eq_zero ((hident n).memLp_iff.2 hX)) ?_ using 3
      · rw [(hident n).integral_eq]
      · rwa [(hident n).variance_eq]
    have mX (n : ℕ) := (hident n).aemeasurable_fst
    refine tendstoInDistribution_of_identDistrib 0 (fun n ↦ ?_) ?_
    · refine ⟨by fun_prop, by fun_prop, Measure.map_congr ?_⟩
      filter_upwards [this] with ω hω
      simp [hω]
    · exact ⟨by fun_prop, by fun_prop, by simp [hY.map_eq, h]⟩
  have : HasLaw (fun ω ↦ Y ω / √Var[X 0; P]) (gaussianReal 0 1) P' := by
    convert! gaussianReal_div_const hY _
    · simp
    · ext; simp [h]
  convert!
    (tendstoInDistribution_inv_sqrt_mul_var_mul_sum_sub this h hindep hident).continuous_comp (g :=
      (√Var[X 0; P] * ·)) (by fun_prop)
  · simp [field] 
    field_simp [h]
  · ext
    simp [field] 
    field_simp [h]

name: iIndepFun.indep_comap_natural_of_lt
statement:
theorem iIndepFun.indep_comap_natural_of_lt (hf : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (f i))
    (hfi : iIndepFun f μ) (hij : i < j) :
    Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (f j) mβ) (Filtration.natural f hf i) μ
proof:
:= by
  suffices Indep (⨆ k ∈ ({j} : Set ι), MeasurableSpace.comap (f k) mβ)
      (⨆ k ∈ {k | k ≤ i}, MeasurableSpace.comap (f k) mβ) μ by rwa [iSup_singleton] at this
  exact indep_iSup_of_disjoint (fun k => (hf k).measurable.comap_le) hfi (by simpa)

name: iIndepFun.condExp_natural_ae_eq_of_lt
statement:
theorem iIndepFun.condExp_natural_ae_eq_of_lt [SecondCountableTopology β] [CompleteSpace β]
    [NormedSpace ℝ β] (hf : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (f i)) (hfi : iIndepFun f μ)
    (hij : i < j) : μ[f j | Filtration.natural f hf i] =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => μ[f j]
proof:
:= by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hfi.isProbabilityMeasure
  exact condExp_indep_eq (hf j).measurable.comap_le (Filtration.le _ _)
    (comap_measurable <| f j).stronglyMeasurable (hfi.indep_comap_natural_of_lt hf hij)

name: iIndepSet.condExp_indicator_filtrationOfSet_ae_eq
statement:
theorem iIndepSet.condExp_indicator_filtrationOfSet_ae_eq (hsm : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n))
    (hs : iIndepSet s μ) (hij : i < j) :
    μ[(s j).indicator (fun _ => 1 : Ω → ℝ) | filtrationOfSet hsm i] =ᵐ[μ]
    fun _ => μ.real (s j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Filtration.filtrationOfSet_eq_natural (β := fun _ ↦ ℝ) hsm]
  refine (iIndepFun.condExp_natural_ae_eq_of_lt _ hs.iIndepFun_indicator hij).trans ?_
  simp only [integral_indicator_const _ (hsm _), smul_eq_mul, mul_one]; rfl

name: measure_limsup_eq_one
statement:
theorem measure_limsup_eq_one {s : ℕ → Set Ω} (hsm : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (s n)) (hs : iIndepSet s μ)
    (hs' : (∑' n, μ (s n)) = ∞) : μ (limsup s atTop) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hs.isProbabilityMeasure
  rw [measure_congr (eventuallyEqSet_iff.2 (ae_mem_limsup_atTop_iff μ <|
    measurableSet_filtrationOfSet' hsm) : limsup s atTop =ᵐ[μ]
      {ω | Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
        (μ[(s (k + 1)).indicator (1 : Ω → ℝ)|filtrationOfSet hsm k]) ω) atTop atTop})]
  suffices {ω | Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
      (μ[(s (k + 1)).indicator (1 : Ω → ℝ)|filtrationOfSet hsm k]) ω) atTop atTop} =ᵐ[μ] Set.univ by
    rw [measure_congr this, measure_univ]
  have : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ n, (μ[(s (n + 1)).indicator (1 : Ω → ℝ) | filtrationOfSet hsm n]) ω = _ :=
    ae_all_iff.2 fun n => hs.condExp_indicator_filtrationOfSet_ae_eq hsm n.lt_succ_self
  filter_upwards [this] with ω hω
  refine eq_true (?_ : Tendsto _ _ _)
  simp_rw [hω]
  have htends : Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, μ (s (k + 1))) atTop (𝓝 ∞) := by
    rw [← ENNReal.tsum_add_one_eq_top hs' (measure_ne_top _ _)]
    exact ENNReal.tendsto_nat_tsum _
  rw [ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_top_iff_nnreal] at htends
  refine tendsto_atTop_atTop_of_monotone' ?_ ?_
  · refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n => ?_
    rw [← sub_nonneg, Finset.sum_range_succ_sub_sum]
    exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  · rintro ⟨B, hB⟩
    refine not_eventually.2 (Frequently.of_forall fun n => ?_) (htends B.toNNReal)
    rw [mem_upperBounds] at hB
    specialize hB (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, μ (s (k + 1))).toReal _
    · refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
      rw [ENNReal.toReal_sum (by finiteness)]
      rfl
    · rwa [not_lt, ENNReal.ofNNReal_toNNReal, ENNReal.le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le]
      · simp
      · exact le_trans (by positivity) hB

statement:
lemma HasLaw.comp_of_hasLaw_comp {Ω' 𝓨 : Type*} {m' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨}
    {P' : Measure Ω'} {ν : Measure 𝓨} {f : 𝓧 → 𝓨} {Y : Ω' → 𝓧} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ)
    (hX : HasLaw X μ P) (hY : HasLaw Y μ P') (h : HasLaw (fun ω ↦ f (X ω)) ν P) :
    HasLaw (fun ω ↦ f (Y ω)) ν P' where
  aemeasurable
proof:
:= (hY.map_eq ▸ hf).comp_aemeasurable hY.aemeasurable
  map_eq := by
    rw [← Function.comp_def,
      ← AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable (hY.map_eq ▸ hf) hY.aemeasurable,
      hY.map_eq, ← hX.map_eq, AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable (hX.map_eq ▸ hf) hX.aemeasurable,
      Function.comp_def, h.map_eq]

lemma indepFun_iff_hasLaw_prodMk_prod [IsFiniteMeasure P] {𝓨 : Type*} {m𝓨 : MeasurableSpace 𝓨}
    {ν : Measure 𝓨} {Y : Ω → 𝓨} (hX : HasLaw X μ P) (hY : HasLaw Y ν P) :
    X ⟂ᵢ[P] Y ↔ HasLaw (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) (μ.prod ν) P where
  mp h
proof:
:=
    { map_eq := by
        rw [h.map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), hX.map_eq,
          hY.map_eq] }
  mpr h := by
    rw [indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),

name: iIndepFun.hasLaw_pi

lemma iIndepFun.hasLaw_pi {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {𝓧 : ι → Type*} {m𝓧 : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (𝓧 i)}

:= h.hasLaw_pi hX

name: to
statement:
theorem to construct the measure over a product indexed by `ℕ`, which is `infinitePiNat`. This
is an implementation detail and should not be used directly. Then we construct the product measure
over an arbitrary type by extending `piContent μ` thanks to Carathéodory's theorem. The key lemma
to do so is `piContent_tendsto_zero`, which states that `piContent μ (A n)` tends to zero if
`A` is a nonincreasing sequence of sets satisfying `⋂ n, A n = ∅`.
We prove this lemma by reducing to the case of an at most countable product,
in which case `piContent μ` is known to be a true measure (see `piContent_eq_measure_pi` and
`piContent_eq_infinitePiNat`).

## Tags

infinite product measure
-/

@[expose] public section

open ProbabilityTheory Finset Filter Preorder MeasurableEquiv

open scoped ENNReal Topology

namespace MeasureTheory

section Preliminaries

variable {ι : Type*} {X : ι → Type*} {mX : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (X i)}
variable (μ : (i : ι) → Measure (X i)) [hμ : ∀ i, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ i)]

/
subfamily. This gives a projective family of measures. -/

name: isProjectiveMeasureFamily_pi
statement:
lemma isProjectiveMeasureFamily_pi :
    IsProjectiveMeasureFamily (fun I : Finset ι ↦ (Measure.pi (fun i : I ↦ μ i)))
proof:
:= by
  refine fun I J hJI ↦ Measure.pi_eq (fun s ms ↦ ?_)
  classical
  simp_rw [Measure.map_apply (measurable_restrict₂ hJI) (.univ_pi ms), restrict₂_preimage hJI,
    Measure.pi_pi, prod_eq_prod_extend]
  refine (prod_subset_one_on_sdiff hJI (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun x hx ↦ ?_)).symm
  · rw [Function.extend_val_apply (mem_sdiff.1 hx).1, dite_eq_right (mem_sdiff.1 hx).2,
      measure_univ]
  · rw [Function.extend_val_apply hx, Function.extend_val_apply (hJI hx), dite_eq_left hx]

name: piContent_cylinder
statement:
lemma piContent_cylinder {I : Finset ι} {S : Set (Π i : I, X i)} (hS : MeasurableSet S) :
    piContent μ (cylinder I S) = Measure.pi (fun i : I ↦ μ i) S
proof:
:=
  projectiveFamilyContent_cylinder _ hS

name: piContent_eq_measure_pi
statement:
theorem piContent_eq_measure_pi [Fintype ι] {s : Set (Π i, X i)} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    piContent μ s = Measure.pi μ s
proof:
:= by
  let e : @Finset.univ ι _ ≃ ι :=
    { toFun i := i
      invFun i := ⟨i, mem_univ i⟩ }
  have : s = cylinder univ (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft X e ⁻¹' s) := rfl
  nth_rw 1 [this]
  dsimp [e]
  rw [piContent_cylinder _ (hs.preimage (by fun_prop)), ← Measure.pi_map_piCongrLeft e,
    ← Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) hs]; rfl

name: pi_prod_map_IocProdIoc
statement:
lemma pi_prod_map_IocProdIoc {a b c : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    ((Measure.pi (fun i : Ioc a b ↦ μ i)).prod (Measure.pi (fun i : Ioc b c ↦ μ i))).map
      (IocProdIoc a b c) = Measure.pi (fun i : Ioc a c ↦ μ i)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Measure.pi_eq fun s ms ↦ ?_).symm
  simp_rw [Measure.map_apply measurable_IocProdIoc (.univ_pi ms), IocProdIoc_preimage hab hbc,
    Measure.prod_prod, Measure.pi_pi, prod_eq_prod_extend]
  nth_rw 1 [Eq.comm, ← Ioc_union_Ioc_eq_Ioc hab hbc, prod_union (Ioc_disjoint_Ioc_of_le le_rfl)]
  congr 1 <;> refine prod_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ ?_
  · rw [Function.extend_val_apply hx, Function.extend_val_apply (Ioc_subset_Ioc_right hbc hx),
      restrict₂]
  · rw [Function.extend_val_apply hx, Function.extend_val_apply (Ioc_subset_Ioc_left hab hx),
      restrict₂]

name: pi_prod_map_IicProdIoc
statement:
lemma pi_prod_map_IicProdIoc {a b : ℕ} :
    ((Measure.pi (fun i : Iic a ↦ μ i)).prod (Measure.pi (fun i : Ioc a b ↦ μ i))).map
      (IicProdIoc a b) = Measure.pi (fun i : Iic b ↦ μ i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain hab | hba := le_total a b
  · refine (Measure.pi_eq fun s ms ↦ ?_).symm
    simp_rw [Measure.map_apply measurable_IicProdIoc (.univ_pi ms), IicProdIoc_preimage hab,
      Measure.prod_prod, Measure.pi_pi, prod_eq_prod_extend]
    nth_rw 1 [Eq.comm, ← Iic_union_Ioc_eq_Iic hab, prod_union (Iic_disjoint_Ioc le_rfl)]
    congr 1 <;> refine prod_congr rfl fun x hx ↦ ?_
    · rw [Function.extend_val_apply hx, Function.extend_val_apply (Iic_subset_Iic.2 hab hx),
        frestrictLe₂, restrict₂]
    · rw [Function.extend_val_apply hx, Function.extend_val_apply (Ioc_subset_Iic_self hx),
        restrict₂]
  · rw [IicProdIoc_le hba, ← Measure.map_map, ← Measure.fst, Measure.fst_prod]
    · exact isProjectiveMeasureFamily_pi μ (Iic a) (Iic b) (Iic_subset_Iic.2 hba) |>.symm
    all_goals fun_prop

name: map_piSingleton
statement:
lemma map_piSingleton (μ : (n : ℕ) → Measure (X n)) [∀ n, SigmaFinite (μ n)] (n : ℕ) :
    (μ (n + 1)).map (piSingleton n) = Measure.pi (fun i : Ioc n (n + 1) ↦ μ i)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Measure.pi_eq fun s hs ↦ ?_).symm
  have : Subsingleton (Ioc n (n + 1)) := by rw [Nat.Ioc_succ_singleton]; infer_instance
  rw [Fintype.prod_subsingleton _ ⟨n + 1, mem_Ioc.2 (by lia)⟩,
    Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) (.univ_pi hs)]
  congr 1 with x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_pi, Set.mem_univ, forall_const, Subtype.forall,
    Nat.Ioc_succ_singleton, mem_singleton]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h (n + 1) rfl, fun h a b ↦ b.symm ▸ h⟩

name: partialTraj_const_restrict
proof:
:= by
  obtain hab | hba := lt_or_ge a b
  · refine Nat.le_induction ?_ (fun n hn hind ↦ ?_) b (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hab) <;> ext1 x₀
    · rw [partialTraj_succ_self, ← map_comp_right, map_apply, prod_apply, map_apply, const_apply,
        const_apply, Measure.map_piSingleton, restrict₂_comp_IicProdIoc, Measure.map_snd_prod,
        measure_univ, one_smul]
      all_goals fun_prop
    · have : (restrict₂ (Ioc_subset_Iic_self (a := a))) ∘ (IicProdIoc (X := X) n (n + 1)) =
          (IocProdIoc a n (n + 1)) ∘ (Prod.map (restrict₂ Ioc_subset_Iic_self) id) := rfl
      rw [const_apply, partialTraj_succ_of_le (by lia), map_const, prod_const_comp, id_comp,
        ← map_comp_right, this, map_comp_right, ← map_prod_map, hind, Kernel.map_id, map_apply,
        prod_apply, const_apply, const_apply, Measure.map_piSingleton,
        Measure.pi_prod_map_IocProdIoc]
      any_goals fun_prop
      all_goals lia
  · have : IsEmpty (Ioc a b) := by simpa [hba] using Subtype.isEmpty_false
    ext x s ms
    by_cases hs : s.Nonempty
    · rw [Subsingleton.eq_univ_of_nonempty hs, @measure_univ .., measure_univ]
      exact (IsMarkovKernel.map _ (measurable_restrict₂ _)) |>.isProbabilityMeasure x
    · rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hs]
      simp

name: partialTraj_const
statement:
theorem partialTraj_const {a b : ℕ} :
    partialTraj (fun n ↦ const _ (μ (n + 1))) a b =
      (Kernel.id ×ₖ (const _ (Measure.pi (fun i : Ioc a b ↦ μ i)))).map (IicProdIoc a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [partialTraj_eq_prod, partialTraj_const_restrict₂]

name: isProjectiveLimit_infinitePiNat
statement:
theorem isProjectiveLimit_infinitePiNat :
    IsProjectiveLimit (infinitePiNat μ) (fun I : Finset ℕ ↦ (Measure.pi (fun i : I ↦ μ i)))
proof:
:= by
  intro I
  rw [isProjectiveMeasureFamily_pi μ _ _ I.subset_Iic_sup_id,
    ← restrict₂_comp_restrict I.subset_Iic_sup_id, ← map_map, ← frestrictLe, infinitePiNat,
    map_comp, traj_map_frestrictLe, partialTraj_const, ← map_comp, ← compProd_eq_comp_prod,
    compProd_const, pi_prod_map_IicProdIoc]
  all_goals fun_prop

name: infinitePiNat_map_restrict
statement:
lemma infinitePiNat_map_restrict (I : Finset ℕ) :
    (infinitePiNat μ).map I.restrict = Measure.pi fun i : I ↦ μ i
proof:
:=
  isProjectiveLimit_infinitePiNat μ I

name: piContent_eq_infinitePiNat
statement:
theorem piContent_eq_infinitePiNat {A : Set (Π n, X n)} (hA : A ∈ measurableCylinders X) :
    piContent μ A = infinitePiNat μ A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, S, mS, rfl⟩ : ∃ s S, MeasurableSet S ∧ A = cylinder s S := by
    simpa [mem_measurableCylinders] using hA
  rw [piContent_cylinder _ mS, cylinder, ← map_apply (measurable_restrict _) mS,
    infinitePiNat_map_restrict]

name: Measure.infinitePiNat_map_piCongrLeft
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, S, hS, rfl⟩ := (mem_measurableCylinders s).1 hs
  rw [map_apply _ hS.cylinder, cylinder, ← Set.preimage_comp, coe_piCongrLeft,
    restrict_comp_piCongrLeft, Set.preimage_comp, ← map_apply,
    infinitePiNat_map_restrict (fun n ↦ μ (e n)), ← cylinder, piContent_cylinder μ hS,
    ← pi_map_piCongrLeft (e.restrictPreimageFinset I), map_apply _ hS, coe_piCongrLeft]
  · simp
  any_goals fun_prop
  exact hS.preimage (by fun_prop)

name: piContent_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem piContent_tendsto_zero {A : ℕ → Set (Π i, X i)} (A_mem : ∀ n, A n ∈ measurableCylinders X)
    (A_anti : Antitone A) (A_inter : ⋂ n, A n = ∅) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ piContent μ (A n)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ i, Nonempty (X i) := fun i ↦ nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure (μ i)
  have A_cyl n : ∃ s S, MeasurableSet S ∧ A n = cylinder s S :=
    (mem_measurableCylinders _).1 (A_mem n)
  choose s S mS A_eq using A_cyl
  
  
  
  
  let u := ⋃ n, (s n : Set ι)
  
  let t n : Finset u := (s n).preimage Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective.injOn
  classical
  
  let f : (Π i : u, X i) → Π i, X i :=
    fun x i ↦ if hi : i ∈ u then x ⟨i, hi⟩ else Classical.ofNonempty
  
  let aux n : t n ≃ s n :=
    { toFun := fun i ↦ ⟨i.1.1, mem_preimage.1 i.2⟩
      invFun := fun i ↦ ⟨⟨i.1, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, i.2⟩⟩, mem_preimage.2 i.2⟩
      left_inv := fun i ↦ by simp
      right_inv := fun i ↦ by simp }
  
  let g n := (aux n).piCongrLeft (fun i : s n ↦ X i)
  
  
  have r_comp_f n : (s n).restrict ∘ f = (g n) ∘ (fun (x : Π i : u, X i) i ↦ x i) := by
    ext x i
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Finset.restrict,
      Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk, f, aux, g, t]
    rw [dite_eq_left (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, i.2⟩)]
  
  let B n := f ⁻¹' (A n)
  
  let T n := (g n) ⁻¹' (S n)
  
  have B_eq n : B n = cylinder (t n) (T n) := by
    simp_rw [B, A_eq, cylinder, ← Set.preimage_comp, r_comp_f]; rfl
  have mT n : MeasurableSet (T n) := (mS n).preimage (by fun_prop)
  have B_mem n : B n ∈ measurableCylinders (fun i : u ↦ X i) :=
    (mem_measurableCylinders (B n)).2 ⟨t n, T n, mT n, B_eq n⟩
  have mB n : MeasurableSet (B n) := .of_mem_measurableCylinders (B_mem n)
  have B_anti : Antitone B := fun m n hmn ↦ Set.preimage_mono <| A_anti hmn
  have B_inter : ⋂ n, B n = ∅ := by
    simp_rw [B, ← Set.preimage_iInter, A_inter, Set.preimage_empty]
  
  
  
  
  conv =>
    enter [1]; ext n
    rw [A_eq, piContent_cylinder μ (mS n), ← pi_map_piCongrLeft (aux n),
      map_apply (by fun_prop) (mS n)]
    change (Measure.pi (fun i : t n ↦ μ i)) (T n)
    rw [← piContent_cylinder (fun i : u ↦ μ i) (mT n), ← B_eq n]
  obtain u_fin | u_inf := finite_or_infinite u
  · let _ := Fintype.ofFinite u
    simp_rw [fun n ↦ piContent_eq_measure_pi (fun i : u ↦ μ i) (mB n)]
    convert!
      tendsto_measure_iInter_atTop (fun n ↦ (mB n).nullMeasurableSet) B_anti ⟨0, measure_ne_top _ _⟩
    · rw [B_inter, measure_empty]
    · infer_instance
  · 
    have count_u : Countable u := Set.countable_iUnion (fun n ↦ (s n).countable_toSet)
    obtain ⟨φ, -⟩ := Classical.exists_true_of_nonempty (α := ℕ ≃ u) nonempty_equiv_of_countable
    conv => enter [1]; ext n; rw [← infinitePiNat_map_piCongrLeft _ φ (B_mem n)]
    convert!
      tendsto_measure_iInter_atTop (fun n ↦ (mB n).nullMeasurableSet) B_anti ⟨0, measure_ne_top _ _⟩
    · rw [B_inter, measure_empty]
    · infer_instance

name: isSigmaSubadditive_piContent
statement: theorem isSigmaSubadditive_piContent : (piContent μ).IsSigmaSubadditive
proof:
:= by
  refine isSigmaSubadditive_of_addContent_iUnion_eq_tsum
    isSetRing_measurableCylinders (fun f hf hf_Union hf' ↦ ?_)
  exact addContent_iUnion_eq_sum_of_tendsto_zero isSetRing_measurableCylinders
    (piContent μ) (fun s hs ↦ projectiveFamilyContent_ne_top _)
    (fun _ ↦ piContent_tendsto_zero μ) hf hf_Union hf'

name: isProjectiveLimit_infinitePi
statement:
theorem isProjectiveLimit_infinitePi :
    IsProjectiveLimit (infinitePi μ) (fun I : Finset ι ↦ (Measure.pi (fun i : I ↦ μ i)))
proof:
:= by
  intro I
  ext s hs
  rw [map_apply (measurable_restrict I) hs, infinitePi, dite_eq_left hμ, AddContent.measure_eq,
    ← cylinder, piContent_cylinder μ hs]
  · exact generateFrom_measurableCylinders.symm
  · exact cylinder_mem_measurableCylinders _ _ hs

name: infinitePi_map_restrict
statement:
theorem infinitePi_map_restrict {I : Finset ι} :
    (Measure.infinitePi μ).map I.restrict = Measure.pi fun i : I ↦ μ i
proof:
:=
  isProjectiveLimit_infinitePi μ I

name: eq_infinitePi
statement:
theorem eq_infinitePi {ν : Measure (Π i, X i)}
    (hν : ∀ s : Finset ι, ∀ t : (i : ι) → Set (X i),
      (∀ i, MeasurableSet (t i)) → ν (Set.pi s t) = ∏ i ∈ s, μ i (t i)) :
    ν = infinitePi μ
proof:
:= by
  refine (isProjectiveLimit_infinitePi μ).unique ?_ |>.symm
  refine fun s ↦ (pi_eq fun t ht ↦ ?_).symm
  classical
  rw [Measure.map_apply, restrict_preimage_univ, hν, ← prod_attach, univ_eq_attach]
  · congr with i
    rw [dite_eq_left i.2]
  any_goals fun_prop
  · rintro i
    split_ifs with hi
    · exact ht ⟨i, hi⟩
    · exact .univ
  · exact .univ_pi ht

name: infinitePi_pi
proof:
:= by
  have : Set.pi s t = cylinder s ((@Set.univ s).pi (fun i : s ↦ t i)) := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [this, cylinder, ← map_apply, infinitePi_map_restrict, pi_pi]
  · rw [univ_eq_attach, prod_attach _ (fun i ↦ (μ i) (t i))]
  · exact measurable_restrict _
  · exact .univ_pi fun i ↦ mt i.1 i.2

name: infinitePi_map_restrict'
statement:
theorem infinitePi_map_restrict' {I : Set ι} :
    (infinitePi μ).map I.domRestrict = infinitePi fun i : I ↦ μ i
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_infinitePi
  intro s t ht
  classical
  rw [map_apply (by fun_prop), domRestrict_preimage, infinitePi_pi _ (by measurability)]
  · simp
  · exact .pi s.countable_toSet (by measurability)

name: infinitePi_pi_of_countable
proof:
:= by
  wlog s_ne : Nonempty s
  · simp [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty'.mp s_ne]
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique (f := fun s' : Finset s ↦ ∏ i ∈ s', μ i (t i)) (l := atTop)
  classical
  · conv in ∏ _ ∈ _, _ =>
      rw [← infinitePi_pi _ (by measurability), ← infinitePi_map_restrict', map_apply
        (by fun_prop) (by apply MeasurableSet.pi (countable_toSet _) (by measurability)),
        domRestrict_preimage]
      simp only [coe_image, dite_eq_ite]
    have : s.pi t
      = ⋂ s' : Finset s,
        (Subtype.val '' (s' : Set s)).pi (fun i ↦ if i ∈ s then t i else Set.univ) := by
      rw [← Set.pi_iUnion_eq_iInter_pi, Set.iUnion_finset_eq_set]
      grind
    rw [this]
    apply tendsto_measure_iInter_atTop
    · refine fun s' ↦ MeasurableSet.nullMeasurableSet (MeasurableSet.pi ?_ (by measurability))
      exact (Finset.countable_toSet _).image _
    · intro _ _ h
      simpa using Set.pi_mono' (by simp) (Set.image_mono h)
    · exact ⟨{Nonempty.some s_ne}, by simp⟩
  · rw [ENNReal.tprod_eq_iInf_prod (by simp [prob_le_one])]
    exact tendsto_atTop_iInf (prod_anti_set_of_le_one (by simp [prob_le_one]))

name: infinitePi_pi_univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [infinitePi_pi_of_countable, tprod_univ (f := fun i ↦ μ i (t i))]
  · simpa [Set.countable_univ_iff]
  · measurability

name: infinitePi_singleton
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.univ_pi_singleton, infinitePi_pi_univ _ (by measurability)]

name: infinitePi_singleton_of_fintype
statement:
lemma infinitePi_singleton_of_fintype [Fintype ι] [∀ i, MeasurableSingletonClass (X i)]
    (f : ∀ i, X i) : infinitePi μ {f} = ∏ i, μ i {f i}
proof: := by simp

statement: @[simp] lemma infinitePi_dirac (f : ∀ i, X i) : infinitePi (fun i ↦ dirac (f i)) = dirac f
proof:
:=
  .symm <| eq_infinitePi _ <| by simp +contextual [MeasurableSet.pi, Finset.countable_toSet]

name: _root_.measurePreserving_eval_infinitePi
statement:
lemma _root_.measurePreserving_eval_infinitePi (i : ι) :
    MeasurePreserving (Function.eval i) (infinitePi μ) (μ i) where
  measurable
proof:
:= by fun_prop
  map_eq := by
    ext s hs
    have : @Function.eval ι X i =
        (@Function.eval ({i} : Finset ι) (fun j ↦ X j) ⟨i, by simp⟩) ∘
        (Finset.restrict {i}) := by ext; simp
    rw [this, ← map_map, infinitePi_map_restrict, (measurePreserving_eval _ _).map_eq]
    all_goals fun_prop

name: infinitePi_map_eval
statement:
lemma infinitePi_map_eval (i : ι) :
    (infinitePi μ).map (fun x ↦ x i) = μ i
proof:
:=
  (measurePreserving_eval_infinitePi μ i).map_eq

name: infinitePi_map_pi
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_infinitePi _ fun s t ht ↦ ?_
  rw [map_apply (by fun_prop) (.pi s.countable_toSet fun _ _ ↦ ht _)]
  have : (fun (x : Π i, X i) i ↦ f i (x i)) ⁻¹' ((s : Set ι).pi t) =
      (s : Set ι).pi (fun i ↦ (f i) ⁻¹' (t i)) := by ext x; simp
  rw [this, infinitePi_pi _ (fun i _ ↦ hf i (ht i))]
  congr! with i hi
  rw [map_apply (by fun_prop) (ht i)]

name: infinitePi_map_piCongrLeft
statement:
theorem infinitePi_map_piCongrLeft {α : Type*} (e : α ≃ ι) :
    (infinitePi (fun i ↦ μ (e i))).map (piCongrLeft X e) = infinitePi μ
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_infinitePi μ fun s t ht ↦ ?_
  conv_lhs => enter [2, 1]; rw [← e.image_preimage s, ← coe_preimage _ e.injective.injOn]
  rw [map_apply, coe_piCongrLeft, Equiv.piCongrLeft_preimage_pi, infinitePi_pi,
    prod_equiv e]
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp_all
  · fun_prop
  · exact .pi ((countable_toSet _).image e) (by simp_all)

name: infinitePi_eq_pi
statement: theorem infinitePi_eq_pi [Fintype ι] : infinitePi μ = Measure.pi μ
proof:
:= by
  refine (pi_eq fun s hs ↦ ?_).symm
  rw [← coe_univ, infinitePi_pi]
  simpa

name: infinitePi_cylinder
statement:
lemma infinitePi_cylinder {s : Finset ι} {S : Set (Π i : s, X i)} (mS : MeasurableSet S) :
    infinitePi μ (cylinder s S) = Measure.pi (fun i : s ↦ μ i) S
proof:
:= by
  rw [cylinder, ← Measure.map_apply (measurable_restrict _) mS, infinitePi_map_restrict]

name: infinitePi_map_piCurry_symm
statement:
lemma infinitePi_map_piCurry_symm :
    (infinitePi fun i : ι ↦ infinitePi fun j : κ i ↦ μ i j).map (piCurry X).symm =
      infinitePi fun p : (i : ι) × κ i ↦ μ p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_infinitePi
  intro s t ht
  classical
  rw [map_apply (by fun_prop) (.pi (countable_toSet _) fun _ _ ↦ ht _),
    ← Finset.sigma_image_fst_preimage_mk s, coe_piCurry_symm, Finset.coe_sigma,
    Set.uncurry_preimage_sigma_pi, infinitePi_pi, Finset.prod_sigma]
  · exact Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun _ _ ↦ infinitePi_pi _ fun _ _ ↦ ht _)
  · simp only [mem_image, Sigma.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right, forall_exists_index]
    exact fun i j hij ↦ MeasurableSet.pi (countable_toSet _) fun k hk ↦ by simp_all

name: infinitePi_map_piCurry
statement:
lemma infinitePi_map_piCurry :
    (infinitePi fun p : (i : ι) × κ i ↦ μ p.1 p.2).map (piCurry X) =
      infinitePi fun i : ι ↦ infinitePi fun j : κ i ↦ μ i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasurableEquiv.map_apply_eq_iff_map_symm_apply_eq, infinitePi_map_piCurry_symm]

name: infinitePi_map_curry_symm
statement:
lemma infinitePi_map_curry_symm :
    (infinitePi fun i : ι ↦ infinitePi fun j : κ ↦ μ i j).map (curry ι κ X).symm =
      infinitePi fun p : ι × κ ↦ μ p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ ↦ X)
    (Equiv.sigmaEquivProd ι κ).symm).map_measurableEquiv_injective.eq_iff, map_map]
  · have : (MeasurableEquiv.piCongrLeft (fun _ ↦ X) (Equiv.sigmaEquivProd ι κ).symm) ∘
        (MeasurableEquiv.curry ι κ X).symm = ⇑(MeasurableEquiv.piCurry (fun _ _ ↦ X)).symm := by
      ext; simp [piCongrLeft, Equiv.piCongrLeft, Sigma.uncurry]
    rw [this, infinitePi_map_piCurry_symm]
    convert! infinitePi_map_piCongrLeft (fun p ↦ μ p.1 p.2) (Equiv.sigmaEquivProd ι κ).symm |>.symm
  all_goals fun_prop

name: infinitePi_map_curry
statement:
lemma infinitePi_map_curry :
    (infinitePi fun p : ι × κ ↦ μ p.1 p.2).map (curry ι κ X) =
      infinitePi fun i : ι ↦ infinitePi fun j : κ ↦ μ i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasurableEquiv.map_apply_eq_iff_map_symm_apply_eq, infinitePi_map_curry_symm]

name: integral_restrict_infinitePi
statement:
theorem integral_restrict_infinitePi {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {s : Finset ι} {f : (Π i : s, X i) → E}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (Measure.pi (fun i : s ↦ μ i))) :
    ∫ y, f (s.restrict y) ∂infinitePi μ = ∫ y, f y ∂Measure.pi (fun i : s ↦ μ i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_map, infinitePi_map_restrict]
  · fun_prop
  · rwa [infinitePi_map_restrict]

name: lintegral_restrict_infinitePi
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lintegral_map hf (measurable_restrict _), isProjectiveLimit_infinitePi μ]

name: integral_infinitePi_of_piFinset
statement:
theorem integral_infinitePi_of_piFinset [DecidableEq ι] {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] {s : Finset ι} {f : (Π i, X i) → E}
    (mf : StronglyMeasurable[piFinset s] f) (x : Π i, X i) :
    ∫ y, f y ∂infinitePi μ =
    ∫ y, f (Function.updateFinset x s y) ∂Measure.pi (fun i : s ↦ μ i)
proof:
:= by
  let g : (Π i : s, X i) → E := fun y ↦ f (Function.updateFinset x _ y)
  have this y : g (s.restrict y) = f y :=
    mf.dependsOn_of_piFinset fun i hi ↦ by simp_all [Function.updateFinset]
  rw [← integral_congr_ae <| ae_of_all _ this, integral_restrict_infinitePi]
  exact mf.comp_measurable (measurable_updateFinset.mono le_rfl (piFinset.le s))
    |>.aestronglyMeasurable

name: lintegral_infinitePi_of_piFinset
proof:
:= by
  let g : (Π i : s, X i) → ℝ≥0∞ := fun y ↦ f (Function.updateFinset x _ y)
  have this y : g (s.restrict y) = f y :=
    mf.dependsOn_of_piFinset fun i hi ↦ by simp_all [Function.updateFinset]
  rw [← lintegral_congr_ae <| ae_of_all _ this, lintegral_restrict_infinitePi]
  · rfl
  · exact mf.comp (measurable_updateFinset.mono le_rfl (piFinset.le s))

name: condVar_of_not_le
statement: lemma condVar_of_not_le (hm : ¬m ≤ m₀) : Var[X; μ | m] = 0
proof: := by rw [condVar, condExp_of_not_le hm]

name: condVar_of_not_sigmaFinite
statement:
lemma condVar_of_not_sigmaFinite (hμm : ¬SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)) :
    Var[X; μ | m] = 0
proof: := by rw [condVar, condExp_of_not_sigmaFinite hm hμm]

name: condVar_of_sigmaFinite
statement:
lemma condVar_of_sigmaFinite [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)] :
    Var[X; μ | m] =
      if Integrable (fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2) μ then
        if StronglyMeasurable[m] (fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2) then
          fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2
        else aestronglyMeasurable_condExpL1.mk (condExpL1 hm μ fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2)
      else 0
proof: := condExp_of_sigmaFinite _

name: condVar_of_stronglyMeasurable
statement:
lemma condVar_of_stronglyMeasurable [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)]
    (hX : StronglyMeasurable[m] X) (hXint : Integrable ((X - μ[X | m]) ^ 2) μ) :
    Var[X; μ | m] = fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable _ ((hX.sub stronglyMeasurable_condExp).pow _) hXint

name: condVar_of_not_integrable
statement:
lemma condVar_of_not_integrable (hXint : ¬ Integrable (fun ω ↦ (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2) μ) :
    Var[X; μ | m] = 0
proof: := condExp_of_not_integrable hXint

name: condVar_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma condVar_zero : Var[0; μ | m] = 0
proof: := by simp [condVar]

name: condVar_const
statement:
@[simp]
lemma condVar_const (hm : m ≤ m₀) (c : ℝ) : Var[fun _ ↦ c; μ | m] = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hc := eq_or_ne c 0
  · simp [← Pi.zero_def]
  by_cases hμm : IsFiniteMeasure μ
  · simp [condVar, hm]
  · simp [condVar, condExp_of_not_integrable, integrable_const_iff_isFiniteMeasure hc,
      integrable_const_iff_isFiniteMeasure <| pow_ne_zero _ hc, hμm, Pi.pow_def]

name: stronglyMeasurable_condVar
statement: lemma stronglyMeasurable_condVar : StronglyMeasurable[m] (Var[X; μ | m])
proof:
:=
  stronglyMeasurable_condExp

name: condVar_congr_ae
statement: lemma condVar_congr_ae (h : X =ᵐ[μ] Y) : Var[X; μ | m] =ᵐ[μ] Var[Y; μ | m]
proof:
:=
  condExp_congr_ae <| by filter_upwards [h, condExp_congr_ae h] with ω hω hω'; dsimp; rw [hω, hω']

name: condVar_of_aestronglyMeasurable
statement:
lemma condVar_of_aestronglyMeasurable [hμm : SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)]
    (hX : AEStronglyMeasurable[m] X μ) (hXint : Integrable ((X - μ[X | m]) ^ 2) μ) :
    Var[X; μ | m] =ᵐ[μ] (X - μ[X | m]) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  condExp_of_aestronglyMeasurable' _ ((continuous_pow _).comp_aestronglyMeasurable
    (hX.sub stronglyMeasurable_condExp.aestronglyMeasurable)) hXint

name: integrable_condVar
statement: lemma integrable_condVar : Integrable Var[X; μ | m] μ
proof: := integrable_condExp

name: setIntegral_condVar
statement:
lemma setIntegral_condVar [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)] (hX : Integrable ((X - μ[X | m]) ^ 2) μ)
    (hs : MeasurableSet[m] s) :
    ∫ ω in s, (Var[X; μ | m]) ω ∂μ = ∫ ω in s, (X ω - (μ[X | m]) ω) ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:=
  setIntegral_condExp _ hX hs

name: condVar_ae_eq_condExp_sq_sub_sq_condExp
statement:
lemma condVar_ae_eq_condExp_sq_sub_sq_condExp (hm : m ≤ m₀) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) :
    Var[X; μ | m] =ᵐ[μ] μ[X ^ 2 | m] - μ[X | m] ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Var[X; μ | m]
    _ = μ[X ^ 2 - 2 * X * μ[X | m] + μ[X | m] ^ 2 | m] := by rw [condVar, sub_sq]
    _ =ᵐ[μ] μ[X ^ 2 | m] - 2 * μ[X | m] ^ 2 + μ[X | m] ^ 2 := by
      have aux₀ : Integrable (X ^ 2) μ := hX.integrable_sq
      have aux₁ : Integrable (2 * X * μ[X | m]) μ := by
        rw [mul_assoc]
        exact (memLp_one_iff_integrable.1 <| (hX.condExp one_le_two).mul hX).const_mul _
      have aux₂ : Integrable (μ[X | m] ^ 2) μ := (hX.condExp one_le_two).integrable_sq
      filter_upwards [condExp_add (m := m) (aux₀.sub aux₁) aux₂, condExp_sub (m := m) aux₀ aux₁,
        condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_right stronglyMeasurable_condExp aux₁
          ((hX.integrable one_le_two).const_mul _), condExp_ofNat (m := m) 2 X]
        with ω hω₀ hω₁ hω₂ hω₃
      simp [hω₀, hω₁, hω₂, hω₃,
        condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable hm (stronglyMeasurable_condExp.pow _) aux₂]
      simp [mul_assoc, sq]
    _ = μ[X ^ 2 | m] - μ[X | m] ^ 2 := by ring

name: condVar_ae_le_condExp_sq
statement:
lemma condVar_ae_le_condExp_sq (hm : m ≤ m₀) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) :
    Var[X; μ | m] ≤ᵐ[μ] μ[X ^ 2 | m]
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [condVar_ae_eq_condExp_sq_sub_sq_condExp hm hX] with ω hω
  dsimp at hω
  nlinarith

name: integral_condVar_add_variance_condExp
statement:
lemma integral_condVar_add_variance_condExp (hm : m ≤ m₀) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) : μ[Var[X; μ | m]] + Var[μ[X | m]; μ] = Var[X; μ]
proof:
:= by
  calc
    μ[Var[X; μ | m]] + Var[μ[X | m]; μ]
    _ = μ[(μ[X ^ 2 | m] - μ[X | m] ^ 2 : Ω → ℝ)] + (μ[μ[X | m] ^ 2] - μ[μ[X | m]] ^ 2) := by
      congr 1
      · exact integral_congr_ae <| condVar_ae_eq_condExp_sq_sub_sq_condExp hm hX
      · exact variance_eq_sub (hX.condExp one_le_two)
    _ = μ[X ^ 2] - μ[μ[X | m] ^ 2] + (μ[μ[X | m] ^ 2] - μ[X] ^ 2) := by
      rw [integral_sub' integrable_condExp, integral_condExp hm, integral_condExp hm]
      exact (hX.condExp one_le_two).integrable_sq
    _ = Var[X; μ] := by rw [variance_eq_sub hX]; ring

name: condVar_bot'
statement:
lemma condVar_bot' [NeZero μ] (X : Ω → ℝ) :
    Var[X; μ | ⊥] = fun _ => ⨍ ω, (X ω - ⨍ ω', X ω' ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp [condVar, condExp_bot', average, measureReal_def]

name: condVar_bot_ae_eq
statement:
lemma condVar_bot_ae_eq (X : Ω → ℝ) :
    Var[X; μ | ⊥] =ᵐ[μ] fun _ ↦ ⨍ ω, (X ω - ⨍ ω', X ω' ∂μ) ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hμ := eq_zero_or_neZero μ
  · rw [ae_zero]
    exact eventually_bot
  · exact .of_forall <| congr_fun (condVar_bot' X)

name: condVar_bot
statement:
@[simp]
lemma condVar_bot [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) :
    Var[X; μ | ⊥] = fun _ω ↦ Var[X; μ]
proof:
:= by
  simp [condVar_bot', average_eq_integral, variance_eq_integral hX]

name: condVar_smul
statement: lemma condVar_smul (c : ℝ) (X : Ω → ℝ) : Var[c • X; μ | m] =ᵐ[μ] c ^ 2 • Var[X; μ | m]
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Var[c • X; μ | m]
    _ =ᵐ[μ] μ[c ^ 2 • (X - μ[X | m]) ^ 2 | m] := by
      rw [condVar]
      refine condExp_congr_ae ?_
      filter_upwards [condExp_smul (m := m) c X] with ω hω
      simp [hω, ← mul_sub, mul_pow]
    _ =ᵐ[μ] c ^ 2 • Var[X; μ | m] := condExp_smul ..

name: condVar_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma condVar_neg (X : Ω → ℝ) : Var[-X; μ | m] =ᵐ[μ] Var[X; μ | m]
proof:
:= by
  refine condExp_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [condExp_neg (m := m) X] with ω hω
  simp [hω]
  ring

name: hasPDF_iff
statement:
theorem hasPDF_iff :
    HasPDF X ℙ μ ↔ AEMeasurable X ℙ ∧ (map X ℙ).HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ ∧ map X ℙ ≪ μ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ ↦ ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ ↦ ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩⟩

name: hasPDF_iff_of_aemeasurable
statement:
theorem hasPDF_iff_of_aemeasurable (hX : AEMeasurable X ℙ) :
    HasPDF X ℙ μ ↔ (map X ℙ).HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ ∧ map X ℙ ≪ μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasPDF_iff]
  simp only [hX, true_and]

name: HasPDF.aemeasurable
statement: theorem HasPDF.aemeasurable [HasPDF X ℙ μ] : AEMeasurable X ℙ
proof: := HasPDF.aemeasurable' μ

name: HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous
statement: theorem HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous [HasPDF X ℙ μ] : map X ℙ ≪ μ
proof: := HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous'

name: HasPDF.quasiMeasurePreserving_of_measurable
statement:
theorem HasPDF.quasiMeasurePreserving_of_measurable (X : Ω → E) (ℙ : Measure Ω) (μ : Measure E)
    [HasPDF X ℙ μ] (h : Measurable X) : QuasiMeasurePreserving X ℙ μ

name: HasPDF.congr
statement: theorem HasPDF.congr (hXY : X =ᵐ[ℙ] Y) [hX : HasPDF X ℙ μ] : HasPDF Y ℙ μ
proof:
:=
  ⟨(HasPDF.aemeasurable X ℙ μ).congr hXY, ℙ.map_congr hXY ▸ hX.haveLebesgueDecomposition,
    ℙ.map_congr hXY ▸ hX.absolutelyContinuous⟩

name: HasPDF.congr_iff
statement: theorem HasPDF.congr_iff (hXY : X =ᵐ[ℙ] Y) : HasPDF X ℙ μ ↔ HasPDF Y ℙ μ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ HasPDF.congr hXY, fun _ ↦ HasPDF.congr hXY.symm⟩

name: hasPDF_of_map_eq_withDensity
statement:
theorem hasPDF_of_map_eq_withDensity (hX : AEMeasurable X ℙ) (f : E → ℝ≥0∞) (hf : AEMeasurable f μ)
    (h : map X ℙ = μ.withDensity f) : HasPDF X ℙ μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hX, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [h]
  · rw [withDensity_congr_ae hf.ae_eq_mk]
    exact haveLebesgueDecomposition_withDensity μ hf.measurable_mk
  · exact withDensity_absolutelyContinuous μ f

name: pdf_def
statement:
theorem pdf_def {_ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {ℙ : Measure Ω} {μ : Measure E} {X : Ω → E} :
    pdf X ℙ μ = (map X ℙ).rnDeriv μ
proof: := rfl

name: pdf_of_not_haveLebesgueDecomposition
statement:
theorem pdf_of_not_haveLebesgueDecomposition {_ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {ℙ : Measure Ω}
    {μ : Measure E} {X : Ω → E} (h : ¬(map X ℙ).HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ) : pdf X ℙ μ = 0
proof:
:=
  rnDeriv_of_not_haveLebesgueDecomposition h

name: measurable_pdf
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem measurable_pdf {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} (X : Ω → E) (ℙ : Measure Ω)
    (μ : Measure E := by volume_tac) : Measurable (pdf X ℙ μ)
proof:
:= by
  exact measurable_rnDeriv _ _

name: withDensity_pdf_le_map
statement:
theorem withDensity_pdf_le_map {_ : MeasurableSpace Ω} (X : Ω → E) (ℙ : Measure Ω)
    (μ : Measure E := by volume_tac) : μ.withDensity (pdf X ℙ μ) ≤ map X ℙ
proof:
:=
  withDensity_rnDeriv_le _ _

name: setLIntegral_pdf_le_map
statement:
theorem setLIntegral_pdf_le_map {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} (X : Ω → E) (ℙ : Measure Ω)
    (μ : Measure E := by volume_tac) (s : Set E) :
    ∫⁻ x in s, pdf X ℙ μ x ∂μ ≤ map X ℙ s
proof:
:= by
  apply (withDensity_apply_le _ s).trans
  exact withDensity_pdf_le_map _ _ _ s

name: map_eq_withDensity_pdf
statement:
theorem map_eq_withDensity_pdf {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} (X : Ω → E) (ℙ : Measure Ω)
    (μ : Measure E := by volume_tac) [hX : HasPDF X ℙ μ] :
    map X ℙ = μ.withDensity (pdf X ℙ μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pdf_def, withDensity_rnDeriv_eq _ _ hX.absolutelyContinuous]

name: map_eq_setLIntegral_pdf
proof:
:= by
  rw [← withDensity_apply _ hs, map_eq_withDensity_pdf X ℙ μ]

name: congr
statement: protected theorem congr {X Y : Ω → E} (hXY : X =ᵐ[ℙ] Y) : pdf X ℙ μ = pdf Y ℙ μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [pdf_def, pdf_def, map_congr hXY]

name: lintegral_eq_measure_univ
statement:
theorem lintegral_eq_measure_univ {X : Ω → E} [HasPDF X ℙ μ] :
    ∫⁻ x, pdf X ℙ μ x ∂μ = ℙ Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← setLIntegral_univ, ← map_eq_setLIntegral_pdf X ℙ μ MeasurableSet.univ,
    map_apply_of_aemeasurable (HasPDF.aemeasurable X ℙ μ) MeasurableSet.univ, Set.preimage_univ]

name: eq_of_map_eq_withDensity
statement:
theorem eq_of_map_eq_withDensity [IsFiniteMeasure ℙ] {X : Ω → E} [HasPDF X ℙ μ] (f : E → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hmf : AEMeasurable f μ) : map X ℙ = μ.withDensity f ↔ pdf X ℙ μ =ᵐ[μ] f
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_eq_withDensity_pdf X ℙ μ]
  apply withDensity_eq_iff (measurable_pdf X ℙ μ).aemeasurable hmf
  rw [lintegral_eq_measure_univ]
  exact measure_ne_top _ _

name: eq_of_map_eq_withDensity'
statement:
theorem eq_of_map_eq_withDensity' [SigmaFinite μ] {X : Ω → E} [HasPDF X ℙ μ] (f : E → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hmf : AEMeasurable f μ) : map X ℙ = μ.withDensity f ↔ pdf X ℙ μ =ᵐ[μ] f
proof:
:=
  map_eq_withDensity_pdf X ℙ μ ▸
    withDensity_eq_iff_of_sigmaFinite (measurable_pdf X ℙ μ).aemeasurable hmf

name: lintegral_pdf_mul
statement:
theorem lintegral_pdf_mul {X : Ω → E} [HasPDF X ℙ μ] {f : E → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) : ∫⁻ x, pdf X ℙ μ x * f x ∂μ = ∫⁻ x, f (X x) ∂ℙ
proof:
:= by
  rw [pdf_def,
    ← lintegral_map' (hf.mono_ac HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous) (HasPDF.aemeasurable X ℙ μ),
    lintegral_rnDeriv_mul HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous hf]

name: integrable_pdf_smul_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Function.comp_def,
    ← integrable_map_measure (hf.mono_ac HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous) (HasPDF.aemeasurable X ℙ μ),
    map_eq_withDensity_pdf X ℙ μ, pdf_def, integrable_rnDeriv_smul_iff HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous]
  rw [withDensity_rnDeriv_eq _ _ HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous]

name: integral_pdf_smul
statement:
theorem integral_pdf_smul [IsFiniteMeasure ℙ] {X : Ω → E} [HasPDF X ℙ μ] {f : E → F}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) : ∫ x, (pdf X ℙ μ x).toReal • f x ∂μ = ∫ x, f (X x) ∂ℙ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_map (HasPDF.aemeasurable X ℙ μ) (hf.mono_ac HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous),
    map_eq_withDensity_pdf X ℙ μ, pdf_def, integral_rnDeriv_smul HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous,
    withDensity_rnDeriv_eq _ _ HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous]

name: quasiMeasurePreserving_hasPDF
statement:
theorem quasiMeasurePreserving_hasPDF (hg : QuasiMeasurePreserving g μ ν)
    (hmap : (map g (map X ℙ)).HaveLebesgueDecomposition ν) : HasPDF (g ∘ X) ℙ ν
proof:
:= by
  have hgm : AEMeasurable g (map X ℙ) := hg.aemeasurable.mono_ac HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous
  rw [hasPDF_iff, ← AEMeasurable.map_map_of_aemeasurable hgm (HasPDF.aemeasurable X ℙ μ)]
  refine ⟨hg.measurable.comp_aemeasurable (HasPDF.aemeasurable _ _ μ), hmap, ?_⟩
  exact (HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous.map hg.1).trans hg.2

name: quasiMeasurePreserving_hasPDF'
statement:
theorem quasiMeasurePreserving_hasPDF' [SFinite ℙ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hg : QuasiMeasurePreserving g μ ν) : HasPDF (g ∘ X) ℙ ν
proof:
:=
  quasiMeasurePreserving_hasPDF X hg inferInstance

name: integral_mul_eq_integral
statement: theorem integral_mul_eq_integral [HasPDF X ℙ] : ∫ x, x * (pdf X ℙ volume x).toReal = ∫ x, X x ∂ℙ
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ = ∫ x, (pdf X ℙ volume x).toReal * x := by congr with x; exact mul_comm _ _
    _ = _ := integral_pdf_smul measurable_id.aestronglyMeasurable

name: hasFiniteIntegral_mul
statement:
theorem hasFiniteIntegral_mul {f : ℝ → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : pdf X ℙ =ᵐ[volume] g)
    (hgi : ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ * g x ≠ ∞) :
    HasFiniteIntegral fun x => f x * (pdf X ℙ volume x).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm]
  have : (fun x => ‖f x‖ₑ * g x) =ᵐ[volume] fun x => ‖f x * (pdf X ℙ volume x).toReal‖ₑ := by
    refine ae_eq_trans ((ae_eq_refl _).fun_mul (ae_eq_trans hg.symm ofReal_toReal_ae_eq.symm)) ?_
    simp_rw [← smul_eq_mul, enorm_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    refine .fun_mul (ae_eq_refl _) ?_
    simp only [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, ae_eq_refl]
  rwa [lt_top_iff_ne_top, ← lintegral_congr_ae this]

name: indepFun_iff_pdf_prod_eq_pdf_mul_pdf
statement:
theorem indepFun_iff_pdf_prod_eq_pdf_mul_pdf
    [IsFiniteMeasure ℙ] [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν] [HasPDF (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) ℙ (μ.prod ν)] :
    IndepFun X Y ℙ ↔
      pdf (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω)) ℙ (μ.prod ν) =ᵐ[μ.prod ν] fun z ↦ pdf X ℙ μ z.1 * pdf Y ℙ ν z.2
proof:
:= by
  have : HasPDF X ℙ μ := quasiMeasurePreserving_hasPDF' (μ := μ.prod ν) (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω))
    quasiMeasurePreserving_fst
  have : HasPDF Y ℙ ν := quasiMeasurePreserving_hasPDF' (μ := μ.prod ν) (fun ω ↦ (X ω, Y ω))
    quasiMeasurePreserving_snd
  have h₀ : (ℙ.map X).prod (ℙ.map Y) =
      (μ.prod ν).withDensity fun z ↦ pdf X ℙ μ z.1 * pdf Y ℙ ν z.2 :=
    prod_eq fun s t hs ht ↦ by rw [withDensity_apply _ (hs.prod ht), ← prod_restrict,
      lintegral_prod_mul (measurable_pdf X ℙ μ).aemeasurable (measurable_pdf Y ℙ ν).aemeasurable,
      map_eq_setLIntegral_pdf X ℙ μ hs, map_eq_setLIntegral_pdf Y ℙ ν ht]
  rw [indepFun_iff_map_prod_eq_prod_map_map (HasPDF.aemeasurable X ℙ μ) (HasPDF.aemeasurable Y ℙ ν),
    ← eq_of_map_eq_withDensity, h₀]
  exact (((measurable_pdf X ℙ μ).comp measurable_fst).mul
    ((measurable_pdf Y ℙ ν).comp measurable_snd)).aemeasurable

name: IndepFun.mul_hasPDF'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IndepFun.mul_hasPDF' [SFinite μ] [HasPDF X ℙ μ] [HasPDF Y ℙ μ]
    (σX : SigmaFinite (ℙ.map X)) (σY : SigmaFinite (ℙ.map Y)) (hXY : IndepFun X Y ℙ) :
    HasPDF (X * Y) ℙ μ
proof:
:= by
  have : AEMeasurable X ℙ := HasPDF.aemeasurable' μ
  have : AEMeasurable Y ℙ := HasPDF.aemeasurable' μ
  rw [hasPDF_iff_of_aemeasurable (by fun_prop),
    hXY.map_mul_eq_map_mconv_map₀' (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) σX σY]
  refine ⟨?_, mconv_absolutelyContinuous HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous⟩
  apply HaveLebesgueDecomposition.mconv <;> exact HasPDF.absolutelyContinuous

name: IndepFun.mul_hasPDF
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IndepFun.mul_hasPDF [SFinite μ] [HasPDF X ℙ μ] [HasPDF Y ℙ μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ℙ]
  (hXY : IndepFun X Y ℙ) : HasPDF (X * Y) ℙ μ

name: IndepFun.pdf_mul_eq_mlconvolution_pdf'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IndepFun.pdf_mul_eq_mlconvolution_pdf' [SigmaFinite μ] [HasPDF X ℙ μ] [HasPDF Y ℙ μ]

name: IndepFun.pdf_mul_eq_mlconvolution_pdf
statement:

theorem IndepFun.pdf_mul_eq_mlconvolution_pdf [SFinite μ] [HasPDF X ℙ μ] [HasPDF Y ℙ μ]

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.truncation
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.truncation (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ)

  exact (stronglyMeasurable_id.indicator measurableSet_Ioc).aestronglyMeasurable

name: abs_truncation_le_bound
statement: theorem abs_truncation_le_bound (f : α → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (x : α) : |truncation f A x| ≤ |A|
proof:
:= by
  simp only [truncation, Set.indicator, id, Function.comp_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact abs_le_abs h.2 (neg_le.2 h.1.le)
  · simp [abs_nonneg]

name: truncation_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem truncation_zero (f : α → ℝ) : truncation f 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [truncation]; rfl

name: abs_truncation_le_abs_self
statement: theorem abs_truncation_le_abs_self (f : α → ℝ) (A : ℝ) (x : α) : |truncation f A x| ≤ |f x|
proof:
:= by
  simp only [truncation, indicator, id, Function.comp_apply]
  split_ifs
  · exact le_rfl
  · simp [abs_nonneg]

name: truncation_eq_self
statement:
theorem truncation_eq_self {f : α → ℝ} {A : ℝ} {x : α} (h : |f x| < A) :
    truncation f A x = f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [truncation, indicator, id, Function.comp_apply, ite_eq_left_iff]
  intro H
  apply H.elim
  simp [(abs_lt.1 h).1, (abs_lt.1 h).2.le]

name: truncation_eq_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem truncation_eq_of_nonneg {f : α → ℝ} {A : ℝ} (h : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) :
    truncation f A = indicator (Set.Ioc 0 A) id ∘ f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rcases (h x).lt_or_eq with (hx | hx)
  · simp only [truncation, indicator, hx, Set.mem_Ioc, id, Function.comp_apply]
    by_cases h'x : f x ≤ A
    · have : -A < f x := by linarith [h x]
      simp only [this, true_and]
    · simp only [h'x, and_false]
  · simp only [truncation, indicator, hx, id, Function.comp_apply, ite_self]

name: truncation_nonneg
statement: theorem truncation_nonneg {f : α → ℝ} (A : ℝ) {x : α} (h : 0 ≤ f x) : 0 ≤ truncation f A x
proof:
:=
  Set.indicator_apply_nonneg fun _ => h

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.memLp_truncation
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.memLp_truncation [IsFiniteMeasure μ]

proof:
:=
  MemLp.of_bound hf.truncation |A| (Eventually.of_forall fun _ => abs_truncation_le_bound _ _ _)

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.integrable_truncation
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.integrable_truncation [IsFiniteMeasure μ]

proof:
:= by
