name: bind_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_const (p : PMF α) (q : PMF β) : (p.bind fun _ => q) = q
proof:
:=
  PMF.ext fun x => by rw [bind_apply, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, tsum_coe, one_mul]

name: bind_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_bind : (p.bind f).bind g = p.bind fun a => (f a).bind g
proof:
:=
  PMF.ext fun b => by
    simpa only [ENNReal.coe_inj.symm, bind_apply, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left.symm,
      ENNReal.tsum_mul_right.symm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using ENNReal.tsum_comm

name: bind_comm
statement:
theorem bind_comm (p : PMF α) (q : PMF β) (f : α → β → PMF γ) :
    (p.bind fun a => q.bind (f a)) = q.bind fun b => p.bind fun a => f a b
proof:
:=
  PMF.ext fun b => by
    simpa only [ENNReal.coe_inj.symm, bind_apply, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left.symm,
      ENNReal.tsum_mul_right.symm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using ENNReal.tsum_comm

name: toOuterMeasure_bind_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toOuterMeasure_bind_apply :
    (p.bind f).toOuterMeasure s = ∑' a, p a * (f a).toOuterMeasure s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (p.bind f).toOuterMeasure s = ∑' b, if b ∈ s then ∑' a, p a * f a b else 0 := by
      simp [toOuterMeasure_apply, Set.indicator_apply]
    _ = ∑' (b) (a), p a * if b ∈ s then f a b else 0 := tsum_congr fun b => by split_ifs <;> simp
    _ = ∑' (a) (b), p a * if b ∈ s then f a b else 0 := ENNReal.tsum_comm
    _ = ∑' a, p a * ∑' b, if b ∈ s then f a b else 0 := tsum_congr fun _ => ENNReal.tsum_mul_left
    _ = ∑' a, p a * ∑' b, if b ∈ s then f a b else 0 :=
      (tsum_congr fun a => (congr_arg fun x => p a * x) <| tsum_congr fun b => by split_ifs <;> rfl)
    _ = ∑' a, p a * (f a).toOuterMeasure s :=
      tsum_congr fun a => by simp only [toOuterMeasure_apply, Set.indicator_apply]

name: toMeasure_bind_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMeasure_bind_apply [MeasurableSpace β] (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (p.bind f).toMeasure s = ∑' a, p a * (f a).toMeasure s
proof:
:=
  (toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply (p.bind f) hs).trans
    ((toOuterMeasure_bind_apply p f s).trans
      (tsum_congr fun a =>
        congr_arg (fun x => p a * x) (toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply (f a) hs).symm))

name: bindOnSupport_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bindOnSupport_apply (b : β) :
    p.bindOnSupport f b = ∑' a, p a * if h : p a = 0 then 0 else f a h b
proof: := rfl

name: support_bindOnSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_bindOnSupport :
    (p.bindOnSupport f).support = ⋃ (a : α) (h : a ∈ p.support), (f a h).support
proof:
:= by
  ext
  
  simp only [mem_support_iff, bindOnSupport_apply, ne_eq, ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero,
    dite_eq_left_iff, mul_eq_zero, not_forall, not_or, and_exists_self,
    Set.mem_iUnion]

name: mem_support_bindOnSupport_iff
statement:
theorem mem_support_bindOnSupport_iff (b : β) :
    b ∈ (p.bindOnSupport f).support ↔ ∃ (a : α) (h : a ∈ p.support), b ∈ (f a h).support
proof:
:= by
  simp only [support_bindOnSupport, Set.mem_iUnion]

name: bindOnSupport_eq_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bindOnSupport_eq_bind (p : PMF α) (f : α → PMF β) :
    (p.bindOnSupport fun a _ => f a) = p.bind f
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  have : ∀ a, ite (p a = 0) 0 (p a * f a b) = p a * f a b :=
    fun a => ite_eq_right_iff.2 fun h => h.symm ▸ symm (zero_mul <| f a b)
  simp only [bindOnSupport_apply fun a _ => f a, p.bind_apply f, dite_eq_ite, mul_ite,
    mul_zero, this]

name: bindOnSupport_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem bindOnSupport_eq_zero_iff (b : β) :
    p.bindOnSupport f b = 0 ↔ ∀ (a) (ha : p a ≠ 0), f a ha b = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bindOnSupport_apply, ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero, or_iff_not_imp_left]
  exact ⟨fun h a ha => Trans.trans (dite_eq_right ha).symm (h a ha),
    fun h a ha => Trans.trans (dite_eq_right ha) (h a ha)⟩

name: pure_bindOnSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pure_bindOnSupport (a : α) (f : ∀ (a' : α) (_ : a' ∈ (pure a).support), PMF β) :
    (pure a).bindOnSupport f = f a ((mem_support_pure_iff a a).mpr rfl)
proof:
:= by
  refine PMF.ext fun b => ?_
  simp only [bindOnSupport_apply, pure_apply]
  classical
  refine _root_.trans (tsum_congr fun a' => ?_) (tsum_ite_eq a (fun _ ↦ _))
  by_cases h : a' = a <;> simp [h]

name: bindOnSupport_pure
statement: theorem bindOnSupport_pure (p : PMF α) : (p.bindOnSupport fun a _ => pure a) = p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PMF.bind_pure, PMF.bindOnSupport_eq_bind]

name: bindOnSupport_bindOnSupport
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bindOnSupport_bindOnSupport (p : PMF α) (f : ∀ a ∈ p.support, PMF β)
    (g : ∀ b ∈ (p.bindOnSupport f).support, PMF γ) :
    (p.bindOnSupport f).bindOnSupport g =
      p.bindOnSupport fun a ha =>
        (f a ha).bindOnSupport fun b hb =>
          g b ((mem_support_bindOnSupport_iff f b).mpr ⟨a, ha, hb⟩)
proof:
:= by
  refine PMF.ext fun a => ?_
  dsimp only [bindOnSupport_apply]
  simp only [← tsum_dite_right, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left.symm, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right.symm]
  classical
  simp only [ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero]
  refine ENNReal.tsum_comm.trans (tsum_congr fun a' => tsum_congr fun b => ?_)
  split_ifs with h _ h_1 H h_2
  any_goals ring1
  · absurd H
    simpa [h] using h_1 a'
  · simp [h_2]

name: bindOnSupport_comm
statement:
theorem bindOnSupport_comm (p : PMF α) (q : PMF β) (f : ∀ a ∈ p.support, ∀ b ∈ q.support, PMF γ) :
    (p.bindOnSupport fun a ha => q.bindOnSupport (f a ha)) =
      q.bindOnSupport fun b hb => p.bindOnSupport fun a ha => f a ha b hb
proof:
:= by
  apply PMF.ext; rintro c
  simp only [bindOnSupport_apply, ← tsum_dite_right,
    ENNReal.tsum_mul_left.symm]
  refine _root_.trans ENNReal.tsum_comm (tsum_congr fun b => tsum_congr fun a => ?_)
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h2 <;> ring

name: toOuterMeasure_bindOnSupport_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toOuterMeasure_bindOnSupport_apply :
    (p.bindOnSupport f).toOuterMeasure s =
      ∑' a, p a * if h : p a = 0 then 0 else (f a h).toOuterMeasure s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toOuterMeasure_apply]
  classical
  calc
    (∑' b, ite (b ∈ s) (∑' a, p a * dite (p a = 0) (fun h => 0) fun h => f a h b) 0) =
        ∑' (b) (a), ite (b ∈ s) (p a * dite (p a = 0) (fun h => 0) fun h => f a h b) 0 :=
      tsum_congr fun b => by split_ifs with hbs <;> simp only [tsum_zero]
    _ = ∑' (a) (b), ite (b ∈ s) (p a * dite (p a = 0) (fun h => 0) fun h => f a h b) 0 :=
      ENNReal.tsum_comm
    _ = ∑' a, p a * ∑' b, ite (b ∈ s) (dite (p a = 0) (fun h => 0) fun h => f a h b) 0 :=
      (tsum_congr fun a => by simp only [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, mul_ite, mul_zero])
    _ = ∑' a, p a * dite (p a = 0) (fun h => 0) fun h => ∑' b, ite (b ∈ s) (f a h b) 0 :=
      tsum_congr fun a => by split_ifs with ha <;> simp only [ite_self, tsum_zero]

name: toMeasure_bindOnSupport_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMeasure_bindOnSupport_apply [MeasurableSpace β] (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (p.bindOnSupport f).toMeasure s =
      ∑' a, p a * if h : p a = 0 then 0 else (f a h).toMeasure s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply _ hs, toOuterMeasure_bindOnSupport_apply]

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
protected theorem ext {p q : PMF α} (h : ∀ x, p x = q x) : p = q
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext p q h

name: hasSum_coe_one
statement: theorem hasSum_coe_one (p : PMF α) : HasSum p 1

name: tsum_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tsum_coe (p : PMF α) : ∑' a, p a = 1
proof:
:=
  p.hasSum_coe_one.tsum_eq

name: tsum_coe_ne_top
statement: theorem tsum_coe_ne_top (p : PMF α) : ∑' a, p a ≠ ∞
proof:
:=
  p.tsum_coe.symm ▸ ENNReal.one_ne_top

name: tsum_coe_indicator_ne_top
statement: theorem tsum_coe_indicator_ne_top (p : PMF α) (s : Set α) : ∑' a, s.indicator p a ≠ ∞
proof:
:=
  ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt
    (ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum (fun _ => Set.indicator_apply_le fun _ => le_rfl))
    (lt_of_le_of_ne le_top p.tsum_coe_ne_top))

name: coe_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_ne_zero (p : PMF α) : ⇑p ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun hp =>
  zero_ne_one ((tsum_zero.symm.trans (tsum_congr fun x => symm (congr_fun hp x))).trans p.tsum_coe)

name: mem_support_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_support_iff (p : PMF α) (a : α) : a ∈ p.support ↔ p a ≠ 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: support_nonempty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_nonempty (p : PMF α) : p.support.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  Function.support_nonempty_iff.2 p.coe_ne_zero

name: support_countable
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_countable (p : PMF α) : p.support.Countable
proof:
:=
  Summable.countable_support_ennreal (tsum_coe_ne_top p)

name: apply_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem apply_eq_zero_iff (p : PMF α) (a : α) : p a = 0 ↔ a ∉ p.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_support_iff, Classical.not_not]

name: apply_pos_iff
statement: theorem apply_pos_iff (p : PMF α) (a : α) : 0 < p a ↔ a ∈ p.support
proof:
:=
  pos_iff_ne_zero.trans (p.mem_support_iff a).symm

name: apply_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem apply_eq_one_iff (p : PMF α) (a : α) : p a = 1 ↔ p.support = {a}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => Set.Subset.antisymm (fun a' ha' => by_contra fun ha => ?_)
    fun a' ha' => ha'.symm ▸ (p.mem_support_iff a).2 fun ha => zero_ne_one <| ha.symm.trans h,
    fun h => _root_.trans (symm <| tsum_eq_single a
      fun a' ha' => (p.apply_eq_zero_iff a').2 (h.symm ▸ ha')) p.tsum_coe⟩
  suffices 1 < ∑' a, p a from ne_of_lt this p.tsum_coe.symm
  classical
  have : 0 < ∑' b, ite (b = a) 0 (p b) := by
    rw [pos_iff_ne_zero, ENNReal.summable.tsum_ne_zero_iff]
    exact ⟨a', ite_ne_left_iff.2 ⟨ha, Ne.symm <| (p.mem_support_iff a').2 ha'⟩⟩
  calc
    1 = 1 + 0 := (add_zero 1).symm
    _ < p a + ∑' b, ite (b = a) 0 (p b) :=
      (ENNReal.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt ENNReal.one_ne_top (le_of_eq h.symm) this)
    _ = ite (a = a) (p a) 0 + ∑' b, ite (b = a) 0 (p b) := by rw [eq_self_iff_true, ite_true]
    _ = (∑' b, ite (b = a) (p b) 0) + ∑' b, ite (b = a) 0 (p b) := by
      congr
      exact symm (tsum_eq_single a fun b hb => ite_eq_right hb)
    _ = ∑' b, (ite (b = a) (p b) 0 + ite (b = a) 0 (p b)) := ENNReal.tsum_add.symm
    _ = ∑' b, p b := tsum_congr fun b => by split_ifs <;> simp only [zero_add, add_zero]

name: coe_le_one
statement: theorem coe_le_one (p : PMF α) (a : α) : p a ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine hasSum_le (fun b => ?_) (hasSum_ite_eq a (p a)) (hasSum_coe_one p)
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: apply_ne_top
statement: theorem apply_ne_top (p : PMF α) (a : α) : p a ≠ ∞
proof:
:=
  ne_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (p.coe_le_one a) ENNReal.one_lt_top)

name: apply_lt_top
statement: theorem apply_lt_top (p : PMF α) (a : α) : p a < ∞
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne le_top (p.apply_ne_top a)

name: toOuterMeasure_apply
statement: theorem toOuterMeasure_apply : p.toOuterMeasure s = ∑' x, s.indicator p x
proof:
:=
  tsum_congr fun x => smul_dirac_apply (p x) x s

name: toOuterMeasure_caratheodory
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toOuterMeasure_caratheodory : p.toOuterMeasure.caratheodory = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 <| le_trans (le_sInf fun x hx => ?_) (le_sum_caratheodory _)
  have ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx
  exact
    ((le_of_eq (dirac_caratheodory y).symm).trans (le_smul_caratheodory _ _)).trans (le_of_eq hy)

name: toOuterMeasure_apply_finset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toOuterMeasure_apply_finset (s : Finset α) : p.toOuterMeasure s = ∑ x ∈ s, p x
proof:
:= by
  refine (toOuterMeasure_apply p s).trans ((tsum_eq_sum (s := s) ?_).trans ?_)
  · exact fun x hx => Set.indicator_of_notMem (Finset.mem_coe.not.2 hx) _
  · exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => Set.indicator_of_mem (Finset.mem_coe.2 hx) _

name: toOuterMeasure_apply_singleton
statement: theorem toOuterMeasure_apply_singleton (a : α) : p.toOuterMeasure {a} = p a
proof:
:= by
  refine (p.toOuterMeasure_apply {a}).trans ((tsum_eq_single a fun b hb => ?_).trans ?_)
  · classical exact ite_eq_right_iff.2 fun hb' => False.elim <| hb hb'
  · classical exact ite_eq_left_iff.2 fun ha' => False.elim <| ha' rfl

name: toOuterMeasure_injective
statement: theorem toOuterMeasure_injective : (toOuterMeasure : PMF α → OuterMeasure α).Injective
proof:
:=
  fun p q h => PMF.ext fun x => (p.toOuterMeasure_apply_singleton x).symm.trans
    ((congr_fun (congr_arg _ h) _).trans <| q.toOuterMeasure_apply_singleton x)

name: toOuterMeasure_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toOuterMeasure_inj {p q : PMF α} : p.toOuterMeasure = q.toOuterMeasure ↔ p = q
proof:
:=
  toOuterMeasure_injective.eq_iff

name: toOuterMeasure_apply_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem toOuterMeasure_apply_eq_zero_iff : p.toOuterMeasure s = 0 ↔ Disjoint p.support s
proof:
:= by
  rw [toOuterMeasure_apply, ENNReal.tsum_eq_zero]
  exact funext_iff.symm.trans Set.indicator_eq_zero'

name: toOuterMeasure_apply_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem toOuterMeasure_apply_eq_one_iff : p.toOuterMeasure s = 1 ↔ p.support ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  refine (p.toOuterMeasure_apply s).symm ▸ ⟨fun h a hap => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · refine by_contra fun hs => ne_of_lt ?_ (h.trans p.tsum_coe.symm)
    have hs' : s.indicator p a = 0 := Set.indicator_apply_eq_zero.2 fun hs' => False.elim <| hs hs'
    have hsa : s.indicator p a < p a := hs'.symm ▸ (p.apply_pos_iff a).2 hap
    exact ENNReal.tsum_lt_tsum (p.tsum_coe_indicator_ne_top s)
      (fun x => Set.indicator_apply_le fun _ => le_rfl) hsa
  · classical suffices ∀ (x) (_ : x ∉ s), p x = 0 from
      _root_.trans (tsum_congr
        fun a => (Set.indicator_apply s p a).trans
          (ite_eq_left_iff.2 <| symm ∘ this a)) p.tsum_coe
    exact fun a ha => (p.apply_eq_zero_iff a).2 <| Set.notMem_subset h ha

name: toOuterMeasure_apply_inter_support
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toOuterMeasure_apply_inter_support :
    p.toOuterMeasure (s ∩ p.support) = p.toOuterMeasure s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toOuterMeasure_apply, PMF.support, Set.indicator_inter_support]

name: toOuterMeasure_mono
statement:
theorem toOuterMeasure_mono {s t : Set α} (h : s ∩ p.support ⊆ t) :
    p.toOuterMeasure s ≤ p.toOuterMeasure t
proof:
:=
  le_trans (le_of_eq (toOuterMeasure_apply_inter_support p s).symm) (p.toOuterMeasure.mono h)

name: toOuterMeasure_apply_eq_of_inter_support_eq
statement:
theorem toOuterMeasure_apply_eq_of_inter_support_eq {s t : Set α}
    (h : s ∩ p.support = t ∩ p.support) : p.toOuterMeasure s = p.toOuterMeasure t
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (p.toOuterMeasure_mono (h.symm ▸ Set.inter_subset_left))
    (p.toOuterMeasure_mono (h ▸ Set.inter_subset_left))

name: toOuterMeasure_apply_fintype
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toOuterMeasure_apply_fintype [Fintype α] : p.toOuterMeasure s = ∑ x, s.indicator p x
proof:
:=
  (p.toOuterMeasure_apply s).trans (tsum_eq_sum fun x h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ x) h)

name: toOuterMeasure_apply_le_toMeasure_apply
statement: theorem toOuterMeasure_apply_le_toMeasure_apply (s : Set α) : p.toOuterMeasure s ≤ p.toMeasure s
proof:
:=
  le_toMeasure_apply p.toOuterMeasure _ s

name: toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply
statement:
theorem toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    p.toMeasure s = p.toOuterMeasure s
proof:
:=
  toMeasure_apply p.toOuterMeasure _ hs

name: toMeasure_apply
statement: theorem toMeasure_apply (hs : MeasurableSet s) : p.toMeasure s = ∑' x, s.indicator p x
proof:
:=
  (p.toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply hs).trans (p.toOuterMeasure_apply s)

name: toMeasure_apply_singleton
statement:
theorem toMeasure_apply_singleton (a : α) (h : MeasurableSet ({a} : Set α)) :
    p.toMeasure {a} = p a
proof:
:= by
  simp [p.toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply h, toOuterMeasure_apply_singleton]

name: toMeasure_apply_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem toMeasure_apply_eq_zero_iff (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    p.toMeasure s = 0 ↔ Disjoint p.support s
proof:
:= by
  rw [p.toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply hs, toOuterMeasure_apply_eq_zero_iff]

name: toMeasure_apply_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem toMeasure_apply_eq_one_iff (hs : MeasurableSet s) : p.toMeasure s = 1 ↔ p.support ⊆ s
proof:
:=
  (p.toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply hs).symm ▸ p.toOuterMeasure_apply_eq_one_iff s

name: toMeasure_mono
statement:
theorem toMeasure_mono {t : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (h : s ∩ p.support ⊆ t) : p.toMeasure s ≤ p.toMeasure t
proof:
:= by
  rw [p.toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply hs]
  exact (p.toOuterMeasure_mono h).trans (p.toOuterMeasure_apply_le_toMeasure_apply t)

name: toMeasure_apply_inter_support
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMeasure_apply_inter_support (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    p.toMeasure (s ∩ p.support) = p.toMeasure s
proof:
:=
  (measure_mono s.inter_subset_left).antisymm (p.toMeasure_mono hs (refl _))

name: restrict_toMeasure_support
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrict_toMeasure_support : p.toMeasure.restrict p.support = p.toMeasure
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.restrict_apply hs, p.toMeasure_apply_inter_support hs]

name: toMeasure_apply_eq_of_inter_support_eq
statement:
theorem toMeasure_apply_eq_of_inter_support_eq {t : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (ht : MeasurableSet t) (h : s ∩ p.support = t ∩ p.support) : p.toMeasure s = p.toMeasure t
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [p.toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply, hs, ht] using
    p.toOuterMeasure_apply_eq_of_inter_support_eq h

name: toMeasure_injective
statement: theorem toMeasure_injective : (toMeasure : PMF α → Measure α).Injective
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  ext x
  rw [← p.toMeasure_apply_singleton x <| measurableSet_singleton x,
    ← q.toMeasure_apply_singleton x <| measurableSet_singleton x, h]

name: toMeasure_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMeasure_inj {p q : PMF α} : p.toMeasure = q.toMeasure ↔ p = q
proof:
:=
  toMeasure_injective.eq_iff

name: toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure
statement: theorem toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure (s : Set α) : p.toMeasure s = p.toOuterMeasure s
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (p.support_countable.mono s.inter_subset_right).measurableSet
  rw [← restrict_toMeasure_support, Measure.restrict_apply' p.support_countable.measurableSet,
    p.toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply hs, toOuterMeasure_apply_inter_support]

name: toMeasure_apply_finset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMeasure_apply_finset (s : Finset α) : p.toMeasure s = ∑ x ∈ s, p x
proof:
:=
  (p.toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure s).trans (p.toOuterMeasure_apply_finset s)

name: toMeasure_apply_eq_tsum
statement: theorem toMeasure_apply_eq_tsum (s : Set α) : p.toMeasure s = ∑' x, s.indicator p x
proof:
:=
  (p.toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure s).trans (p.toOuterMeasure_apply s)

name: toMeasure_apply_fintype
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMeasure_apply_fintype (s : Set α) [Fintype α] : p.toMeasure s = ∑ x, s.indicator p x
proof:
:=
  (p.toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure s).trans (p.toOuterMeasure_apply_fintype s)

name: toPMF_apply
statement: theorem toPMF_apply (x : α) : μ.toPMF x = μ {x}
proof: := rfl

name: toPMF_toMeasure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toPMF_toMeasure : μ.toPMF.toMeasure = μ
proof:
:=
  Measure.ext fun s hs => by
    rw [μ.toPMF.toMeasure_apply hs, ← μ.tsum_indicator_apply_singleton s hs]
    rfl

name: toMeasure_toPMF
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMeasure_toPMF : p.toMeasure.toPMF = p
proof:
:=
  PMF.ext fun x => by
    rw [← p.toMeasure_apply_singleton x (measurableSet_singleton x), p.toMeasure.toPMF_apply]

name: toMeasure_eq_iff_eq_toPMF
statement:
theorem toMeasure_eq_iff_eq_toPMF (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    p.toMeasure = μ ↔ p = μ.toPMF
proof: := by rw [← toMeasure_inj, Measure.toPMF_toMeasure]

name: toPMF_eq_iff_toMeasure_eq
statement:
theorem toPMF_eq_iff_toMeasure_eq (μ : Measure α) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    μ.toPMF = p ↔ μ = p.toMeasure
proof: := by rw [← toMeasure_inj, Measure.toPMF_toMeasure]

name: monad_map_eq_map
statement: theorem monad_map_eq_map {α β : Type u} (f : α → β) (p : PMF α) : f <$> p = p.map f
proof: := rfl

name: map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_apply : (map f p) b = ∑' a, if b = f a then p a else 0
proof: := by simp [map]

name: support_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_map : (map f p).support = f '' p.support
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun b => by simp [map, @eq_comm β b]

name: mem_support_map_iff
statement: theorem mem_support_map_iff : b ∈ (map f p).support ↔ ∃ a ∈ p.support, f a = b
proof: := by simp

name: bind_pure_comp
statement: theorem bind_pure_comp : bind p (pure ∘ f) = map f p
proof: := rfl

name: map_id
statement: theorem map_id : map id p = p
proof:
:=
  bind_pure _

name: map_comp
statement: theorem map_comp (g : β → γ) : (p.map f).map g = p.map (g ∘ f)
proof: := by simp [map, Function.comp_def]

name: pure_map
statement: theorem pure_map (a : α) : (pure a).map f = pure (f a)
proof:
:=
  pure_bind _ _

name: map_bind
statement: theorem map_bind (q : α → PMF β) (f : β → γ) : (p.bind q).map f = p.bind fun a => (q a).map f
proof:
:=
  bind_bind _ _ _

name: bind_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_map (p : PMF α) (f : α → β) (q : β → PMF γ) : (p.map f).bind q = p.bind (q ∘ f)
proof:
:=
  (bind_bind _ _ _).trans (congr_arg _ (funext fun _ => pure_bind _ _))

name: map_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_const : p.map (Function.const α b) = pure b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map, Function.comp_def, bind_const, Function.const]

name: toOuterMeasure_map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toOuterMeasure_map_apply : (p.map f).toOuterMeasure s = p.toOuterMeasure (f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [map, Set.indicator, toOuterMeasure_apply p (f ⁻¹' s)]
  rfl

name: toMeasure_map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMeasure_map_apply (hf : Measurable f)
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) : (p.map f).toMeasure s = p.toMeasure (f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply _ hs,
    toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply _ (measurableSet_preimage hf hs)]
  exact toOuterMeasure_map_apply f p s

name: toMeasure_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toMeasure_map (p : PMF α) (hf : Measurable f) : p.toMeasure.map f = (p.map f).toMeasure
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs : 1; rw [PMF.toMeasure_map_apply _ _ _ hf hs, Measure.map_apply hf hs]

name: monad_seq_eq_seq
statement: theorem monad_seq_eq_seq {α β : Type u} (q : PMF (α → β)) (p : PMF α) : q <*> p = q.seq p
proof: := rfl

name: seq_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem seq_apply : (seq q p) b = ∑' (f : α → β) (a : α), if b = f a then q f * p a else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [seq, mul_boole, bind_apply, pure_apply]
  refine tsum_congr fun f => ENNReal.tsum_mul_left.symm.trans (tsum_congr fun a => ?_)
  simpa only [mul_zero] using mul_ite (b = f a) (q f) (p a) 0

name: support_seq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_seq : (seq q p).support = ⋃ f ∈ q.support, f '' p.support
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun b => by simp [-mem_support_iff, seq, @eq_comm β b]

name: mem_support_seq_iff
statement: theorem mem_support_seq_iff : b ∈ (seq q p).support ↔ ∃ f ∈ q.support, b ∈ f '' p.support
proof: := by simp

name: ofFinset_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofFinset_apply (a : α) : ofFinset f s h h' a = f a
proof: := rfl

name: support_ofFinset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_ofFinset : (ofFinset f s h h').support = ↑s ∩ Function.support f
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun a => by simpa [mem_support_iff] using mt (h' a)

name: mem_support_ofFinset_iff
statement: theorem mem_support_ofFinset_iff (a : α) : a ∈ (ofFinset f s h h').support ↔ a ∈ s ∧ f a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: ofFinset_apply_of_notMem
statement: theorem ofFinset_apply_of_notMem {a : α} (ha : a ∉ s) : ofFinset f s h h' a = 0
proof:
:=
  h' a ha

name: toOuterMeasure_ofFinset_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toOuterMeasure_ofFinset_apply :
    (ofFinset f s h h').toOuterMeasure t = ∑' x, t.indicator f x
proof:
:=
  toOuterMeasure_apply (ofFinset f s h h') t

name: toMeasure_ofFinset_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMeasure_ofFinset_apply [MeasurableSpace α] (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
    (ofFinset f s h h').toMeasure t = ∑' x, t.indicator f x
proof:
:=
  (toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply _ ht).trans (toOuterMeasure_ofFinset_apply h h' t)

name: ofFintype_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofFintype_apply (a : α) : ofFintype f h a = f a
proof: := rfl

name: support_ofFintype

proof: := rfl

name: mem_support_ofFintype_iff
statement: theorem mem_support_ofFintype_iff (a : α) : a ∈ (ofFintype f h).support ↔ f a ≠ 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: map_ofFintype
statement:
@[simp]
lemma map_ofFintype [Fintype β] (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) (h : ∑ a, f a = 1) (g : α → β) :
    (ofFintype f h).map g = ofFintype (fun b ↦ ∑ a with g a = b, f a)
      (by simpa [Finset.sum_fiberwise_eq_sum_filter univ univ g f])
proof:
:= by
  ext b : 1
  simp only [sum_filter, eq_comm, map_apply, ofFintype_apply]
  exact tsum_eq_sum fun _ h ↦ (h <| mem_univ _).elim

name: toOuterMeasure_ofFintype_apply
statement:
@[simp high]
theorem toOuterMeasure_ofFintype_apply : (ofFintype f h).toOuterMeasure s = ∑' x, s.indicator f x
proof:

  toOuterMeasure_apply (ofFintype f h) s

name: toMeasure_ofFintype_apply

theorem toMeasure_ofFintype_apply [MeasurableSpace α] (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (ofFintype f h).toMeasure s = ∑' x, s.indicator f x
proof:
:=
  (toMeasure_apply_eq_toOuterMeasure_apply _ hs).trans (toOuterMeasure_ofFintype_apply h s)

name: normalize_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalize_apply (a : α) : (normalize f hf0 hf) a = f a * (∑' x, f x)⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: support_normalize
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_normalize : (normalize f hf0 hf).support = Function.support f
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun a => by simp [hf, mem_support_iff]

name: mem_support_normalize_iff
statement: theorem mem_support_normalize_iff (a : α) : a ∈ (normalize f hf0 hf).support ↔ f a ≠ 0
proof: := by simp

name: filter_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_apply (a : α) :
    (p.filter s h) a = s.indicator p a * (∑' a', (s.indicator p) a')⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter, normalize_apply]

name: filter_apply_eq_zero_of_notMem
statement: theorem filter_apply_eq_zero_of_notMem {a : α} (ha : a ∉ s) : (p.filter s h) a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_apply, Set.indicator_apply_eq_zero.mpr fun ha' => absurd ha' ha, zero_mul]

name: mem_support_filter_iff
statement: theorem mem_support_filter_iff {a : α} : a ∈ (p.filter s h).support ↔ a ∈ s ∧ a ∈ p.support
proof:
:=
  (mem_support_normalize_iff _ _ _).trans Set.indicator_apply_ne_zero

name: support_filter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_filter : (p.filter s h).support = s ∩ p.support
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun _ => mem_support_filter_iff _

name: filter_apply_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem filter_apply_eq_zero_iff (a : α) : (p.filter s h) a = 0 ↔ a ∉ s ∨ a ∉ p.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [apply_eq_zero_iff, support_filter, Set.mem_inter_iff, not_and_or]

name: filter_apply_ne_zero_iff
statement: theorem filter_apply_ne_zero_iff (a : α) : (p.filter s h) a ≠ 0 ↔ a ∈ s ∧ a ∈ p.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, filter_apply_eq_zero_iff, not_or, Classical.not_not, Classical.not_not]

name: bernoulli_apply
statement:
@[deprecated ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure_apply (since := "2026-04-07")]
theorem bernoulli_apply : bernoulli p h b = cond b p (1 - p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bernoulli, ofFintype_apply]
  exact Eq.symm (Bool.apply_cond ofNNReal)

name: support_bernoulli
statement:
@[deprecated ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure_apply_of_notMem_of_notMem (since := "2026-05-29")]
theorem support_bernoulli : (bernoulli p h).support = { b | cond b (p ≠ 0) (p ≠ 1) }
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ext fun b => ?_
  induction b
  · simp_rw [mem_support_iff, bernoulli_apply, Bool.cond_false, Ne, ENNReal.coe_sub,
      ENNReal.coe_one, Bool.cond_prop, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false,
      not_iff_not]
    constructor
    · intro h'
      simp only [tsub_eq_zero_iff_le, one_le_coe_iff] at h'
      exact eq_of_le_of_ge h h'
    · intro h'
      simp only [h', ENNReal.coe_one, tsub_self]
  · simp only [mem_support_iff, bernoulli_apply, Bool.cond_true, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, ne_eq,
      ENNReal.coe_eq_zero]

name: mem_support_bernoulli_iff
statement:
@[deprecated ProbabilityTheory.bernoulliMeasure_apply_of_notMem_of_notMem (since := "2026-05-29")]
theorem mem_support_bernoulli_iff : b ∈ (bernoulli p h).support ↔ cond b (p ≠ 0) (p ≠ 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [support_bernoulli]

name: binomial_apply
statement:
@[deprecated ProbabilityTheory.binomial_real_singleton (since := "2026-04-07")]
theorem binomial_apply (p : ℝ≥0) (h : p ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    binomial p h n i = p ^ (i : ℕ) * (1 - p) ^ ((Fin.last n - i) : ℕ) * (n.choose i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [binomial]

name: binomial_apply_zero
statement:
@[deprecated ProbabilityTheory.binomial_real_zero (since := "2026-04-07")]
theorem binomial_apply_zero (p : ℝ≥0) (h : p ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    binomial p h n 0 = (1 - p) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [binomial_apply]

name: binomial_apply_last
statement:
@[deprecated ProbabilityTheory.binomial_real_self (since := "2026-04-07")]
theorem binomial_apply_last (p : ℝ≥0) (h : p ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    binomial p h n (.last n) = p ^ n
proof:
:= by
  simp [binomial_apply]

name: binomial_apply_self
statement:
@[deprecated ProbabilityTheory.binomial_real_self (since := "2026-04-07")]
theorem binomial_apply_self (p : ℝ≥0) (h : p ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    binomial p h n (.last n) = p ^ n
proof: := by simp [binomial_apply_last]

name: binomial_one_eq_bernoulli
statement:
@[deprecated ProbabilityTheory.binomial_one_eq_bernoulliMeasure (since := "2026-05-31")]
theorem binomial_one_eq_bernoulli (p : ℝ≥0) (h : p ≤ 1) :
    binomial p h 1 = (bernoulli p h).map (cond · 1 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [binomial_apply, bernoulli_apply]

name: binomial_apply_of_le
statement:
@[deprecated ProbabilityTheory.binomial_singleton (since := "2026-04-07")]
theorem binomial_apply_of_le {k b : ℕ} (hb : k ≤ b) {x : ℝ≥0} (h : x ≤ 1) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((b.choose k) * x ^ k * (1 - x) ^ (b - k))
    = PMF.binomial x h b (Fin.ofNat (b + 1) k)
proof:
:= by
  have eq0 : k % (b + 1) = k := by simpa using Order.lt_add_one_iff.mpr hb
  have eq1 : 1 - (x : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - x : ℝ) := by norm_cast
  have : (1 - (x : ℝ)) ≥ 0 := by simpa
  rwa [Fin.ofNat_eq_cast, PMF.binomial_apply, Fin.val_natCast, Fin.val_last, eq0, eq1,
    coe_nnreal_eq x, mul_rotate, ofReal_mul, ofReal_mul, ofReal_pow, ofReal_pow, ofReal_natCast]
  all_goals positivity

name: toLp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toLpₗ_apply (h_Lp : MemLp id p μ) (L : StrongDual 𝕜 E) :
    L.toLpₗ μ p = MemLp.toLp L (h_Lp.continuousLinearMap_comp L)
proof:
:= by
  simp [toLpₗ, dite_eq_left h_Lp]

name: toLp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toLpₗ_of_not_memLp (h_Lp : ¬ MemLp id p μ) (L : StrongDual 𝕜 E) :
    L.toLpₗ μ p = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [toLpₗ, dite_eq_right h_Lp]

name: norm_toLp
statement:
lemma norm_toLpₗ_le [OpensMeasurableSpace E] (L : StrongDual 𝕜 E) :
    ‖L.toLpₗ μ p‖ ≤ ‖L‖ * (eLpNorm id p μ).toReal
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h_Lp : MemLp id p μ
  swap
  · simp only [h_Lp, not_false_eq_true, toLpₗ_of_not_memLp, Lp.norm_zero]
    positivity
  by_cases hp : p = 0
  · simp only [h_Lp, toLpₗ_apply, Lp.norm_toLp]
    simp [hp]
  by_cases hp_top : p = ∞
  · simp only [hp_top, StrongDual.toLpₗ_apply h_Lp, Lp.norm_toLp, eLpNorm_exponent_top] at h_Lp ⊢
    simp only [eLpNormEssSup, id_eq]
    suffices (essSup (fun x ↦ ‖L x‖ₑ) μ).toReal ≤ (essSup (fun x ↦ ‖L‖ₑ * ‖x‖ₑ) μ).toReal by
      rwa [ENNReal.essSup_const_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul, toReal_enorm] at this
    gcongr
    · rw [ENNReal.essSup_const_mul]
      exact ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) h_Lp.eLpNorm_ne_top
    · exact essSup_mono_ae <| ae_of_all _ L.le_opENorm
  have h0 : 0 < p.toReal := by simp [ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff, pos_iff_ne_zero, hp, Ne.lt_top hp_top]
  suffices ‖L.toLpₗ μ p‖
      ≤ (‖L‖ₑ ^ p.toReal * ∫⁻ x, ‖x‖ₑ ^ p.toReal ∂μ).toReal ^ p.toReal⁻¹ by
    refine this.trans_eq ?_
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul]
    rw [← ENNReal.toReal_rpow, Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity),
      ← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity), mul_inv_cancel₀ h0.ne', Real.rpow_one, toReal_enorm]
    rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by simp [hp]) hp_top, ENNReal.toReal_rpow]
    simp
  rw [StrongDual.toLpₗ_apply h_Lp, Lp.norm_toLp,
    eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by simp [hp]) hp_top]
  simp only [one_div]
  refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (by positivity) ?_
  suffices ∫⁻ x, ‖L x‖ₑ ^ p.toReal ∂μ ≤ ‖L‖ₑ ^ p.toReal * ∫⁻ x, ‖x‖ₑ ^ p.toReal ∂μ by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    gcongr
    rwa [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal]
    refine ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) ?_
    have h := h_Lp.eLpNorm_ne_top
    rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal (by simp [hp]) hp_top] at h
    simpa [h0] using h
  calc ∫⁻ x, ‖L x‖ₑ ^ p.toReal ∂μ
  _ ≤ ∫⁻ x, ‖L‖ₑ ^ p.toReal * ‖x‖ₑ ^ p.toReal ∂μ := by
    refine lintegral_mono fun x ↦ ?_
    rw [← ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg]
    swap; · positivity
    gcongr
    exact L.le_opENorm x
  _ = ‖L‖ₑ ^ p.toReal * ∫⁻ x, ‖x‖ₑ ^ p.toReal ∂μ := by rw [lintegral_const_mul]; fun_prop

name: toLp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toLp_apply [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (h_Lp : MemLp id p μ) (L : StrongDual 𝕜 E) :
    L.toLp μ p = MemLp.toLp L (h_Lp.continuousLinearMap_comp L)
proof:
:= by
  simp [toLp, h_Lp]

name: toLp_of_not_memLp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toLp_of_not_memLp [Fact (1 ≤ p)] (h_Lp : ¬ MemLp id p μ) (L : StrongDual 𝕜 E) :
    L.toLp μ p = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [toLp, h_Lp]

name: uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_apply
statement:
lemma uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_apply (h : MemLp id 2 μ) (L₁ L₂ : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual μ L₁ L₂ = ∫ x, L₁ x * L₂ x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual, ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply,
    StrongDual.toLp_apply h, L2.inner_def, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [MemLp.coeFn_toLp (h.continuousLinearMap_comp L₁),
    MemLp.coeFn_toLp (h.continuousLinearMap_comp L₂)] with x hxL₁ hxL₂
  simp only [id_eq] at hxL₁ hxL₂
  rw [hxL₁, hxL₂, mul_comm]

name: uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_of_not_memLp
statement:
lemma uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_of_not_memLp (h : ¬ MemLp id 2 μ) (L₁ L₂ : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual μ L₁ L₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual, StrongDual.toLp_of_not_memLp h]

name: uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_zero : uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual (0 : Measure E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext
  have : Subsingleton (Lp ℝ 2 (0 : Measure E)) := ⟨fun x y ↦ Lp.ext_iff.2 rfl⟩
  simp [uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual, Subsingleton.eq_zero (StrongDual.toLp 0 2)]

name: norm_uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_le
statement:
lemma norm_uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_le (L₁ L₂ : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    ‖uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual μ L₁ L₂‖ ≤ ‖L₁‖ * ‖L₂‖ * ∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : MemLp id 2 μ
  swap; · simp only [uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_of_not_memLp h, norm_zero]; positivity
  calc ‖uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual μ L₁ L₂‖
  _ = ‖∫ x, L₁ x * L₂ x ∂μ‖ := by rw [uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_apply h]
  _ ≤ ∫ x, ‖L₁ x‖ * ‖L₂ x‖ ∂μ := (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans (by simp)
  _ ≤ ∫ x, ‖L₁‖ * ‖x‖ * ‖L₂‖ * ‖x‖ ∂μ := by
    refine integral_mono_ae ?_ ?_ (ae_of_all _ fun x ↦ ?_)
    · simp_rw [← norm_mul]
      exact (MemLp.integrable_mul (h.continuousLinearMap_comp L₁)
        (h.continuousLinearMap_comp L₂)).norm
    · simp_rw [mul_assoc]
      refine Integrable.const_mul ?_ _
      simp_rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ (‖L₂‖), mul_assoc, ← pow_two]
      refine Integrable.const_mul ?_ _
      exact h.integrable_norm_pow (by simp)
    · simp only
      rw [mul_assoc]
      gcongr
      · exact ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm L₁ x
      · exact ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm L₂ x
  _ = ‖L₁‖ * ‖L₂‖ * ∫ x, ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr with x
    ring

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.memLp_id_of_self_sub_integral
statement:
lemma _root_.MeasureTheory.memLp_id_of_self_sub_integral {p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (h_Lp : MemLp (fun x ↦ x - ∫ y, y ∂μ) p μ) : MemLp id p μ
proof:
:= by
  have : (id : E → E) = fun x ↦ x - ∫ x, x ∂μ + ∫ x, x ∂μ := by ext; simp
  rw [this]
  apply h_Lp.add
  set c := ∫ x, x ∂μ
  /- We need to check that the constant `c = ∫ x, x ∂μ` is in `L^p`. Note that we don't assume
  that `μ` is finite, so this requires an argument. If the constant is zero, it's obvious.
  If it's nonzero, this means that `x` is integrable for `μ` (as otherwise the integral would be
  `0` by our choice of junk value), so `‖x‖ ^ (1/p)` is in `L^p`.
  The constant `c` is controlled by `2 ‖x - c‖` close to `0` (say when `‖x‖ ≤ ‖c‖ / 2`)
  and by a multiple of `‖x‖ ^ (1/p)` away from `0`. Those two functions
  are in `L^p` by assumptions, so the constant `c` also is. -/
  by_cases hx : c = 0
  · simp [hx]
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp0
  · simp [aestronglyMeasurable_const]
  rcases eq_or_ne p ∞ with rfl | hptop
  · exact memLp_top_const c
  apply (integrable_norm_rpow_iff (by fun_prop) hp0 hptop).1
  have I : Integrable (fun (x : E) ↦ ‖x‖) μ := by
    apply Integrable.norm
    contrapose hx
    exact integral_undef hx
  have := (h_Lp.integrable_norm_rpow hp0 hptop).const_mul (2 ^ p.toReal)
  apply (((I.const_mul (2 * ‖c‖ ^ (p.toReal - 1))).add this)).mono' (by fun_prop)
  filter_upwards [] with y
  lift p to ℝ≥0 using hptop
  simp only [ENNReal.coe_toReal, Real.norm_eq_abs, Pi.add_apply]
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  rcases le_total ‖y‖ (‖c‖ / 2)
  · have : ‖c‖ ≤ ‖y‖ + ‖y - c‖ := Eq.trans_le (by abel_nf) (norm_sub_le y (y - c))
    calc ‖c‖ ^ (p : ℝ)
    _ ≤ (2 * ‖y - c‖) ^ (p : ℝ) := by
      gcongr
      linarith
    _ = 0 + 2 ^ (p : ℝ) * ‖y - c‖ ^ (p : ℝ) := by
      rw [Real.mul_rpow (by simp) (by positivity)]
      ring
    _ ≤ 2 * ‖c‖ ^ (p - 1 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ + 2 ^ (p : ℝ) * ‖y - c‖ ^ (p : ℝ) := by
      gcongr
      positivity
  · calc ‖c‖ ^ (p : ℝ)
    _ = ‖c‖ ^ ((p - 1) + 1 : ℝ) := by abel_nf
    _ = ‖c‖ ^ (p - 1 : ℝ) * ‖c‖ := by rw [Real.rpow_add (by positivity), Real.rpow_one]
    _ ≤ ‖c‖ ^ (p - 1 : ℝ) * (2 * ‖y‖) := by gcongr; linarith
    _ = 2 * ‖c‖ ^ (p - 1 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ + 0 := by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * ‖c‖ ^ (p - 1 : ℝ) * ‖y‖ + 2 ^ (p : ℝ) * ‖y - c‖ ^ (p : ℝ) := by gcongr; positivity

name: covarianceBilinDual_of_not_memLp'
statement:
lemma covarianceBilinDual_of_not_memLp' (h : ¬ MemLp (fun x ↦ x - ∫ y, y ∂μ) 2 μ)
    (L₁ L₂ : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    covarianceBilinDual μ L₁ L₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [covarianceBilinDual, uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_of_not_memLp]
  rw [(measurableEmbedding_subRight _).memLp_map_measure_iff]
  exact h

name: covarianceBilinDual_of_not_memLp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma covarianceBilinDual_of_not_memLp (h : ¬ MemLp id 2 μ) (L₁ L₂ : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    covarianceBilinDual μ L₁ L₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply covarianceBilinDual_of_not_memLp'
  contrapose h
  exact memLp_id_of_self_sub_integral h

name: covarianceBilinDual_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma covarianceBilinDual_zero : covarianceBilinDual (0 : Measure E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [covarianceBilinDual, Measure.map_zero, uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_zero]

name: covarianceBilinDual_comm
statement:
lemma covarianceBilinDual_comm (L₁ L₂ : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    covarianceBilinDual μ L₁ L₂ = covarianceBilinDual μ L₂ L₁
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : MemLp (fun x ↦ x - ∫ y, y ∂μ) 2 μ
  · have h' : MemLp id 2 (Measure.map (fun x ↦ x - ∫ (x : E), x ∂μ) μ) :=
      (measurableEmbedding_subRight _).memLp_map_measure_iff.mpr <| h
    simp_rw [covarianceBilinDual, uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_apply h', mul_comm (L₁ _)]
  · simp [h, covarianceBilinDual_of_not_memLp']

name: covarianceBilinDual_self_nonneg
statement:
@[simp]
lemma covarianceBilinDual_self_nonneg (L : StrongDual ℝ E) : 0 ≤ covarianceBilinDual μ L L
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : MemLp id 2 μ
  · simp only [covarianceBilinDual, uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual,
      ContinuousLinearMap.bilinearComp_apply, IsBoundedBilinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap_apply]
    exact real_inner_self_nonneg
  · simp [h]

name: isPosSemidef_covarianceBilinDual
statement:
lemma isPosSemidef_covarianceBilinDual : (covarianceBilinDual μ).toBilinForm.IsPosSemidef where
  eq
proof:
:= covarianceBilinDual_comm
  nonneg := covarianceBilinDual_self_nonneg

name: covarianceBilinDual_apply
statement:
lemma covarianceBilinDual_apply (h : MemLp id 2 μ) (L₁ L₂ : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    covarianceBilinDual μ L₁ L₂ = ∫ x, (L₁ x - μ[L₁]) * (L₂ x - μ[L₂]) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [covarianceBilinDual, uncenteredCovarianceBilinDual_apply,
    integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  · have hL (L : StrongDual ℝ E) : μ[L] = L (∫ x, x ∂μ) :=
      L.integral_comp_comm (h.integrable (by simp))
    simp [← hL]
  · exact (measurableEmbedding_subRight _).memLp_map_measure_iff.mpr <| h.sub (memLp_const _)

name: covarianceBilinDual_apply'
statement:
lemma covarianceBilinDual_apply' (h : MemLp id 2 μ) (L₁ L₂ : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    covarianceBilinDual μ L₁ L₂ = ∫ x, L₁ (x - μ[id]) * L₂ (x - μ[id]) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [covarianceBilinDual_apply h]
  have hL (L : StrongDual ℝ E) : μ[L] = L (∫ x, x ∂μ) :=
    L.integral_comp_comm (h.integrable (by simp))
  simp [← hL]

name: covarianceBilinDual_eq_covariance
statement:
lemma covarianceBilinDual_eq_covariance (h : MemLp id 2 μ) (L₁ L₂ : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    covarianceBilinDual μ L₁ L₂ = cov[L₁, L₂; μ]
proof:
:= by
  rw [covarianceBilinDual_apply h, covariance]

name: covarianceBilinDual_self_eq_variance
statement:
lemma covarianceBilinDual_self_eq_variance (h : MemLp id 2 μ) (L : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    covarianceBilinDual μ L L = Var[L; μ]
proof:
:= by
  rw [covarianceBilinDual_eq_covariance h, covariance_self (by fun_prop)]

name: aestronglyMeasurable
statement:
lemma aestronglyMeasurable (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable X (κ ∘ₘ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have h_int := h.integrable_exp_mul 1
  simpa using (aemeasurable_of_aemeasurable_exp h_int.1.aemeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable

name: ae_integrable_exp_mul
statement:
lemma ae_integrable_exp_mul (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) (t : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, Integrable (fun y ↦ exp (t * X y)) (κ ω')
proof:
:=
  Measure.ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp (h.integrable_exp_mul t)

name: ae_aestronglyMeasurable
statement:
lemma ae_aestronglyMeasurable (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) :
    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, AEStronglyMeasurable X (κ ω')
proof:
:= by
  have h_int := h.ae_integrable_exp_mul 1
  filter_upwards [h_int] with ω h_int
  simpa using (aemeasurable_of_aemeasurable_exp h_int.1.aemeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable

name: ae_forall_integrable_exp_mul
statement:
lemma ae_forall_integrable_exp_mul (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) :
    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, ∀ t, Integrable (fun ω ↦ exp (t * X ω)) (κ ω')
proof:
:= by
  have h_int (n : ℤ) : ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, Integrable (fun ω ↦ exp (n * X ω)) (κ ω') :=
    h.ae_integrable_exp_mul _
  rw [← ae_all_iff] at h_int
  filter_upwards [h_int] with ω' h_int t
  exact integrable_exp_mul_of_le_of_le (h_int _) (h_int _) (Int.floor_le t) (Int.le_ceil t)

name: ae_forall_memLp_exp_mul
statement:
lemma ae_forall_memLp_exp_mul (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) (p : ℝ≥0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, ∀ t, MemLp (fun ω ↦ exp (t * X ω)) p (κ ω')
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h.ae_forall_integrable_exp_mul] with ω' hi t
  constructor
  · exact (hi t).1
  · by_cases hp : p = 0
    · simp [hp]
    rw [eLpNorm_lt_top_iff_lintegral_rpow_enorm_lt_top (mod_cast hp) (by simp),
      ENNReal.coe_toReal]
    have hf := (hi (p * t)).lintegral_lt_top
    convert! hf using 3 with ω
    rw [enorm_eq_ofReal (by positivity), ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (by positivity),
      ← exp_mul, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc]
    positivity

name: memLp_exp_mul
statement:
lemma memLp_exp_mul (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) (t : ℝ) (p : ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp (fun ω ↦ exp (t * X ω)) p (κ ∘ₘ ν)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp0 : p = 0
  · simpa [hp0] using (h.integrable_exp_mul t).1
  constructor
  · exact (h.integrable_exp_mul t).1
  · rw [eLpNorm_lt_top_iff_lintegral_rpow_enorm_lt_top (mod_cast hp0) (by simp)]
    simp only [ENNReal.coe_toReal]
    have h' := (h.integrable_exp_mul (p * t)).2
    rw [hasFiniteIntegral_def] at h'
    convert! h' using 3 with ω
    rw [enorm_eq_ofReal (by positivity), enorm_eq_ofReal (by positivity),
      ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (by positivity), ← exp_mul, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc]
    positivity

name: cgf_le
statement:
lemma cgf_le (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) :
    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, ∀ t, cgf X (κ ω') t ≤ c * t ^ 2 / 2
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h.mgf_le, h.ae_forall_integrable_exp_mul] with ω' h h_int t
  calc cgf X (κ ω') t
  _ = log (mgf X (κ ω') t) := rfl
  _ ≤ log (exp (c * t ^ 2 / 2)) := by
    by_cases h0 : κ ω' = 0
    · simpa [h0] using by positivity
    gcongr
    · exact mgf_pos' h0 (h_int t)
    · exact h t
  _ ≤ c * t ^ 2 / 2 := by rw [log_exp]

name: isFiniteMeasure
statement:
lemma isFiniteMeasure (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) :
    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, IsFiniteMeasure (κ ω')
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h.ae_integrable_exp_mul 0, h.mgf_le] with ω' h h_mgf
  simpa [integrable_const_iff] using h

name: measure_univ_le_one
statement:
lemma measure_univ_le_one (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) :
    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, κ ω' Set.univ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h.isFiniteMeasure, h.mgf_le] with ω' h h_mgf
  suffices (κ ω').real Set.univ ≤ 1 by
    rwa [← ENNReal.ofReal_one, ENNReal.le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le (measure_ne_top _ _) zero_le_one]
  simpa [mgf] using h_mgf 0

name: of_rat
statement:
protected lemma of_rat (h_int : ∀ t : ℝ, Integrable (fun ω ↦ exp (t * X ω)) (κ ∘ₘ ν))
    (h_mgf : ∀ q : ℚ, ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, mgf X (κ ω') q ≤ exp (c * q ^ 2 / 2)) :
    Kernel.HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν where
  integrable_exp_mul
proof:
:= h_int
  mgf_le := by
    rw [← ae_all_iff] at h_mgf
    have h_int : ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, ∀ t, Integrable (fun ω ↦ exp (t * X ω)) (κ ω') := by
      have h_int' (n : ℤ) := Measure.ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp (h_int n)
      rw [← ae_all_iff] at h_int'
      filter_upwards [h_int'] with ω' h_int t
      exact integrable_exp_mul_of_le_of_le (h_int _) (h_int _) (Int.floor_le t) (Int.le_ceil t)
    filter_upwards [h_mgf, h_int] with ω' h_mgf h_int t
    refine Rat.denseRange_cast.induction_on t ?_ h_mgf
    exact isClosed_le (continuous_mgf h_int) (by fun_prop)

name: fun_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fun_zero [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsZeroOrMarkovKernel κ] :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun _ ↦ 0) 0 κ ν where
  integrable_exp_mul
proof:
:= by simp
  mgf_le := by simp

name: zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsZeroOrMarkovKernel κ] : HasSubgaussianMGF 0 0 κ ν
proof: := fun_zero

name: zero_kernel
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_kernel : HasSubgaussianMGF X c (0 : Kernel Ω' Ω) ν
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp [FunLike.coe_zero]
  · simp [exp_nonneg]

name: zero_measure
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_measure : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ (0 : Measure Ω')
proof: := ⟨by simp, by simp⟩

name: neg
statement:
lemma neg {c : ℝ≥0} (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) : HasSubgaussianMGF (-X) c κ ν where
  integrable_exp_mul t
proof:
:= by simpa using h.integrable_exp_mul (-t)
  mgf_le := by filter_upwards [h.mgf_le] with ω' hm t using by simpa [mgf] using hm (-t)

name: congr
statement:
lemma congr {Y : Ω → ℝ} (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) (h' : X =ᵐ[κ ∘ₘ ν] Y) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF Y c κ ν where
  integrable_exp_mul t
proof:
:= by
    refine (integrable_congr ?_).mpr (h.integrable_exp_mul t)
    filter_upwards [h'] with ω hω using by rw [hω]
  mgf_le := by
    have h'' := Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_comp h'
    filter_upwards [h.mgf_le, h''] with ω' h_mgf h' t
    rw [mgf_congr (Filter.EventuallyEq.symm h')]
    exact h_mgf t

name: _root_.ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.HasSubgaussianMGF_congr
statement:
lemma _root_.ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.HasSubgaussianMGF_congr {Y : Ω → ℝ} (h : X =ᵐ[κ ∘ₘ ν] Y) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν ↔ HasSubgaussianMGF Y c κ ν
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hX ↦ congr hX h, fun hY ↦ congr hY (ae_eq_symm h)⟩

name: of_map
statement:
lemma of_map {Ω'' : Type*} {mΩ'' : MeasurableSpace Ω''} {κ : Kernel Ω' Ω''}
    {Y : Ω'' → Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} (hY : Measurable Y) (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c (κ.map Y) ν) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (X ∘ Y) c κ ν where
  integrable_exp_mul t
proof:
:= by
    have h1 := h.integrable_exp_mul t
    rwa [← Measure.map_comp _ _ hY, integrable_map_measure h1.aestronglyMeasurable (by fun_prop)]
      at h1
  mgf_le := by
    filter_upwards [h.ae_forall_integrable_exp_mul, h.mgf_le] with ω' h_int h_mgf t
    convert! h_mgf t
    ext t
    rw [map_apply _ hY, mgf_map hY.aemeasurable]
    convert! (h_int t).1
    rw [map_apply _ hY]

name: id_map_iff
statement:
lemma id_map_iff (hX : Measurable X) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF id c (κ.map X) ν ↔ HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨fun t ↦ ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · change HasSubgaussianMGF (id ∘ X) c κ ν
    exact .of_map hX h
  · rw [← Kernel.deterministic_comp_eq_map hX, ← Measure.comp_assoc,
      Measure.deterministic_comp_eq_map, integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hX.aemeasurable]
    exact h.integrable_exp_mul t
  · simpa [Kernel.map_apply _ hX, mgf_id_map hX.aemeasurable] using h.mgf_le

name: const_mul
statement:
protected lemma const_mul (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) (r : ℝ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ r * X ω) (.mk (r ^ 2) (sq_nonneg r) * c) κ ν where
  integrable_exp_mul t
proof:
:= by
    simp_rw [← mul_assoc]
    exact h.integrable_exp_mul (t * r)
  mgf_le := by
    filter_upwards [h.mgf_le] with ω hω t
    rw [mgf_const_mul, mul_comm]
    refine (hω (t * r)).trans_eq ?_
    congr 1
    simp only [NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_mk]
    ring

name: measure_ge_le_exp_add
statement:
lemma measure_ge_le_exp_add (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) (ε : ℝ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → (κ ω').real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ≤ exp (-t * ε + c * t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h.mgf_le, h.ae_forall_integrable_exp_mul, h.isFiniteMeasure] with ω' h1 h2 _ t ht
  calc (κ ω').real {ω | ε ≤ X ω}
  _ ≤ exp (-t * ε) * mgf X (κ ω') t := measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf ε ht (h2 t)
  _ ≤ exp (-t * ε + c * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
    rw [exp_add]
    gcongr
    exact h1 t

name: measure_ge_le
statement:
lemma measure_ge_le (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, (κ ω').real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ≤ exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * c))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc0 : c = 0
  · filter_upwards [h.measure_univ_le_one] with ω' h
    simp only [hc0, NNReal.coe_zero, mul_zero, div_zero, exp_zero]
    refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal zero_le_one ?_
    simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    exact (measure_mono (Set.subset_univ _)).trans h
  filter_upwards [measure_ge_le_exp_add h ε] with ω' h
  calc (κ ω').real {ω | ε ≤ X ω}
  
  _ ≤ exp (-(ε / c) * ε + c * (ε / c) ^ 2 / 2) := h (ε / c) (by positivity)
  _ = exp (- ε ^ 2 / (2 * c)) := by congr; field

name: measure_pos_eq_zero_of_hasSubGaussianMGF_zero
statement:
lemma measure_pos_eq_zero_of_hasSubGaussianMGF_zero (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X 0 κ ν) :
    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, (κ ω') {ω | 0 < X ω} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : {ω | 0 < X ω} = ⋃ ε : {ε : ℚ // 0 < ε}, {ω | ε ≤ X ω} := by
    ext ω
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Subtype.exists, exists_prop]
    constructor
    · intro hp
      obtain ⟨q, h1, h2⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hp
      exact ⟨q, (q.cast_pos.1 h1), h2.le⟩
    · intro ⟨q, h1, h2⟩
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (q.cast_pos.2 h1) h2
  have hb (ε : ℚ) : ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, 0 < ε → (κ ω') {ω | ε ≤ X ω} = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [h.measure_ge_le_exp_add ε, h.isFiniteMeasure] with ω' hm _ hε
    simp only [neg_mul, NNReal.coe_zero, zero_mul, zero_div, add_zero] at hm
    suffices (κ ω').real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} = 0 by simpa [Measure.real, ENNReal.toReal_eq_zero_iff]
    have hl : Filter.Tendsto (fun t ↦ rexp (-(t * ε))) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      apply tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero.comp
      exact Filter.Tendsto.atTop_mul_const (ε.cast_pos.2 hε) (fun _ a ↦ a)
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact ge_of_tendsto hl (Filter.eventually_atTop.2 ⟨0, hm⟩)
    · exact measureReal_nonneg
  /- `ν`-almost everywhere, `{ω | 0 < X ω}` is a countable union of `κ ω'`-null sets. -/
  filter_upwards [ae_all_iff.2 hb] with ω' hn
  simp only [hs, measure_iUnion_null_iff, Subtype.forall]
  exact fun _ ↦ hn _

name: ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero
statement:
lemma ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X 0 κ ν) :
    ∀ᵐ ω' ∂ν, X =ᵐ[κ ω'] 0
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(h.neg).measure_pos_eq_zero_of_hasSubGaussianMGF_zero,
    h.measure_pos_eq_zero_of_hasSubGaussianMGF_zero]
  intro ω' h1 h2
  simp_rw [Pi.neg_apply, Left.neg_pos_iff] at h1
  apply nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1
  calc (κ ω') {ω | X ω ≠ 0}
  _ = (κ ω') {ω | X ω < 0 ∨ 0 < X ω} := by simp_rw [ne_iff_lt_or_gt]
  _ ≤ (κ ω') {ω | X ω < 0} + (κ ω') {ω | 0 < X ω} := measure_union_le _ _
  _ = 0 := by simp [h1, h2]

name: ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero_of_measurable
statement:
lemma ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero_of_measurable
    (hX : Measurable X) (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X 0 κ ν) :
    X =ᵐ[κ ∘ₘ ν] 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, Measure.ae_comp_iff (measurableSet_eq_fun hX (by fun_prop))]
  exact h.ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero

name: ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero'
statement:
lemma ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero' (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X 0 κ ν) :
    X =ᵐ[κ ∘ₘ ν] 0
proof:
:= by
  have hX := h.aestronglyMeasurable
  have h' : HasSubgaussianMGF (hX.mk X) 0 κ ν := h.congr hX.ae_eq_mk
  exact hX.ae_eq_mk.trans (ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero_of_measurable hX.measurable_mk h')

name: add
statement:
lemma add {Y : Ω → ℝ} {cX cY : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X cX κ ν)
    (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY κ ν) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ X ω + Y ω) ((cX.sqrt + cY.sqrt) ^ 2) κ ν
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hX0 : cX = 0
  · simp only [hX0, NNReal.sqrt_zero, zero_add, NNReal.sq_sqrt] at hX ⊢
    refine hY.congr ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero' hX] with ω hX0 using by simp [hX0]
  by_cases hY0 : cY = 0
  · simp only [hY0, NNReal.sqrt_zero, add_zero, NNReal.sq_sqrt] at hY ⊢
    refine hX.congr ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_eq_zero_of_hasSubgaussianMGF_zero' hY] with ω hY0 using by simp [hY0]
  exact
  { integrable_exp_mul t := by
      simp_rw [mul_add, exp_add]
      convert! MemLp.integrable_mul (hX.memLp_exp_mul t 2) (hY.memLp_exp_mul t 2)
      norm_cast
      infer_instance
    mgf_le := by
      let p := (cX.sqrt + cY.sqrt) / cX.sqrt
      let q := (cX.sqrt + cY.sqrt) / cY.sqrt
      filter_upwards [hX.mgf_le, hY.mgf_le, hX.ae_forall_memLp_exp_mul p,
        hY.ae_forall_memLp_exp_mul q] with ω' hmX hmY hlX hlY t
      calc (κ ω')[fun ω ↦ exp (t * (X ω + Y ω))]
      _ ≤ (κ ω')[fun ω ↦ exp (t * X ω) ^ (p : ℝ)] ^ (1 / (p : ℝ)) *
          (κ ω')[fun ω ↦ exp (t * Y ω) ^ (q : ℝ)] ^ (1 / (q : ℝ)) := by
        simp_rw [mul_add, exp_add]
        apply integral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq_of_nonneg
        · exact ⟨by simp [field, p, q], by positivity, by positivity⟩
        · exact ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ exp_nonneg _
        · exact ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ exp_nonneg _
        · simpa using (hlX t)
        · simpa using (hlY t)
      _ ≤ exp (cX * (t * p) ^ 2 / 2) ^ (1 / (p : ℝ)) *
          exp (cY * (t * q) ^ 2 / 2) ^ (1 / (q : ℝ)) := by
        simp_rw [← exp_mul _ p, ← exp_mul _ q, mul_right_comm t _ p, mul_right_comm t _ q]
        gcongr
        · exact hmX (t * p)
        · exact hmY (t * q)
      _ = exp ((cX.sqrt + cY.sqrt) ^ 2 * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
        simp_rw [← exp_mul, ← exp_add]
        simp only [NNReal.coe_div, NNReal.coe_add, coe_sqrt, one_div, inv_div, exp_eq_exp, p, q]
        field_simp
        linear_combination t ^ 2 * (-√↑cY * Real.sq_sqrt cX.coe_nonneg
            -√↑cX * Real.sq_sqrt cY.coe_nonneg) }

name: prodMkLeft_compProd
statement:
lemma prodMkLeft_compProd {η : Kernel Ω Ω''} (h : HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY η (κ ∘ₘ ν)) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY (prodMkLeft Ω' η) (ν ⊗ₘ κ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hν : SFinite ν
  swap; · simp [hν]
  by_cases hκ : IsSFiniteKernel κ
  swap; · simp [hκ]
  constructor
  · simpa using h.integrable_exp_mul
  · have h2 := h.mgf_le
    rw [← Measure.snd_compProd, Measure.snd] at h2
    exact ae_of_ae_map (by fun_prop) h2

name: integrable_exp_add_compProd
statement:
lemma integrable_exp_add_compProd {η : Kernel (Ω' × Ω) Ω''} [IsZeroOrMarkovKernel η]
    (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY η (ν ⊗ₘ κ)) (t : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω ↦ exp (t * (X ω.1 + Y ω.2))) ((κ ⊗ₖ η) ∘ₘ ν)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hκ : IsSFiniteKernel κ
  swap; · simp [FunLike.coe_zero, hκ]
  rcases eq_zero_or_isMarkovKernel η with rfl | hη
  · simp [FunLike.coe_zero]
  simp_rw [mul_add, exp_add]
  refine MemLp.integrable_mul (p := 2) (q := 2) ?_ ?_
  · have h := hX.memLp_exp_mul t 2
    simp only [ENNReal.coe_ofNat] at h
    have : κ ∘ₘ ν = ((κ ⊗ₖ η) ∘ₘ ν).map Prod.fst := by
      rw [Measure.map_comp _ _ measurable_fst, ← fst_eq, fst_compProd]
    rwa [this, memLp_map_measure_iff h.1 measurable_fst.aemeasurable] at h
  · have h := hY.memLp_exp_mul t 2
    rwa [ENNReal.coe_ofNat, Measure.comp_compProd_comm, Measure.snd,
      memLp_map_measure_iff h.1 measurable_snd.aemeasurable] at h

name: add_compProd
statement:
lemma add_compProd {η : Kernel (Ω' × Ω) Ω''} [IsZeroOrMarkovKernel η]
    (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY η (ν ⊗ₘ κ)) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun p ↦ X p.1 + Y p.2) (c + cY) (κ ⊗ₖ η) ν
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hκ : IsSFiniteKernel κ
  swap; · simp [hκ]
  refine .of_rat (integrable_exp_add_compProd hX hY) fun q ↦ ?_
  filter_upwards [hX.mgf_le, hX.ae_integrable_exp_mul q, Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_compProd hY.mgf_le,
    Measure.ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp <| integrable_exp_add_compProd hX hY q]
    with ω' hX_mgf hX_int hY_mgf h_int_mul
  calc mgf (fun p ↦ X p.1 + Y p.2) ((κ ⊗ₖ η) ω') q
  _ = ∫ x, exp (q * X x) * ∫ y, exp (q * Y y) ∂(η (ω', x)) ∂(κ ω') := by
    simp_rw [mgf, mul_add, exp_add] at h_int_mul ⊢
    simp_rw [integral_compProd h_int_mul, integral_const_mul]
  _ ≤ ∫ x, exp (q * X x) * exp (cY * q ^ 2 / 2) ∂(κ ω') := by
    refine integral_mono_of_nonneg ?_ (hX_int.mul_const _) ?_
    · exact ae_of_all _ fun ω ↦ mul_nonneg (by positivity)
        (integral_nonneg (fun _ ↦ by positivity))
    · filter_upwards [all_ae_of hY_mgf q] with ω hY_mgf
      gcongr
      exact hY_mgf
  _ ≤ exp (↑(c + cY) * q ^ 2 / 2) := by
    rw [integral_mul_const, NNReal.coe_add, add_mul, add_div, exp_add]
    gcongr
    exact hX_mgf q

name: add_comp
statement:
lemma add_comp {η : Kernel Ω Ω''} [IsZeroOrMarkovKernel η]
    (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X c κ ν) (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY η (κ ∘ₘ ν)) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun p ↦ X p.1 + Y p.2) (c + cY) (κ ⊗ₖ prodMkLeft Ω' η) ν
proof:
:=
  hX.add_compProd hY.prodMkLeft_compProd

name: of_map
statement:
lemma of_map {Ω' : Type*} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {μ : Measure Ω'}
    {Y : Ω' → Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} (hY : AEMeasurable Y μ) (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c (μ.map Y)) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (X ∘ Y) c μ where
  integrable_exp_mul t

lemma id_map_iff (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) :

:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨fun t ↦ ?_, fun t ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [← Function.id_comp X]
    exact .of_map hX h
  · rw [integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) hX]
    exact h.integrable_exp_mul t
  · rw [mgf_id_map hX]
    exact h.mgf_le t

name: congr_identDistrib
proof:

name: add
statement:
lemma add {Y : Ω → ℝ} {cX cY : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X cX μ)
    (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY μ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ X ω + Y ω) ((cX.sqrt + cY.sqrt) ^ 2) μ
proof:
:= by
  have := (HasSubgaussianMGF_iff_kernel.1 hX).add (HasSubgaussianMGF_iff_kernel.1 hY)
  simpa [HasSubgaussianMGF_iff_kernel] using this

name: add_of_indepFun
statement:
lemma add_of_indepFun {Y : Ω → ℝ} {cX cY : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X cX μ)
    (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY μ) (hindep : X ⟂ᵢ[μ] Y) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ X ω + Y ω) (cX + cY) μ where
  integrable_exp_mul t
proof:
:= by
    simp_rw [mul_add, exp_add]
    convert! MemLp.integrable_mul (hX.memLp_exp_mul t 2) (hY.memLp_exp_mul t 2)
    norm_cast
    infer_instance
  mgf_le t := by
    calc mgf (X + Y) μ t
    _ = mgf X μ t * mgf Y μ t :=
      hindep.mgf_add (hX.integrable_exp_mul t).1 (hY.integrable_exp_mul t).1
    _ ≤ exp (cX * t ^ 2 / 2) * exp (cY * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
      gcongr
      · exact mgf_nonneg
      · exact hX.mgf_le t
      · exact hY.mgf_le t
    _ = exp ((cX + cY) * t ^ 2 / 2) := by rw [← exp_add]; congr; ring

name: sub_of_indepFun
statement:
lemma sub_of_indepFun {Y : Ω → ℝ} {cX cY : ℝ≥0} (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X cX μ)
    (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY μ) (hindep : X ⟂ᵢ[μ] Y) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ X ω - Y ω) (cX + cY) μ
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  exact hX.add_of_indepFun hY.neg hindep.neg_right

name: sum_of_iIndepFun_of_forall_aemeasurable
statement:
private lemma sum_of_iIndepFun_of_forall_aemeasurable
    {ι : Type*} {X : ι → Ω → ℝ} (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ) {c : ι → ℝ≥0}
    (h_meas : ∀ i, AEMeasurable (X i) μ)
    {s : Finset ι} (h_subG : ∀ i ∈ s, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) (c i) μ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω) (∑ i ∈ s, c i) μ
proof:
:= by
  have : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := h_indep.isProbabilityMeasure
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s his h =>
    simp_rw [← Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_insert his, Pi.add_apply, Finset.sum_apply]
    have h_indep' := (h_indep.indepFun_finsetSum_of_notMem₀ h_meas his).symm
    refine add_of_indepFun (h_subG _ (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) (h ?_) ?_
    · exact fun i hi ↦ h_subG _ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    · convert! h_indep'
      rw [Finset.sum_apply]

name: sum_of_iIndepFun
proof:
:= by
  have : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ ∑ (i : s), X i ω) (∑ (i : s), c i) μ := by
    apply sum_of_iIndepFun_of_forall_aemeasurable
    · exact h_indep.precomp Subtype.val_injective
    · exact fun i ↦ (h_subG i i.2).aemeasurable
    · exact fun i _ ↦ h_subG i i.2
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort] at this
  exact this.congr (ae_of_all _ fun ω ↦ Finset.sum_attach s (fun i ↦ X i ω))

name: measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun
statement:
lemma measure_sum_ge_le_of_iIndepFun {ι : Type*} {X : ι → Ω → ℝ} (h_indep : iIndepFun X μ)
    {c : ι → ℝ≥0}
    {s : Finset ι} (h_subG : ∀ i ∈ s, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) (c i) μ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, X i ω} ≤ exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ∑ i ∈ s, c i))
proof:
:=
  (sum_of_iIndepFun h_indep h_subG).measure_ge_le hε

name: measure_sum_range_ge_le_of_iIndepFun
proof:
:= by
  have h := (sum_of_iIndepFun h_indep (c := fun _ ↦ c)
    (s := Finset.range n) (by simpa)).measure_ge_le hε
  simpa [← mul_assoc] using h

name: measureReal_le_le_exp
statement:
lemma measureReal_le_le_exp {Y : Ω → ℝ} {cX cY : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ X ω - μ[X]) cX μ)
    (hY : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ Y ω - μ[Y]) cY μ)
    (hindep : IndepFun X Y μ) (h_le : μ[Y] ≤ μ[X]) :
    μ.real {ω | X ω ≤ Y ω} ≤ Real.exp (- (μ[Y] - μ[X]) ^ 2 / (2 * (cX + cY)))
proof:
:= by
  calc μ.real {ω | X ω ≤ Y ω}
  _ = μ.real {ω | (μ[X] - μ[Y]) ≤ (Y ω - μ[Y]) - (X ω - μ[X])} := by
    congr with ω
    grind
  _ ≤ Real.exp (- (μ[Y] - μ[X]) ^ 2 / (2 * (cX + cY))) := by
    refine (measure_ge_le (X := fun ω ↦ (Y ω - μ[Y]) - (X ω - μ[X])) (c := cX + cY) ?_ ?_).trans_eq
      ?_
    · rw [add_comm cX]
      refine sub_of_indepFun hY hX ?_
      exact hindep.symm.comp (φ := fun x ↦ x - μ[Y]) (ψ := fun x ↦ x - μ[X])
        (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    · grind
    · congr 2
      grind

name: mgf_le_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hi (u : ℝ) : Integrable (fun ω ↦ exp (u * X ω)) μ := integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc hm hb
  have hs : Set.Icc 0 t ⊆ interior (integrableExpSet X μ) := by simp [hi, integrableExpSet]
  obtain ⟨u, h1, h2⟩ := exists_cgf_eq_iteratedDeriv_two_cgf_mul ht hc hs
  rw [← exp_cgf (hi t), exp_le_exp, h2]
  gcongr
  calc
  _ = Var[X; μ.tilted (u * X ·)] := by
    rw [← variance_tilted_mul (hs (Set.mem_Icc_of_Ioo h1))]
  _ ≤ ((b - a) / 2) ^ 2 := by
    convert! variance_le_sq_of_bounded ((tilted_absolutelyContinuous μ (u * X ·)) hb) _
    · exact isProbabilityMeasure_tilted (hi u)
    · exact hm.mono_ac (tilted_absolutelyContinuous μ (u * X ·))
  _ = (‖b - a‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 := by simp [field]

name: hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero
statement:
lemma hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ}
    (hm : AEMeasurable X μ) (hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ∈ Set.Icc a b) (hc : μ[X] = 0) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF X ((‖b - a‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) μ where
  integrable_exp_mul t
proof:
:= integrable_exp_mul_of_mem_Icc hm hb
  mgf_le t := by
    obtain ht | ht | ht := lt_trichotomy 0 t
    · exact ProbabilityTheory.mgf_le_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero hm hb hc ht
    · simp [← ht]
    calc
    _ = mgf (-X) μ (-t) := by simp [mgf]
    _ ≤ exp ((‖-a - -b‖₊ / 2) ^ 2 * (-t) ^ 2 / 2) := by
      apply ProbabilityTheory.mgf_le_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero (hm.neg)
      · filter_upwards [hb] with ω ⟨hl, hr⟩ using ⟨neg_le_neg_iff.2 hr, neg_le_neg_iff.2 hl⟩
      · simp only [Pi.neg_apply]; rw [integral_neg, hc, neg_zero]
      · rwa [Left.neg_pos_iff]
    _ = exp (((‖b - a‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) * t ^ 2 / 2) := by ring_nf

name: hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc
statement:
lemma hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {a b : ℝ} (hm : AEMeasurable X μ)
    (hb : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, X ω ∈ Set.Icc a b) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ X ω - μ[X]) ((‖b - a‖₊ / 2) ^ 2) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_sub_sub_cancel_right b a μ[X]]
  apply hasSubgaussianMGF_of_mem_Icc_of_integral_eq_zero (hm.sub_const _)
  · filter_upwards [hb] with ω hab using by simpa using hab
  · simp [integral_sub (Integrable.of_mem_Icc a b hm hb) (integrable_const _)]

name: HasSubgaussianMGF.add_of_hasCondSubgaussianMGF
statement:
lemma HasSubgaussianMGF.add_of_hasCondSubgaussianMGF [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {Y : Ω → ℝ} {cX cY : ℝ≥0} (hm : m ≤ mΩ)
    (hX : HasSubgaussianMGF X cX (μ.trim hm)) (hY : HasCondSubgaussianMGF m hm Y cY μ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (X + Y) (cX + cY) μ
proof:
:= by
  suffices HasSubgaussianMGF (fun p ↦ X p.1 + Y p.2) (cX + cY)
      (@Measure.map Ω (Ω × Ω) mΩ (m.prod mΩ) Function.diag μ) by
    have h_eq : X + Y = (fun p ↦ X p.1 + Y p.2) ∘ Function.diag := rfl
    rw [h_eq]
    refine HasSubgaussianMGF.of_map ?_ this
    exact @Measurable.aemeasurable _ _ _ (m.prod mΩ) _ _
      ((measurable_id'' hm).prodMk measurable_id)
  rw [HasSubgaussianMGF_iff_kernel] at hX ⊢
  have hY' : Kernel.HasSubgaussianMGF Y cY (condExpKernel μ m)
      (Kernel.const Unit (μ.trim hm) ∘ₘ Measure.dirac ()) := by simpa
  convert! hX.add_comp hY'
  ext
  rw [Kernel.const_apply, ← Measure.compProd, compProd_trim_condExpKernel]

name: HasSubgaussianMGF.sum_of_hasCondSubgaussianMGF
statement:
lemma HasSubgaussianMGF.sum_of_hasCondSubgaussianMGF [IsZeroOrProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h_adapted : StronglyAdapted ℱ Y) (h0 : HasSubgaussianMGF (Y 0) (cY 0) μ) (n : ℕ)
    (h_subG : ∀ i < n - 1, HasCondSubgaussianMGF (ℱ i) (ℱ.le i) (Y (i + 1)) (cY (i + 1)) μ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω ↦ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Y i ω) (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, cY i) μ
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [h0]
    | succ n =>
      specialize hn fun i hi ↦ h_subG i (by lia)
      simp_rw [Finset.sum_range_succ _ (n + 1)]
      refine HasSubgaussianMGF.add_of_hasCondSubgaussianMGF (ℱ.le n) ?_ (h_subG n (by lia))
      refine HasSubgaussianMGF.trim (ℱ.le n) ?_ hn
      refine Finset.measurable_fun_sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) fun m hm ↦
        ((h_adapted m).mono (ℱ.mono ?_)).measurable
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hm
      lia

name: measure_sum_ge_le_of_hasCondSubgaussianMGF
statement:
lemma measure_sum_ge_le_of_hasCondSubgaussianMGF [IsZeroOrProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h_adapted : StronglyAdapted ℱ Y) (h0 : HasSubgaussianMGF (Y 0) (cY 0) μ) (n : ℕ)
    (h_subG : ∀ i < n - 1, HasCondSubgaussianMGF (ℱ i) (ℱ.le i) (Y (i + 1)) (cY (i + 1)) μ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    μ.real {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Y i ω}
      ≤ exp (-ε ^ 2 / (2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, cY i))
proof:
:=
  (HasSubgaussianMGF.sum_of_hasCondSubgaussianMGF h_adapted h0 n h_subG).measure_ge_le hε

lemma tilted_mul_apply_eq_ofReal_integral_cgf' {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet s)

name: setIntegral_tilted_mul_eq_mgf'
statement:
lemma setIntegral_tilted_mul_eq_mgf' (g : Ω → E) {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ∫ x in s, g x ∂(μ.tilted (t * X ·)) = ∫ x in s, (exp (t * X x) / mgf X μ t) • (g x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [setIntegral_tilted' _ _ hs, mgf]

name: setIntegral_tilted_mul_eq_mgf
statement:
lemma setIntegral_tilted_mul_eq_mgf [SFinite μ] (g : Ω → E) (s : Set Ω) :
    ∫ x in s, g x ∂(μ.tilted (t * X ·)) = ∫ x in s, (exp (t * X x) / mgf X μ t) • (g x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [setIntegral_tilted, mgf]

name: setIntegral_tilted_mul_eq_cgf'
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_neZero μ with rfl | hμ
  · simp
  · simp_rw [setIntegral_tilted_mul_eq_mgf' _ hs, exp_sub, exp_cgf ht]

name: setIntegral_tilted_mul_eq_cgf
statement:
lemma setIntegral_tilted_mul_eq_cgf [SFinite μ] (g : Ω → E) (s : Set Ω)
    (ht : Integrable (fun ω ↦ exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    ∫ x in s, g x ∂(μ.tilted (t * X ·)) = ∫ x in s, exp (t * X x - cgf X μ t) • (g x) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
