name: rnDerivAux_nonneg
statement: lemma rnDerivAux_nonneg (hκη : κ ≤ η) {a : α} {x : γ} : 0 ≤ rnDerivAux κ η a x
proof:
:= by
  rw [rnDerivAux]
  split_ifs with hα
  · exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  · have := hαγ.countableOrCountablyGenerated.resolve_left hα
    exact density_nonneg ((fst_map_id_prod _ measurable_const).trans_le hκη) _ _ _

name: rnDerivAux_le_one
statement:
lemma rnDerivAux_le_one [IsFiniteKernel η] (hκη : κ ≤ η) {a : α} :
    rnDerivAux κ η a ≤ᵐ[η a] 1
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Measure.rnDeriv_le_one_of_le (hκη a)] with x hx_le_one
  simp_rw [rnDerivAux]
  split_ifs with hα
  · refine ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal zero_le_one ?_
    simp only [Pi.one_apply, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
    exact hx_le_one
  · have := hαγ.countableOrCountablyGenerated.resolve_left hα
    exact density_le_one ((fst_map_id_prod _ measurable_const).trans_le hκη) _ _ _

name: measurable_rnDerivAux
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_rnDerivAux (κ η : Kernel α γ) :
    Measurable (fun p : α × γ ↦ Kernel.rnDerivAux κ η p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [rnDerivAux]
  split_ifs with hα
  · refine Measurable.ennreal_toReal <| measurable_from_prod_countable_right'
      (fun a ↦ Measure.measurable_rnDeriv (κ a) (η a)) fun a a' c ha'_mem_a ↦ ?_
    have h_eq : ∀ κ : Kernel α γ, κ a' = κ a := fun κ ↦ by
      ext s hs
      exact mem_of_mem_measurableAtom ha'_mem_a
        (Kernel.measurable_coe κ hs (measurableSet_singleton (κ a s))) rfl
    rw [h_eq κ, h_eq η]
  · have := hαγ.countableOrCountablyGenerated.resolve_left hα
    exact measurable_density _ η MeasurableSet.univ

name: measurable_rnDerivAux_right
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_rnDerivAux_right (κ η : Kernel α γ) (a : α) :
    Measurable (fun x : γ ↦ rnDerivAux κ η a x)
proof: := by fun_prop

name: setLIntegral_rnDerivAux
statement:
lemma setLIntegral_rnDerivAux (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η]
    (a : α) {s : Set γ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x) ∂(κ + η) a = κ a s
proof:
:= by
  have h_le : κ ≤ κ + η := le_add_of_nonneg_right bot_le
  simp_rw [rnDerivAux]
  split_ifs with hα
  · have h_ac : κ a ≪ (κ + η) a := Measure.absolutelyContinuous_of_le (h_le a)
    rw [← Measure.setLIntegral_rnDeriv h_ac]
    refine setLIntegral_congr_fun_ae hs ?_
    filter_upwards [Measure.rnDeriv_lt_top (κ a) ((κ + η) a)] with x hx_lt _
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hx_lt.ne]
  · have := hαγ.countableOrCountablyGenerated.resolve_left hα
    rw [setLIntegral_density ((fst_map_id_prod _ measurable_const).trans_le h_le) _
      MeasurableSet.univ hs, map_apply' _ (by fun_prop) _ (hs.prod MeasurableSet.univ)]
    congr 1 with x
    simp

name: withDensity_rnDerivAux
statement:
lemma withDensity_rnDerivAux (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] :
    withDensity (κ + η) (fun a x ↦ Real.toNNReal (rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x)) = κ
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply']
  swap; · fun_prop
  simp_rw [ofNNReal_toNNReal]
  exact setLIntegral_rnDerivAux κ η a hs

name: withDensity_one_sub_rnDerivAux
statement:
lemma withDensity_one_sub_rnDerivAux (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] :
    withDensity (κ + η) (fun a x ↦ Real.toNNReal (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x)) = η
proof:
:= by
  have h_le : κ ≤ κ + η := le_add_of_nonneg_right bot_le
  suffices withDensity (κ + η) (fun a x ↦ Real.toNNReal (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x))
      + withDensity (κ + η) (fun a x ↦ Real.toNNReal (rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x))
      = κ + η by
    ext a s
    have h : (withDensity (κ + η) (fun a x ↦ Real.toNNReal (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x))
          + withDensity (κ + η) (fun a x ↦ Real.toNNReal (rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x))) a s
        = κ a s + η a s := by
      rw [this]
      simp
    simp only [FunLike.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Measure.coe_add] at h
    rwa [withDensity_rnDerivAux, add_comm, ENNReal.add_right_inj (measure_ne_top _ _)] at h
  simp_rw [ofNNReal_toNNReal, ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ (rnDerivAux_nonneg h_le), ENNReal.ofReal_one]
  rw [withDensity_sub_add_cancel]
  · rw [withDensity_one']
  · exact measurable_const
  · fun_prop
  · intro a
    filter_upwards [rnDerivAux_le_one h_le] with x hx
    simp only [ENNReal.ofReal_le_one]
    exact hx

name: mem_mutuallySingularSetSlice
statement:
lemma mem_mutuallySingularSetSlice (κ η : Kernel α γ) (a : α) (x : γ) :
    x ∈ mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a ↔ 1 ≤ rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mutuallySingularSetSlice, mem_ofPred]

name: notMem_mutuallySingularSetSlice
statement:
lemma notMem_mutuallySingularSetSlice (κ η : Kernel α γ) (a : α) (x : γ) :
    x ∉ mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a ↔ rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x < 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [mutuallySingularSetSlice]

name: measurableSet_mutuallySingularSet
statement:
lemma measurableSet_mutuallySingularSet (κ η : Kernel α γ) :
    MeasurableSet (mutuallySingularSet κ η)
proof:
:=
  measurable_rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) measurableSet_Ici

name: measurableSet_mutuallySingularSetSlice
statement:
lemma measurableSet_mutuallySingularSetSlice (κ η : Kernel α γ) (a : α) :
    MeasurableSet (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)
proof:
:=
  measurable_prodMk_left (measurableSet_mutuallySingularSet κ η)

name: measure_mutuallySingularSetSlice
statement:
lemma measure_mutuallySingularSetSlice (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η]
    (a : α) :
    η a (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices withDensity (κ + η) (fun a x ↦ Real.toNNReal
      (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x)) a {x | 1 ≤ rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x} = 0 by
    rwa [withDensity_one_sub_rnDerivAux κ η] at this
  simp_rw [ofNNReal_toNNReal]
  rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply', lintegral_eq_zero_iff, EventuallyEq, ae_restrict_iff]
  rotate_left
  · exact (measurableSet_singleton 0).preimage (by fun_prop)
  · fun_prop
  · fun_prop
  refine ae_of_all _ (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  simp only [mem_ofPred_eq] at hx
  simp [hx]

name: rnDeriv_def'
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_def' (κ η : Kernel α γ) :
    rnDeriv κ η = fun a x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x)
      / ENNReal.ofReal (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x)
proof: := by ext; rw [rnDeriv_def]

name: measurable_rnDeriv
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_rnDeriv (κ η : Kernel α γ) :
    Measurable (fun p : α × γ ↦ rnDeriv κ η p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [rnDeriv_def]
  exact (measurable_rnDerivAux κ _).ennreal_ofReal.div
    (measurable_const.sub (measurable_rnDerivAux κ _)).ennreal_ofReal

name: measurable_rnDeriv_right
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable_rnDeriv_right (κ η : Kernel α γ) (a : α) :
    Measurable (fun x : γ ↦ rnDeriv κ η a x)
proof: := by fun_prop

name: rnDeriv_eq_top_iff
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_eq_top_iff (κ η : Kernel α γ) (a : α) (x : γ) :
    rnDeriv κ η a x = ∞ ↔ (a, x) ∈ mutuallySingularSet κ η
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rnDeriv, ENNReal.div_eq_top, ne_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le,
    tsub_le_iff_right, zero_add, ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, not_false_eq_true, and_true, or_false,
    mutuallySingularSet, mem_ofPred_eq, and_iff_right_iff_imp]
  exact fun h ↦ zero_lt_one.trans_le h

name: rnDeriv_eq_top_iff'
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_eq_top_iff' (κ η : Kernel α γ) (a : α) (x : γ) :
    rnDeriv κ η a x = ∞ ↔ x ∈ mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a
proof:
:= by
  rw [rnDeriv_eq_top_iff, mutuallySingularSet, mutuallySingularSetSlice, mem_ofPred, mem_ofPred]

name: measurable_singularPart_fun
statement:
lemma measurable_singularPart_fun (κ η : Kernel α γ) :
    Measurable (fun p : α × γ ↦ Real.toNNReal (rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) p.1 p.2)
      - Real.toNNReal (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) p.1 p.2) * rnDeriv κ η p.1 p.2)
proof: := by fun_prop

name: measurable_singularPart_fun_right
statement:
lemma measurable_singularPart_fun_right (κ η : Kernel α γ) (a : α) :
    Measurable (fun x : γ ↦ Real.toNNReal (rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x)
      - Real.toNNReal (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x) * rnDeriv κ η a x)
proof:
:= by
  change Measurable ((Function.uncurry fun a b ↦
    ENNReal.ofReal (rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a b)
    - ENNReal.ofReal (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a b) * rnDeriv κ η a b) ∘ (fun b ↦ (a, b)))
  exact (measurable_singularPart_fun κ η).comp measurable_prodMk_left

name: singularPart_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice
statement:
lemma singularPart_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsSFiniteKernel κ]
    [IsSFiniteKernel η] (a : α) :
    singularPart κ η a (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)ᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [singularPart, Kernel.withDensity_apply', lintegral_eq_zero_iff, EventuallyEq,
    ae_restrict_iff]
  all_goals simp_rw [ofNNReal_toNNReal]
  rotate_left
  · exact measurableSet_preimage (measurable_singularPart_fun_right κ η a)
      (measurableSet_singleton _)
  · exact measurable_singularPart_fun_right κ η a
  · exact measurable_singularPart_fun κ η
  refine ae_of_all _ (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
  simp only [mem_compl_iff, mutuallySingularSetSlice, mem_ofPred, not_le] at hx
  simp_rw [rnDeriv]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos, div_eq_inv_mul, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_inv_cancel₀, one_mul, tsub_self, Pi.zero_apply]
  · simp only [ne_eq, sub_eq_zero, hx.ne', not_false_eq_true]
  · simp only [sub_nonneg, hx.le]
  · simp only [sub_pos, hx]

name: singularPart_of_subset_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice
statement:
lemma singularPart_of_subset_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice [IsSFiniteKernel κ]
    [IsFiniteKernel η] {a : α} {s : Set γ} (hs : s ⊆ (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)ᶜ) :
    singularPart κ η a s = 0
proof:
:=
  measure_mono_null hs (singularPart_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)

name: singularPart_of_subset_mutuallySingularSetSlice
statement:
lemma singularPart_of_subset_mutuallySingularSetSlice [IsFiniteKernel κ]
    [IsFiniteKernel η] {a : α} {s : Set γ} (hsm : MeasurableSet s)
    (hs : s ⊆ mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a) :
    singularPart κ η a s = κ a s
proof:
:= by
  have hs' : ∀ x ∈ s, 1 ≤ rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x := fun _ hx ↦ hs hx
  rw [singularPart, Kernel.withDensity_apply']
  swap; · exact measurable_singularPart_fun κ η
  calc
    ∫⁻ x in s, ↑(Real.toNNReal (rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x)) -
      ↑(Real.toNNReal (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x)) * rnDeriv κ η a x
      ∂(κ + η) a
    = ∫⁻ _ in s, 1 ∂(κ + η) a := by
        refine setLIntegral_congr_fun_ae hsm ?_
        have h_le : κ ≤ κ + η := le_add_of_nonneg_right bot_le
        filter_upwards [rnDerivAux_le_one h_le] with x hx hxs
        have h_eq_one : rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x = 1 := le_antisymm hx (hs' x hxs)
        simp [h_eq_one]
  _ = (κ + η) a s := by simp
  _ = κ a s := by
        suffices η a s = 0 by simp [this]
        exact measure_mono_null hs (measure_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)

name: withDensity_rnDeriv_mutuallySingularSetSlice
statement:
lemma withDensity_rnDeriv_mutuallySingularSetSlice (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ]
    [IsFiniteKernel η] (a : α) :
    withDensity η (rnDeriv κ η) a (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply']
  · exact setLIntegral_measure_zero _ _ (measure_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)
  · exact measurable_rnDeriv κ η

name: withDensity_rnDeriv_of_subset_mutuallySingularSetSlice
statement:
lemma withDensity_rnDeriv_of_subset_mutuallySingularSetSlice [IsFiniteKernel κ]
    [IsFiniteKernel η] {a : α} {s : Set γ}
    (hs : s ⊆ mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a) :
    withDensity η (rnDeriv κ η) a s = 0
proof:
:=
  measure_mono_null hs (withDensity_rnDeriv_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)

name: withDensity_rnDeriv_of_subset_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice
statement:
lemma withDensity_rnDeriv_of_subset_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice
    [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] {a : α} {s : Set γ} (hsm : MeasurableSet s)
    (hs : s ⊆ (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)ᶜ) :
    withDensity η (rnDeriv κ η) a s = κ a s
proof:
:= by
  have : withDensity η (rnDeriv κ η)
      = withDensity (withDensity (κ + η)
        (fun a x ↦ Real.toNNReal (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x))) (rnDeriv κ η) := by
    rw [rnDeriv_def']
    congr
    exact (withDensity_one_sub_rnDerivAux κ η).symm
  rw [this, ← withDensity_mul, Kernel.withDensity_apply']
  rotate_left
  · fun_prop
  · fun_prop
  · exact measurable_rnDeriv _ _
  simp_rw [rnDeriv]
  have hs' : ∀ x ∈ s, rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x < 1 := by
    simp_rw [← notMem_mutuallySingularSetSlice]
    exact fun x hx hx_mem ↦ hs hx hx_mem
  calc
    ∫⁻ x in s, ↑(Real.toNNReal (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x)) *
      (ENNReal.ofReal (rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x) /
        ENNReal.ofReal (1 - rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x)) ∂(κ + η) a
  _ = ∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (rnDerivAux κ (κ + η) a x) ∂(κ + η) a := by
      refine setLIntegral_congr_fun hsm (fun x hx ↦ ?_)
      rw [ofNNReal_toNNReal, ← ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos, div_eq_inv_mul, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul,
        ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀, one_mul]
      · rw [ne_eq, sub_eq_zero]
        exact (hs' x hx).ne'
      · simp [(hs' x hx).le]
      · simp [hs' x hx]
  _ = κ a s := setLIntegral_rnDerivAux κ η a hsm

name: mutuallySingular_singularPart
statement:
lemma mutuallySingular_singularPart (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η]
    (a : α) :
    singularPart κ η a ⟂ₘ η a
proof:
:= by
  symm
  exact ⟨mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a, measurableSet_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a,
    measure_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a, singularPart_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a⟩

name: rnDeriv_add_singularPart
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_add_singularPart (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] :
    withDensity η (rnDeriv κ η) + singularPart κ η = κ
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  rw [← inter_union_sdiff s (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)]
  simp only [FunLike.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Measure.coe_add]
  have hm := measurableSet_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a
  simp only [measure_union (Disjoint.mono inter_subset_right le_rfl disjoint_sdiff_right)
    (hs.diff hm)]
  rw [singularPart_of_subset_mutuallySingularSetSlice (hs.inter hm) inter_subset_right,
    singularPart_of_subset_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice (sdiff_subset_iff.mpr (by simp)),
    add_zero, withDensity_rnDeriv_of_subset_mutuallySingularSetSlice inter_subset_right,
    zero_add, withDensity_rnDeriv_of_subset_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice (hs.diff hm)
      (sdiff_subset_iff.mpr (by simp)), add_comm]

name: singularPart_eq_zero_iff_apply_eq_zero
statement:
lemma singularPart_eq_zero_iff_apply_eq_zero (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsSFiniteKernel κ]
    [IsSFiniteKernel η] (a : α) :
    singularPart κ η a = 0 ↔ singularPart κ η a (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Measure.measure_univ_eq_zero]
  have : univ = (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a) ∪ (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)ᶜ := by simp
  rw [this, measure_union disjoint_compl_right (measurableSet_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a).compl,
    singularPart_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice, add_zero]

name: withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero_iff_apply_eq_zero
statement:
lemma withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero_iff_apply_eq_zero (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ]
    [IsFiniteKernel η] (a : α) :
    withDensity η (rnDeriv κ η) a = 0
      ↔ withDensity η (rnDeriv κ η) a (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)ᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Measure.measure_univ_eq_zero]
  have : univ = (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a) ∪ (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)ᶜ := by simp
  rw [this, measure_union disjoint_compl_right (measurableSet_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a).compl,
    withDensity_rnDeriv_mutuallySingularSetSlice, zero_add]

name: singularPart_eq_zero_iff_absolutelyContinuous
statement:
lemma singularPart_eq_zero_iff_absolutelyContinuous (κ η : Kernel α γ)
    [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] (a : α) :
    singularPart κ η a = 0 ↔ κ a ≪ η a
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← rnDeriv_add_singularPart κ η, add_apply]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [h, add_zero]
    exact withDensity_absolutelyContinuous _ _
  rw [Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.add_left_iff] at h
  exact Measure.eq_zero_of_absolutelyContinuous_of_mutuallySingular h.2
    (mutuallySingular_singularPart _ _ _)

name: withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero_iff_mutuallySingular
statement:
lemma withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero_iff_mutuallySingular (κ η : Kernel α γ)
    [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] (a : α) :
    withDensity η (rnDeriv κ η) a = 0 ↔ κ a ⟂ₘ η a
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← rnDeriv_add_singularPart κ η, add_apply]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [h, zero_add]
    exact mutuallySingular_singularPart _ _ _
  rw [Measure.MutuallySingular.add_left_iff] at h
  rw [← Measure.MutuallySingular.self_iff]
  exact h.1.mono_ac Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.rfl
    (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous (κ := η) (rnDeriv κ η) a)

name: singularPart_eq_zero_iff_measure_eq_zero
statement:
lemma singularPart_eq_zero_iff_measure_eq_zero (κ η : Kernel α γ)
    [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] (a : α) :
    singularPart κ η a = 0 ↔ κ a (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq_add := rnDeriv_add_singularPart κ η
  simp_rw [Kernel.ext_iff, Measure.ext_iff] at h_eq_add
  specialize h_eq_add a (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)
    (measurableSet_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)
  simp only [FunLike.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Measure.coe_add,
    withDensity_rnDeriv_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η, zero_add] at h_eq_add
  rw [← h_eq_add]
  exact singularPart_eq_zero_iff_apply_eq_zero κ η a

name: withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero_iff_measure_eq_zero
statement:
lemma withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero_iff_measure_eq_zero (κ η : Kernel α γ)
    [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] (a : α) :
    withDensity η (rnDeriv κ η) a = 0 ↔ κ a (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)ᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq_add := rnDeriv_add_singularPart κ η
  simp_rw [Kernel.ext_iff, Measure.ext_iff] at h_eq_add
  specialize h_eq_add a (mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a)ᶜ
    (measurableSet_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a).compl
  simp only [FunLike.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Measure.coe_add,
    singularPart_compl_mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η, add_zero] at h_eq_add
  rw [← h_eq_add]
  exact withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero_iff_apply_eq_zero κ η a

name: measurableSet_absolutelyContinuous
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← singularPart_eq_zero_iff_absolutelyContinuous,
    singularPart_eq_zero_iff_measure_eq_zero]
  exact measurable_kernel_prodMk_left (measurableSet_mutuallySingularSet κ η)
    (measurableSet_singleton 0)

name: measurableSet_mutuallySingular
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero_iff_mutuallySingular,
    withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero_iff_measure_eq_zero]
  exact measurable_kernel_prodMk_left (measurableSet_mutuallySingularSet κ η).compl
    (measurableSet_singleton 0)

name: singularPart_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma singularPart_self (κ : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] : κ.singularPart κ = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext : 1; rw [zero_apply, singularPart_eq_zero_iff_absolutelyContinuous]

name: eq_rnDeriv_measure
statement:
lemma eq_rnDeriv_measure (h : κ = η.withDensity f + ξ)
    (hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)) (a : α) (hξ : ξ a ⟂ₘ η a) :
    f a =ᵐ[η a] ∂(κ a)/∂(η a)
proof:
:= by
  have : κ a = ξ a + (η a).withDensity (f a) := by
    rw [h, add_apply, η.withDensity_apply hf, add_comm]
  exact (κ a).eq_rnDeriv₀ (hf.comp measurable_prodMk_left).aemeasurable hξ this

name: eq_singularPart_measure
statement:
lemma eq_singularPart_measure (h : κ = η.withDensity f + ξ)
    (hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)) (a : α) (hξ : ξ a ⟂ₘ η a) :
    ξ a = (κ a).singularPart (η a)
proof:
:= by
  have : κ a = ξ a + (η a).withDensity (f a) := by
    rw [h, add_apply, η.withDensity_apply hf, add_comm]
  exact (κ a).eq_singularPart (hf.comp measurable_prodMk_left) hξ this

name: rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure
statement: lemma rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure : rnDeriv κ η a =ᵐ[η a] ∂(κ a)/∂(η a)
proof:
:=
  eq_rnDeriv_measure (rnDeriv_add_singularPart κ η).symm (measurable_rnDeriv κ η) a
    (mutuallySingular_singularPart κ η a)

name: singularPart_eq_singularPart_measure
statement: lemma singularPart_eq_singularPart_measure : singularPart κ η a = (κ a).singularPart (η a)
proof:
:=
  eq_singularPart_measure (rnDeriv_add_singularPart κ η).symm (measurable_rnDeriv κ η) a
    (mutuallySingular_singularPart κ η a)

name: eq_rnDeriv
statement:
lemma eq_rnDeriv (h : κ = η.withDensity f + ξ)
    (hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)) (a : α) (hξ : ξ a ⟂ₘ η a) :
    f a =ᵐ[η a] rnDeriv κ η a
proof:
:=
  (eq_rnDeriv_measure h hf a hξ).trans rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure.symm

name: eq_singularPart
statement:
lemma eq_singularPart (h : κ = η.withDensity f + ξ)
    (hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)) (a : α) (hξ : ξ a ⟂ₘ η a) :
    ξ a = singularPart κ η a
proof:
:=
  (eq_singularPart_measure h hf a hξ).trans singularPart_eq_singularPart_measure.symm

name: measurable_singularPart
statement:
lemma measurable_singularPart (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] :
    Measurable (fun a ↦ (κ a).singularPart (η a))
proof:
:= by
  refine Measure.measurable_of_measurable_coe _ (fun s hs ↦ ?_)
  simp_rw [← κ.singularPart_eq_singularPart_measure, κ.singularPart_def η]
  exact Kernel.measurable_coe _ hs

name: rnDeriv_self
statement: lemma rnDeriv_self (κ : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] (a : α) : rnDeriv κ κ a =ᵐ[κ a] 1
proof:
:=
  (κ.rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure).trans (κ a).rnDeriv_self

name: rnDeriv_singularPart
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_singularPart (κ ν : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel ν] (a : α) :
    rnDeriv (singularPart κ ν) ν a =ᵐ[ν a] 0
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(singularPart κ ν).rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure,
    (Measure.rnDeriv_eq_zero _ _).mpr (mutuallySingular_singularPart κ ν a)] with x h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2]

name: rnDeriv_lt_top
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_lt_top (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] {a : α} :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(η a), rnDeriv κ η a x < ∞
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [κ.rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure, (κ a).rnDeriv_ne_top _]
    with x heq htop using heq ▸ htop.lt_top

name: rnDeriv_ne_top
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_ne_top (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] {a : α} :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(η a), rnDeriv κ η a x ≠ ∞
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [κ.rnDeriv_lt_top η] with a h using h.ne

name: rnDeriv_pos
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_pos [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] {a : α} (ha : κ a ≪ η a) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(κ a), 0 < rnDeriv κ η a x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ha.ae_le κ.rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure, Measure.rnDeriv_pos ha]
    with x heq hpos using heq ▸ hpos

name: rnDeriv_toReal_pos
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_toReal_pos [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] {a : α} (h : κ a ≪ η a) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(κ a), 0 < (rnDeriv κ η a x).toReal
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [rnDeriv_pos h, h.ae_le (rnDeriv_ne_top κ _)] with x h0 htop
  simp_all only [pos_iff_ne_zero, ne_eq, ENNReal.toReal_pos, not_false_eq_true]

name: rnDeriv_add
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_add (κ ν η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel ν] [IsFiniteKernel η]
    (a : α) :
    rnDeriv (κ + ν) η a =ᵐ[η a] rnDeriv κ η a + rnDeriv ν η a
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(κ + ν).rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure, κ.rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure,
    ν.rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure, (κ a).rnDeriv_add (ν a) (η a)] with x h1 h2 h3 h4
  simp [h1, h2, h3, h4]

name: setLIntegral_rnDeriv_le
statement:
lemma setLIntegral_rnDeriv_le {κ η : Kernel α γ} [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η]
    {a : α} {s : Set γ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ∫⁻ c in s, κ.rnDeriv η a c ∂η a ≤ κ a s
proof:
:= by
  rw [setLIntegral_congr_fun_ae hs ((κ.rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure).mono (fun x hx _ ↦ hx)),
    ← withDensity_apply' _ s]
  exact (κ a).withDensity_rnDeriv_le _ _

name: setLIntegral_rnDeriv
statement:
lemma setLIntegral_rnDeriv {κ η : Kernel α γ} [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η]
    {a : α} (h : κ a ≪ η a) {s : Set γ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ∫⁻ c in s, κ.rnDeriv η a c ∂η a = κ a s
proof:
:= by
  rw [setLIntegral_congr_fun_ae hs ((κ.rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure).mono (fun x hx _ ↦ hx)),
    ← withDensity_apply _ hs, (κ a).withDensity_rnDeriv_eq _ h]

name: lintegral_rnDeriv
statement:
lemma lintegral_rnDeriv {κ η : Kernel α γ} [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η]
    {a : α} (h : κ a ≪ η a) :
    ∫⁻ c, κ.rnDeriv η a c ∂η a = κ a univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← setLIntegral_univ, setLIntegral_rnDeriv h MeasurableSet.univ]

name: withDensity_rnDeriv_le
statement:
lemma withDensity_rnDeriv_le (κ η : Kernel α γ) [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] (a : α) :
    η.withDensity (κ.rnDeriv η) a ≤ κ a
proof:
:= by
  refine Measure.le_intro (fun s hs _ ↦ ?_)
  rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply']
  · exact setLIntegral_rnDeriv_le hs
  · exact κ.measurable_rnDeriv _

name: withDensity_rnDeriv_eq
statement:
lemma withDensity_rnDeriv_eq [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] {a : α} (h : κ a ≪ η a) :
    η.withDensity (κ.rnDeriv η) a = κ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply]
  swap; · exact κ.measurable_rnDeriv _
  have h_ae := κ.rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure (η := η) (a := a)
  rw [MeasureTheory.withDensity_congr_ae h_ae, (κ a).withDensity_rnDeriv_eq _ h]

name: rnDeriv_withDensity
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_withDensity [IsFiniteKernel κ] {f : α → γ → ℝ≥0∞} [IsFiniteKernel (withDensity κ f)]
    (hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)) (a : α) :
    (κ.withDensity f).rnDeriv κ a =ᵐ[κ a] f a
proof:
:= by
  have h_ae := (κ.withDensity f).rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure (η := κ) (a := a)
  have hf' : ∀ a, Measurable (f a) := fun _ ↦ hf.of_uncurry_left
  filter_upwards [h_ae, (κ a).rnDeriv_withDensity (hf' a)] with x hx1 hx2
  rw [hx1, κ.withDensity_apply hf, hx2]

name: rnDeriv_eq_one_iff_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Measure.rnDeriv_eq_one_iff_eq h_ac]
  refine eventually_congr ?_
  filter_upwards [rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure (κ := κ) (η := η) (a := a)] with c hc
  rw [hc, Pi.one_apply]

name: ae_eq_of_compProd_eq
statement:
lemma ae_eq_of_compProd_eq [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η]
    (h : μ ⊗ₘ κ = μ ⊗ₘ η) :
    κ =ᵐ[μ] η
proof:
:= by
  have h_ac : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ a ≪ η a := (Measure.absolutelyContinuous_of_eq h).kernel_of_compProd
  have hκ_eq : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ a = η.withDensity (κ.rnDeriv η) a := by
    filter_upwards [h_ac] with a ha using (Kernel.withDensity_rnDeriv_eq ha).symm
  suffices ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, ∀ᵐ b ∂(η a), κ.rnDeriv η a b = 1 by
    filter_upwards [h_ac, this] with a h_ac h using (rnDeriv_eq_one_iff_eq h_ac).mp h
  refine Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_compProd (p := fun x ↦ κ.rnDeriv η x.1 x.2 = 1) ?_
  refine ae_eq_of_forall_setLIntegral_eq_of_sigmaFinite (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) fun s hs _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [MeasureTheory.lintegral_const, MeasurableSet.univ, Measure.restrict_apply,
    Set.univ_inter, one_mul]
  calc ∫⁻ x in s, κ.rnDeriv η x.1 x.2 ∂μ ⊗ₘ η
  _ = (μ ⊗ₘ κ) s := by
    rw [Measure.compProd_congr hκ_eq, Measure.compProd_withDensity, withDensity_apply _ hs]
    fun_prop
  _ = (μ ⊗ₘ η) s := by rw [h]

name: compProd_eq_iff
statement:
lemma compProd_eq_iff [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ = μ ⊗ₘ η ↔ κ =ᵐ[μ] η
proof:
:=
  ⟨Kernel.ae_eq_of_compProd_eq, Measure.compProd_congr⟩

name: withDensity_of_not_measurable
statement:
theorem withDensity_of_not_measurable (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ]
    (hf : ¬Measurable (Function.uncurry f)) : withDensity κ f = 0
proof: := by exact dite_eq_right hf

name: withDensity_apply
statement:
protected theorem withDensity_apply (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ]
    (hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)) (a : α) :
    withDensity κ f a = (κ a).withDensity (f a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [withDensity, dite_eq_left hf]
  rfl

name: withDensity_apply'
statement:
protected theorem withDensity_apply' (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ]
    (hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)) (a : α) (s : Set β) :
    withDensity κ f a s = ∫⁻ b in s, f a b ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply κ hf, withDensity_apply' _ s]

name: withDensity_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma withDensity_one (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] :
    Kernel.withDensity κ 1 = κ
proof:
:= by
  ext; rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply _ measurable_const]; simp

name: withDensity_one'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma withDensity_one' (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] :
    Kernel.withDensity κ (fun _ _ ↦ 1) = κ
proof: := Kernel.withDensity_one _

name: withDensity_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma withDensity_zero (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] :
    Kernel.withDensity κ 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext; rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply _ measurable_const]; simp

name: withDensity_zero'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma withDensity_zero' (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] :
    Kernel.withDensity κ (fun _ _ ↦ 0) = 0
proof: := Kernel.withDensity_zero _

name: lintegral_withDensity
statement:
theorem lintegral_withDensity (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ]
    (hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)) (a : α) {g : β → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g) :
    ∫⁻ b, g b ∂withDensity κ f a = ∫⁻ b, f a b * g b ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply _ hf,
    lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ (Measurable.of_uncurry_left hf) hg]
  simp_rw [Pi.mul_apply]

name: integral_withDensity
statement:
theorem integral_withDensity {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {f : β → E} [IsSFiniteKernel κ] {a : α} {g : α → β → ℝ≥0}
    (hg : Measurable (Function.uncurry g)) :
    ∫ b, f b ∂withDensity κ (fun a b => g a b) a = ∫ b, g a b • f b ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply, integral_withDensity_eq_integral_smul]
  · fun_prop
  · fun_prop

name: withDensity_add_left
statement:
theorem withDensity_add_left (κ η : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    (f : α → β → ℝ≥0∞) : withDensity (κ + η) f = withDensity κ f + withDensity η f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)
  · ext a s
    simp only [Kernel.withDensity_apply _ hf, add_apply, withDensity_add_measure]
  · simp_rw [withDensity_of_not_measurable _ hf]
    rw [zero_add]

name: withDensity_kernel_sum
statement:
theorem withDensity_kernel_sum [Countable ι] (κ : ι → Kernel α β) (hκ : ∀ i, IsSFiniteKernel (κ i))
    (f : α → β → ℝ≥0∞) :
    withDensity (Kernel.sum κ) f = Kernel.sum fun i => withDensity (κ i) f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)
  · ext1 a
    simp_rw [sum_apply, Kernel.withDensity_apply _ hf, sum_apply,
      withDensity_sum (fun n => κ n a) (f a)]
  · simp_rw [withDensity_of_not_measurable _ hf]
    exact sum_zero.symm

name: withDensity_add_right
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [add_apply, Kernel.withDensity_apply _ hf, Kernel.withDensity_apply _ hg,
    Kernel.withDensity_apply, Pi.add_apply, MeasureTheory.withDensity_add_right]
  · fun_prop
  · exact hf.add hg

name: withDensity_sub_add_cancel
statement:
lemma withDensity_sub_add_cancel [IsSFiniteKernel κ] {f g : α → β → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)) (hg : Measurable (Function.uncurry g))
    (hfg : ∀ a, g a ≤ᵐ[κ a] f a) :
    withDensity κ (fun a x ↦ f a x - g a x) + withDensity κ g = withDensity κ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← withDensity_add_right _ hg]
  swap; · exact hf.sub hg
  refine withDensity_congr_ae κ ((hf.sub hg).add hg) hf (fun a ↦ ?_)
  filter_upwards [hfg a] with x hx
  rwa [Pi.add_apply, Pi.add_apply, tsub_add_cancel_iff_le]

name: withDensity_tsum
proof:
:= by
  have h_sum_a : ∀ a, Summable fun n => f n a := fun a => Pi.summable.mpr fun b => ENNReal.summable
  have h_sum : Summable fun n => f n := Pi.summable.mpr h_sum_a
  ext a s hs
  rw [sum_apply' _ a hs, Kernel.withDensity_apply' κ _ a s]
  swap
  · have : Function.uncurry (∑' n, f n) = ∑' n, Function.uncurry (f n) := by
      ext1 p
      simp only [Function.uncurry_def]
      rw [Pi.tsum_apply h_sum, Pi.tsum_apply (h_sum_a _), Pi.tsum_apply]
      exact Pi.summable.mpr fun p => ENNReal.summable
    rw [this]
    fun_prop
  have : ∫⁻ b in s, (∑' n, f n) a b ∂κ a = ∫⁻ b in s, ∑' n, (fun b => f n a b) b ∂κ a := by
    congr with b
    rw [Pi.tsum_apply h_sum, Pi.tsum_apply (h_sum_a a)]
  rw [this, lintegral_tsum fun n => by fun_prop]
  congr with n
  rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply' _ (hf n) a s]

name: isFiniteKernel_withDensity_of_bounded
statement:
theorem isFiniteKernel_withDensity_of_bounded (κ : Kernel α β) [IsFiniteKernel κ] {B : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hB_top : B ≠ ∞) (hf_B : ∀ a b, f a b ≤ B) : IsFiniteKernel (withDensity κ f)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)
  · exact ⟨⟨B * κ.bound, ENNReal.mul_lt_top hB_top.lt_top κ.bound_lt_top, fun a => by
        rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply' κ hf a Set.univ]
        calc
          ∫⁻ b in Set.univ, f a b ∂κ a ≤ ∫⁻ _ in Set.univ, B ∂κ a := lintegral_mono (hf_B a)
          _ = B * κ a Set.univ := by
            simp only [Measure.restrict_univ, MeasureTheory.lintegral_const]
          _ ≤ B * κ.bound := by grw [measure_le_bound]⟩⟩
  · rw [withDensity_of_not_measurable _ hf]
    infer_instance

name: isSFiniteKernel_withDensity_of_isFiniteKernel
statement:
theorem isSFiniteKernel_withDensity_of_isFiniteKernel (κ : Kernel α β) [IsFiniteKernel κ]
    (hf_ne_top : ∀ a b, f a b ≠ ∞) : IsSFiniteKernel (withDensity κ f)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  by_cases hf : Measurable (Function.uncurry f)
  swap; · rw [withDensity_of_not_measurable _ hf]; infer_instance
  let fs : ℕ → α → β → ℝ≥0∞ := fun n a b => min (f a b) (n + 1) - min (f a b) n
  have h_le : ∀ a b n, ⌈(f a b).toReal⌉₊ ≤ n → f a b ≤ n := by
    intro a b n hn
    have : (f a b).toReal ≤ n := Nat.le_of_ceil_le hn
    rw [← ENNReal.le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le (hf_ne_top a b) _] at this
    · simpa
    · exact n.cast_nonneg
  have h_zero : ∀ a b n, ⌈(f a b).toReal⌉₊ ≤ n → fs n a b = 0 := by
    intro a b n hn
    suffices min (f a b) (n + 1) = f a b ∧ min (f a b) n = f a b by
      simp_rw [fs, this.1, this.2, tsub_self (f a b)]
    exact ⟨min_eq_left ((h_le a b n hn).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right zero_le_one)),
      min_eq_left (h_le a b n hn)⟩
  have hf_eq_tsum : f = ∑' n, fs n := by
    have h_sum_a : ∀ a, Summable fun n => fs n a :=
      fun _ => Pi.summable.mpr fun _ => ENNReal.summable
    ext a b : 2
    rw [Pi.tsum_apply (Pi.summable.mpr h_sum_a), Pi.tsum_apply (h_sum_a a),
      ENNReal.tsum_eq_liminf_sum_nat]
    have h_finsetSum : ∀ n, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, fs i a b = min (f a b) n := fun n ↦ by
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n hn =>
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, hn]
        simp [fs]
    simp_rw [h_finsetSum]
    refine (Filter.Tendsto.liminf_eq ?_).symm
    refine Filter.Tendsto.congr' ?_ tendsto_const_nhds
    rw [Filter.EventuallyEq, Filter.eventually_atTop]
    exact ⟨⌈(f a b).toReal⌉₊, fun n hn => (min_eq_left (h_le a b n hn)).symm⟩
  rw [hf_eq_tsum, withDensity_tsum _ fun n : ℕ => _]
  swap; · fun_prop
  refine isSFiniteKernel_sum (hκs := fun n => ?_)
  suffices IsFiniteKernel (withDensity κ (fs n)) by infer_instance
  refine isFiniteKernel_withDensity_of_bounded _ (ENNReal.coe_ne_top : ↑n + 1 ≠ ∞) fun a b => ?_
  
  beta_reduce
  norm_cast
  calc
    fs n a b ≤ min (f a b) (n + 1) := tsub_le_self
    _ ≤ n + 1 := min_le_right _ _
    _ = ↑(n + 1) := by norm_cast

name: isProper_iff_restrict_eq_indicator_smul
statement:
lemma isProper_iff_restrict_eq_indicator_smul (h𝓑𝓧 : 𝓑 ≤ 𝓧) :
    IsProper π ↔ ∀ ⦃B : Set X⦄ (hB : MeasurableSet[𝓑] B) (x : X),
      π.restrict (h𝓑𝓧 _ hB) x = B.indicator (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) x • π x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨?_⟩⟩ <;> simpa +instances only [inf_eq_left.2 h𝓑𝓧] using h

name: isProper_iff_inter_eq_indicator_mul
statement:
lemma isProper_iff_inter_eq_indicator_mul (h𝓑𝓧 : 𝓑 ≤ 𝓧) :
    IsProper π ↔
      ∀ ⦃A : Set X⦄ (_hA : MeasurableSet[𝓧] A) ⦃B : Set X⦄ (_hB : MeasurableSet[𝓑] B) (x : X),
        π x (A ∩ B) = B.indicator 1 x * π x A
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ↔ ∀ ⦃A : Set X⦄ (_hA : MeasurableSet[𝓧] A) ⦃B : Set X⦄ (hB : MeasurableSet[𝓑] B) (x : X),
          π.restrict (h𝓑𝓧 _ hB) x A = B.indicator 1 x * π x A := by
      simp [isProper_iff_restrict_eq_indicator_smul h𝓑𝓧, Measure.ext_iff]; aesop
    _ ↔ _ := by congr! 5 with A hA B hB x; rw [restrict_apply, Measure.restrict_apply hA]

name: IsProper.setLIntegral_eq_comp
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.bind_apply (by measurability) (π.measurable.mono h𝓑𝓧 le_rfl).aemeasurable]
  simp only [hπ.inter_eq_indicator_mul h𝓑𝓧 hA hB, ← indicator_mul_const, Pi.one_apply, one_mul]
  rw [← lintegral_indicator (h𝓑𝓧 _ hB)]
  rfl

name: IsProper.lintegral_indicator_mul_indicator
statement:
private lemma IsProper.lintegral_indicator_mul_indicator (hπ : IsProper π) (h𝓑𝓧 : 𝓑 ≤ 𝓧)
    (hA : MeasurableSet[𝓧] A) (hB : MeasurableSet[𝓑] B) :
    ∫⁻ x, B.indicator 1 x * A.indicator 1 x ∂(π x₀) =
      B.indicator 1 x₀ * ∫⁻ x, A.indicator 1 x ∂(π x₀)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← inter_indicator_mul]
  rw [lintegral_indicator ((h𝓑𝓧 _ hB).inter hA), lintegral_indicator hA]
  simp only [MeasureTheory.lintegral_const, MeasurableSet.univ, Measure.restrict_apply, univ_inter,
    Pi.one_apply, one_mul]
  rw [← hπ.inter_eq_indicator_mul h𝓑𝓧 hA hB, inter_comm]

name: IsProper.lintegral_indicator_mul
proof:
:= by
  refine hf.ennreal_induction ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro c A hA
    simp_rw [← smul_indicator_one_apply, mul_smul_comm, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [lintegral_const_mul, lintegral_const_mul, hπ.lintegral_indicator_mul_indicator h𝓑𝓧 hA hB,
      mul_left_comm] <;> measurability
  · rintro f₁ f₂ - _ _ hf₁ hf₂
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, mul_add]
    rw [lintegral_add_right, lintegral_add_right, hf₁, hf₂, mul_add] <;> measurability
  · rintro f' hf'_meas hf'_mono hf'
    simp_rw [ENNReal.mul_iSup]
    rw [lintegral_iSup (by measurability), lintegral_iSup hf'_meas hf'_mono, ENNReal.mul_iSup]
    · simp_rw [hf']
    · exact hf'_mono.const_mul zero_le

name: IsProper.setLIntegral_eq_indicator_mul_lintegral
statement:
lemma IsProper.setLIntegral_eq_indicator_mul_lintegral (hπ : IsProper π) (h𝓑𝓧 : 𝓑 ≤ 𝓧)
    (hf : Measurable[𝓧] f) (hB : MeasurableSet[𝓑] B) (x₀ : X) :
    ∫⁻ x in B, f x ∂(π x₀) = B.indicator 1 x₀ * ∫⁻ x, f x ∂(π x₀)
proof:
:= by
  simp [← hπ.lintegral_indicator_mul h𝓑𝓧 hf hB, ← indicator_mul_left,
    lintegral_indicator (h𝓑𝓧 _ hB)]

name: IsProper.setLIntegral_inter_eq_indicator_mul_setLIntegral
statement:
lemma IsProper.setLIntegral_inter_eq_indicator_mul_setLIntegral (hπ : IsProper π) (h𝓑𝓧 : 𝓑 ≤ 𝓧)
    (hf : Measurable[𝓧] f) (hA : MeasurableSet[𝓧] A) (hB : MeasurableSet[𝓑] B) (x₀ : X) :
    ∫⁻ x in A ∩ B, f x ∂(π x₀) = B.indicator 1 x₀ * ∫⁻ x in A, f x ∂(π x₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lintegral_indicator hA, ← hπ.setLIntegral_eq_indicator_mul_lintegral h𝓑𝓧 _ hB,
    setLIntegral_indicator] <;> measurability

name: IsProper.lintegral_mul
statement:
lemma IsProper.lintegral_mul (hπ : IsProper π) (h𝓑𝓧 : 𝓑 ≤ 𝓧) (hf : Measurable[𝓧] f)
    (hg : Measurable[𝓑] g) (x₀ : X) :
    ∫⁻ x, g x * f x ∂(π x₀) = g x₀ * ∫⁻ x, f x ∂(π x₀)
proof:
:= by
  refine hg.ennreal_induction ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro c A hA
    simp_rw [← smul_indicator_one_apply, smul_mul_assoc, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [lintegral_const_mul, hπ.lintegral_indicator_mul h𝓑𝓧 hf hA]
    · measurability
  · rintro g₁ g₂ - _ hg₂_meas hg₁ hg₂
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, add_mul]
    rw [lintegral_add_right, hg₁, hg₂]
    · exact (hg₂_meas.mono h𝓑𝓧 le_rfl).mul hf
  · rintro g' hg'_meas hg'_mono hg'
    simp_rw [ENNReal.iSup_mul]
    rw [lintegral_iSup (fun n ↦ ((hg'_meas _).mono h𝓑𝓧 le_rfl).fun_mul hf)
      (hg'_mono.mul_const zero_le)]
    simp_rw [hg']

name: measurable
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma measurable (κ : Kernel α β) : Measurable κ
proof: := κ.measurable'

name: aemeasurable
statement: lemma aemeasurable (κ : Kernel α β) {μ : Measure α} : AEMeasurable κ μ
proof: := κ.measurable.aemeasurable

name: coe_mk
statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma coe_mk (f : α → Measure β) (hf) : mk f hf = f
proof: := rfl

name: finsetSum_apply'
statement:
theorem finsetSum_apply' (I : Finset ι) (κ : ι → Kernel α β) (a : α) (s : Set β) :
    (∑ i ∈ I, κ i) a s = ∑ i ∈ I, κ i a s
proof: := by rw [sum_apply, Measure.finsetSum_apply]

name: eq_zero_or_isMarkovKernel
statement:
theorem eq_zero_or_isMarkovKernel
    (κ : Kernel α β) [h : IsZeroOrMarkovKernel κ] :
    κ = 0 ∨ IsMarkovKernel κ
proof:
:=
  h.eq_zero_or_isMarkovKernel'

name: bound_lt_top
statement: theorem bound_lt_top (κ : Kernel α β) [h : IsFiniteKernel κ] : κ.bound < ∞
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hle⟩ := h.exists_univ_le
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hC
  simp [bound, hle]

name: bound_ne_top
statement:
theorem bound_ne_top (κ : Kernel α β) [IsFiniteKernel κ] :
    κ.bound ≠ ∞
proof: := κ.bound_lt_top.ne

name: measure_le_bound
statement:
theorem measure_le_bound (κ : Kernel α β) (a : α) (s : Set β) :
    κ a s ≤ κ.bound
proof:
:=
  (measure_mono (Set.subset_univ s)).trans <| le_iSup (f := fun a ↦ κ a .univ) a

name: bound_eq_zero_of_isEmpty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bound_eq_zero_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty α] (κ : Kernel α β) :
    κ.bound = 0
proof: := by simp [bound]

name: bound_eq_zero_of_isEmpty'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bound_eq_zero_of_isEmpty' [IsEmpty β] (κ : Kernel α β) :
    κ.bound = 0
proof: := by simp [bound, Subsingleton.elim _ (0 : Measure β)]

name: bound_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bound_zero : bound (0 : Kernel α β) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [bound]

name: isFiniteKernel_of_le
statement:
lemma isFiniteKernel_of_le {κ ν : Kernel α β} [hν : IsFiniteKernel ν] (hκν : κ ≤ ν) :
    IsFiniteKernel κ
proof:
:=
  ⟨ν.bound, ν.bound_lt_top, fun a ↦ (hκν _ _).trans (ν.measure_le_bound a Set.univ)⟩

name: bound_eq_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bound_eq_one [Nonempty α] (κ : Kernel α β) [IsMarkovKernel κ] :
    κ.bound = 1
proof: := by simp [bound]

name: bound_le_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bound_le_one (κ : Kernel α β) [IsZeroOrMarkovKernel κ] :
    κ.bound ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α
  · simp
  · rcases eq_zero_or_isMarkovKernel κ with rfl | _ <;> simp

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext (h : ∀ a, κ a = η a) : κ = η
proof: := DFunLike.ext _ _ h

name: ext_iff'
statement: theorem ext_iff' : κ = η ↔ ∀ a s, MeasurableSet s → κ a s = η a s
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Kernel.ext_iff, Measure.ext_iff]

name: ext_fun
statement:
theorem ext_fun (h : ∀ a f, Measurable f → ∫⁻ b, f b ∂κ a = ∫⁻ b, f b ∂η a) :
    κ = η
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  specialize h a (s.indicator fun _ => 1) (Measurable.indicator measurable_const hs)
  simp_rw [lintegral_indicator_const hs, one_mul] at h
  rw [h]

name: ext_fun_iff
statement: theorem ext_fun_iff : κ = η ↔ ∀ a f, Measurable f → ∫⁻ b, f b ∂κ a = ∫⁻ b, f b ∂η a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h a f _ => by rw [h], ext_fun⟩

name: not_isMarkovKernel_zero
statement: lemma not_isMarkovKernel_zero [Nonempty α] : ¬ IsMarkovKernel (0 : Kernel α β)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  let x : α := Nonempty.some inferInstance
  have h1 : (0 : Measure β) .univ = 1 := (h.isProbabilityMeasure x).measure_univ
  simp at h1

name: measurable_coe
statement:
protected theorem measurable_coe (κ : Kernel α β) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    Measurable fun a => κ a s
proof:
:=
  (Measure.measurable_coe hs).comp κ.measurable

name: apply_congr_of_mem_measurableAtom
statement:
lemma apply_congr_of_mem_measurableAtom (κ : Kernel α β) {y' y : α} (hy' : y' ∈ measurableAtom y) :
    κ y' = κ y
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  exact mem_of_mem_measurableAtom hy' (κ.measurable_coe hs (measurableSet_singleton (κ y s))) rfl

name: eq_zero_of_isEmpty_left
statement: lemma eq_zero_of_isEmpty_left (κ : Kernel α β) [h : IsEmpty α] : κ = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  exact h.elim a

name: eq_zero_of_isEmpty_right
statement: lemma eq_zero_of_isEmpty_right (κ : Kernel α β) [IsEmpty β] : κ = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp [Measure.eq_zero_of_isEmpty (κ a)]

name: sum_apply
statement:
theorem sum_apply [Countable ι] (κ : ι → Kernel α β) (a : α) :
    Kernel.sum κ a = Measure.sum fun n => κ n a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: sum_apply'
statement:
theorem sum_apply' [Countable ι] (κ : ι → Kernel α β) (a : α) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    Kernel.sum κ a s = ∑' n, κ n a s
proof: := by rw [sum_apply κ a, Measure.sum_apply _ hs]

name: sum_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_zero [Countable ι] : (Kernel.sum fun _ : ι => (0 : Kernel α β)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  rw [sum_apply' _ a hs]
  simp only [zero_apply, Measure.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, tsum_zero]

name: sum_comm
statement:
theorem sum_comm [Countable ι] (κ : ι → ι → Kernel α β) :
    (Kernel.sum fun n => Kernel.sum (κ n)) = Kernel.sum fun m => Kernel.sum fun n => κ n m
proof:
:= by
  ext a s; simp_rw [sum_apply]; rw [Measure.sum_comm]

name: sum_fintype
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_fintype [Fintype ι] (κ : ι → Kernel α β) : Kernel.sum κ = ∑ i, κ i
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  simp only [sum_apply' κ a hs, finsetSum_apply' _ κ a s, tsum_fintype]

name: sum_add
statement:
theorem sum_add [Countable ι] (κ η : ι → Kernel α β) :
    (Kernel.sum fun n => κ n + η n) = Kernel.sum κ + Kernel.sum η
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  simp only [add_apply, sum_apply, Measure.sum_apply _ hs, Pi.add_apply,
    Measure.coe_add, ENNReal.summable.tsum_add ENNReal.summable]

name: kernel_sum_seq
statement: theorem kernel_sum_seq (κ : Kernel α β) [h : IsSFiniteKernel κ] : Kernel.sum (seq κ) = κ
proof:
:=
  h.tsum_finite.choose_spec.2.symm

name: measure_sum_seq
statement:
theorem measure_sum_seq (κ : Kernel α β) [h : IsSFiniteKernel κ] (a : α) :
    (Measure.sum fun n => seq κ n a) = κ a
proof: := by rw [← Kernel.sum_apply, kernel_sum_seq κ]

name: IsSFiniteKernel.finsetSum
statement:
theorem IsSFiniteKernel.finsetSum {κs : ι → Kernel α β} (I : Finset ι)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ I, IsSFiniteKernel (κs i)) : IsSFiniteKernel (∑ i ∈ I, κs i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction I using Finset.induction with
  | empty => rw [Finset.sum_empty]; infer_instance
  | insert i I hi_notMem_I h_ind =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi_notMem_I]
    have : IsSFiniteKernel (κs i) := h i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
    have : IsSFiniteKernel (∑ x ∈ I, κs x) :=
      h_ind fun i hiI => h i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hiI)
    exact IsSFiniteKernel.add _ _

name: isSFiniteKernel_sum_of_denumerable
statement:
theorem isSFiniteKernel_sum_of_denumerable [Denumerable ι] {κs : ι → Kernel α β}
    (hκs : ∀ n, IsSFiniteKernel (κs n)) : IsSFiniteKernel (Kernel.sum κs)
proof:
:= by
  let e : ℕ ≃ ι × ℕ := (Denumerable.eqv (ι × ℕ)).symm
  refine ⟨⟨fun n => seq (κs (e n).1) (e n).2, inferInstance, ?_⟩⟩
  have hκ_eq : Kernel.sum κs = Kernel.sum fun n => Kernel.sum (seq (κs n)) := by
    simp_rw [kernel_sum_seq]
  ext a s hs
  rw [hκ_eq]
  simp_rw [Kernel.sum_apply' _ _ hs]
  change (∑' i, ∑' m, seq (κs i) m a s) = ∑' n, (fun im : ι × ℕ => seq (κs im.fst) im.snd a s) (e n)
  rw [e.tsum_eq (fun im : ι × ℕ => seq (κs im.fst) im.snd a s),
    ENNReal.summable.tsum_prod' fun _ => ENNReal.summable]

name: exists_measurable_map_eq_unitInterval_aux
statement:
private lemma exists_measurable_map_eq_unitInterval_aux (κ : Kernel X I) [IsMarkovKernel κ] :
    ∃ (f : X → I → I), Measurable (uncurry f) ∧ ∀ a, volume.map (f a) = κ a
proof:
:= by
  let f := fun s (t : I) ↦ sSup {x | (κ s).real (Icc 0 x) < t}
  have measurable_f : Measurable (uncurry f) := by
    refine measurable_of_Ioi fun a ↦ ?_
    simp only [preimage, uncurry, mem_Ioi]
    have h_monotone s : Monotone (fun x ↦ (κ s).real (Icc 0 x)) :=
      fun x y hxy ↦ measureReal_mono (by gcongr)
    have sSup_eq_iUnion_rat : {x : X × I | a < f x.1 x.2} =
        ⋃ (q : ℚ) (hqI : ↑q ∈ I) (_ : a < (q : ℝ)), {e | (κ e.1).real (Icc 0 ⟨q, hqI⟩) < e.2} := by
      ext e
      simp_all only [lt_sSup_iff, mem_ofPred_eq, Subtype.exists, mem_Icc, Rat.cast_nonneg,
        mem_iUnion, exists_prop, exists_and_left, f]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, hyI, y_mem, (hy : a.1 < y)⟩
        obtain ⟨q, hqa, hqy⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hy
        refine ⟨q, hqa, ⟨?_, hqy.le.trans hyI.2⟩, lt_of_lt_of_le' y_mem (h_monotone e.1 hqy.le)⟩
        simp [← Rat.cast_nonneg (K := ℝ), a.2.1.trans hqa.le]
      · intro he
        obtain ⟨q, hqa, hqI, h⟩ := he
        refine ⟨q, ⟨by simp [hqI.1], hqI.2⟩, h, ?_⟩
        change a.1 < q
        simp [hqa]
    rw [sSup_eq_iUnion_rat]
    refine MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun b ↦ MeasurableSet.iUnion
      (fun bI ↦ MeasurableSet.iUnion (fun _ ↦ ?_)))
    refine measurableSet_lt ?_ measurable_snd.subtype_val
    simp_rw [measureReal_def]
    have hκ := κ.measurable_coe (s := Icc 0 ⟨b, bI⟩) measurableSet_Icc
    fun_prop
  refine ⟨f, measurable_f, fun a ↦ (volume.map (f a)).ext_of_Iic (κ a) fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  have Iic_to_Icc : Iic x = Icc 0 x := by ext; simp
  have κ_in_I : ((κ a).real (Icc 0 x)) ∈ I := ⟨measureReal_nonneg, measureReal_le_one⟩
  simp_rw [volume.map_apply measurable_f.of_uncurry_left measurableSet_Iic, preimage,
    mem_Iic, Iic_to_Icc, ← ofReal_measureReal (measure_ne_top (κ a) _), ← volume_Iic ⟨_, κ_in_I⟩]
  congr with ξ
  constructor
  · intro (hξ : f a ξ ≤ x)
    change ξ ≤ (κ a).real (Icc 0 x)
    by_cases hx : x = 1
    · simp [hx, ← univ_eq_Icc, ξ.2.2]
    let g := fun y ↦ (κ a).real (Icc 0 y)
    let nebot : NeBot (𝓝[>] x) := by
      refine nhdsGT_neBot_of_exists_gt ?_
      use 1
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne x.2.2 hx
    refine le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto (b := 𝓝[>] x) (g := g) continuousWithinAt_const ?_ ?_
    · let h := cdf ((κ a).map Subtype.val)
      have h_continuousWithinAt := continuousWithinAt_Ioi_iff_Ici.mpr (h.right_continuous x)
      simp_rw [g, ← unitInterval.cdf_eq_real (κ a)]
      exact h_continuousWithinAt.comp (Continuous.continuousWithinAt (by fun_prop)) (fun y hy ↦ hy)
    · refine eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall fun y hy ↦ ?_
      by_contra! h
      simp only [sSup_le_iff, f] at hξ
      specialize hξ y h
      grind
  · intro (hξ : ξ ≤ (κ a).real (Icc 0 x))
    simp only [sSup_le_iff, f]
    intro c hc
    by_contra! h
    have h_lt : ¬ (κ a).real (Icc 0 x) ≤ (κ a).real (Icc 0 c) := not_le.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt' hξ hc)
    refine h_lt ?_
    gcongr
    simp

name: exists_measurable_map_eq_unitInterval
statement:
theorem exists_measurable_map_eq_unitInterval (κ : Kernel X Y) [IsMarkovKernel κ] :
    ∃ (f : X → I → Y), Measurable (uncurry f) ∧ ∀ a, volume.map (f a) = κ a
proof:
:= by
  let g := sigmoid ∘ embeddingReal Y
  have hg := measurableEmbedding_sigmoid_comp_embeddingReal Y
  have hκg : IsMarkovKernel (κ.map g) := IsMarkovKernel.map κ hg.measurable
  have hg'κ : κ = (κ.map g).map hg.invFun := by
    rw [← map_comp_right _ hg.measurable (by fun_prop), LeftInverse.id hg.leftInverse_invFun,
      map_id]
  obtain ⟨f', hf', hf'κ⟩ := (κ.map g).exists_measurable_map_eq_unitInterval_aux
  refine ⟨fun a u ↦ hg.invFun (f' a u), by fun_prop, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [hg'κ, map_apply _ (by fun_prop), ← hf'κ, Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  rfl

name: MeasureTheory.Measure.exists_measurable_map_eq
statement:
theorem MeasureTheory.Measure.exists_measurable_map_eq (μ : Measure Y) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] :
    ∃ (f : I → Y), Measurable f ∧ volume.map f = μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf_meas, hf_map⟩ := Kernel.exists_measurable_map_eq_unitInterval (Kernel.const Unit μ)
  specialize hf_map ()
  exact ⟨f (), by fun_prop, by simpa⟩

name: isIrreducible_of_le_measure
statement:
lemma isIrreducible_of_le_measure {φ₁ φ₂ : Measure α} (hφ : φ₁ ≤ φ₂)
    {κ : Kernel α α} [hκ : IsIrreducible φ₂ κ] :
    IsIrreducible φ₁ κ where
  irreducible s hs hsp
proof:
:= by
    simpa using hκ.irreducible hs <| Std.lt_of_lt_of_le hsp (hφ s)

name: Invariant.def
statement: theorem Invariant.def (hκ : Invariant κ μ) : μ.bind κ = μ
proof:
:=
  hκ

name: Invariant.comp
statement:
theorem Invariant.comp (hκ : Invariant κ μ) (hη : Invariant η μ) :
    Invariant (κ ∘ₖ η) μ
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α with _ | hα
  · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · rw [Invariant, ← Measure.comp_assoc, hη, hκ]

name: IsReversible.invariant
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  calc
    (κ ∘ₘ π) s = ∫⁻ x, κ x s ∂π := by rw [Measure.bind_apply hs (Kernel.aemeasurable _)]
             _ = ∫⁻ x in s, κ x Set.univ ∂π := by simpa [restrict_univ] using (h_rev hs .univ).symm
             _ = π s := by simp

name: compProd_posterior_eq_map_swap
statement: lemma compProd_posterior_eq_map_swap : (κ ∘ₘ μ) ⊗ₘ κ†μ = (μ ⊗ₘ κ).map Prod.swap
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! ((μ ⊗ₘ κ).map Prod.swap).disintegrate ((μ ⊗ₘ κ).map Prod.swap).condKernel

name: compProd_posterior_eq_swap_comp
statement: lemma compProd_posterior_eq_swap_comp : (κ ∘ₘ μ) ⊗ₘ κ†μ = Kernel.swap Ω 𝓧 ∘ₘ μ ⊗ₘ κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [compProd_posterior_eq_map_swap, Measure.swap_comp]

name: swap_compProd_posterior
statement: lemma swap_compProd_posterior : Kernel.swap 𝓧 Ω ∘ₘ (κ ∘ₘ μ) ⊗ₘ κ†μ = μ ⊗ₘ κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [compProd_posterior_eq_swap_comp, Measure.comp_assoc, Kernel.swap_swap, Measure.id_comp]

name: parallelProd_posterior_comp_copy_comp
statement:
lemma parallelProd_posterior_comp_copy_comp :
    (Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ†μ) ∘ₘ Kernel.copy 𝓧 ∘ₘ κ ∘ₘ μ
      = (κ ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ Kernel.copy Ω ∘ₘ μ
proof:
:= by
  calc (Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ†μ) ∘ₘ Kernel.copy 𝓧 ∘ₘ κ ∘ₘ μ
  _ = (κ ∘ₘ μ) ⊗ₘ κ†μ := by rw [← Measure.compProd_eq_parallelComp_comp_copy_comp]
  _ = Kernel.swap _ _ ∘ₘ (μ ⊗ₘ κ) := by rw [compProd_posterior_eq_swap_comp]
  _ = Kernel.swap _ _ ∘ₘ (Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ) ∘ₘ Kernel.copy Ω ∘ₘ μ := by
    rw [Measure.compProd_eq_parallelComp_comp_copy_comp]
  _ = (κ ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ Kernel.copy Ω ∘ₘ μ := by
    rw [Measure.comp_assoc, Kernel.swap_parallelComp, Measure.comp_assoc, Kernel.comp_assoc,
      Kernel.swap_copy, Measure.comp_assoc]

name: posterior_prod_id_comp
statement: lemma posterior_prod_id_comp : (κ†μ ×ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ κ ∘ₘ μ = μ ⊗ₘ κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Kernel.swap_prod, ← Measure.comp_assoc, ← Measure.compProd_eq_comp_prod,
    compProd_posterior_eq_swap_comp, Measure.comp_assoc, Kernel.swap_swap, Measure.id_comp]

name: ae_eq_posterior_of_compProd_eq
statement:
lemma ae_eq_posterior_of_compProd_eq {η : Kernel 𝓧 Ω} [IsFiniteKernel η]
    (h : (κ ∘ₘ μ) ⊗ₘ η = (μ ⊗ₘ κ).map Prod.swap) :
    η =ᵐ[κ ∘ₘ μ] κ†μ
proof:
:=
  (Kernel.ae_eq_of_compProd_eq (compProd_posterior_eq_map_swap.trans h.symm)).symm

name: ae_eq_posterior_of_compProd_eq_swap_comp
statement:
lemma ae_eq_posterior_of_compProd_eq_swap_comp (η : Kernel 𝓧 Ω) [IsFiniteKernel η]
    (h : ((κ ∘ₘ μ) ⊗ₘ η) = Kernel.swap Ω 𝓧 ∘ₘ μ ⊗ₘ κ) :
    η =ᵐ[κ ∘ₘ μ] κ†μ
proof:
:=
  ae_eq_posterior_of_compProd_eq <| by rw [h, Measure.swap_comp]

name: posterior_comp_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma posterior_comp_self [IsMarkovKernel κ] : κ†μ ∘ₘ κ ∘ₘ μ = μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Measure.snd_compProd, compProd_posterior_eq_map_swap, Measure.snd_map_swap,
    Measure.fst_compProd]

name: posterior_id
statement: lemma posterior_id (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] : Kernel.id†μ =ᵐ[μ] Kernel.id
proof:
:= by
  suffices Kernel.id =ᵐ[Kernel.id ∘ₘ μ] (Kernel.id : Kernel Ω Ω)†μ by
    rw [Measure.id_comp] at this
    filter_upwards [this] with a ha using ha.symm
  refine ae_eq_posterior_of_compProd_eq_swap_comp Kernel.id ?_
  rw [Measure.id_comp, Measure.compProd_id_eq_copy_comp, Measure.comp_assoc, Kernel.swap_copy]

name: deterministic_comp_posterior
statement:
lemma deterministic_comp_posterior [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated 𝓧]
    {f : Ω → 𝓧} (hf : Measurable f) :
    Kernel.deterministic f hf ∘ₖ (Kernel.deterministic f hf)†μ =ᵐ[μ.map f] Kernel.id
proof:
:= by
  refine Kernel.ae_eq_of_compProd_eq ?_
  calc μ.map f ⊗ₘ (Kernel.deterministic f hf ∘ₖ (Kernel.deterministic f hf)†μ)
  _ = (Kernel.deterministic f hf ∘ₘ μ)
      ⊗ₘ (Kernel.deterministic f hf ∘ₖ (Kernel.deterministic f hf)†μ) := by
    rw [Measure.deterministic_comp_eq_map]
  _ = (Kernel.id ∥ₖ Kernel.deterministic f hf) ∘ₘ (Kernel.id ∥ₖ (Kernel.deterministic f hf)†μ) ∘ₘ
      Kernel.copy 𝓧 ∘ₘ Kernel.deterministic f hf ∘ₘ μ := by
    rw [Measure.compProd_eq_parallelComp_comp_copy_comp,
      ← Kernel.parallelComp_id_left_comp_parallelComp, ← Measure.comp_assoc]
  _ = (Kernel.id ∥ₖ Kernel.deterministic f hf) ∘ₘ (Kernel.deterministic f hf ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ
      Kernel.copy Ω ∘ₘ μ := by rw [parallelProd_posterior_comp_copy_comp]
  _ = (Kernel.deterministic f hf ∥ₖ Kernel.deterministic f hf) ∘ₘ Kernel.copy Ω ∘ₘ μ := by
    rw [Measure.comp_assoc, Kernel.parallelComp_comp_parallelComp, Kernel.id_comp, Kernel.comp_id]
  _ = (Kernel.copy 𝓧 ∘ₖ Kernel.deterministic f hf) ∘ₘ μ := by 
    rw [Measure.comp_assoc, Kernel.parallelComp_self_comp_copy]
  _ = μ.map f ⊗ₘ Kernel.id := by
    rw [Measure.compProd_id_eq_copy_comp, ← Measure.comp_assoc,
      Measure.deterministic_comp_eq_map]

name: absolutelyContinuous_posterior
statement:
lemma absolutelyContinuous_posterior {ν : Measure 𝓧} [SFinite ν] (h_ac : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, κ ω ≪ ν) :
    ∀ᵐ b ∂(κ ∘ₘ μ), (κ†μ) b ≪ μ
proof:
:= by
  suffices (κ ∘ₘ μ) ⊗ₘ (κ†μ) ≪ ν.prod μ by
    rw [← Measure.compProd_const] at this
    simpa using this.kernel_of_compProd
  suffices μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ μ.prod ν by
    rw [compProd_posterior_eq_map_swap, ← Measure.prod_swap]
    exact this.map measurable_swap
  rw [← Measure.compProd_const]
  refine Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd_right ?_
  simpa

name: posterior_posterior
statement: lemma posterior_posterior [IsMarkovKernel κ] : (κ†μ)†(κ ∘ₘ μ) =ᵐ[μ] κ
proof:
:= by
  suffices κ =ᵐ[κ†μ ∘ₘ κ ∘ₘ μ] (κ†μ)†(κ ∘ₘ μ) by
    rw [posterior_comp_self] at this
    filter_upwards [this] with a h using h.symm
  refine ae_eq_posterior_of_compProd_eq_swap_comp κ ?_
  rw [posterior_comp_self, compProd_posterior_eq_swap_comp, Measure.comp_assoc,
    Kernel.swap_swap, Measure.id_comp]

name: posterior_comp
statement:
lemma posterior_comp {η : Kernel 𝓧 𝓨} [IsFiniteKernel η] :
    (η ∘ₖ κ)†μ =ᵐ[η ∘ₘ κ ∘ₘ μ] κ†μ ∘ₖ η†(κ ∘ₘ μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.comp_assoc]
  refine (ae_eq_posterior_of_compProd_eq_swap_comp ((κ†μ) ∘ₖ η†(κ ∘ₘ μ)) ?_).symm
  simp_rw [Measure.compProd_eq_comp_prod, ← Kernel.parallelComp_comp_copy,
    ← Kernel.parallelComp_id_left_comp_parallelComp, ← Measure.comp_assoc]
  calc (Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ†μ) ∘ₘ (Kernel.id ∥ₖ η†(κ ∘ₘ μ)) ∘ₘ (Kernel.copy 𝓨) ∘ₘ η ∘ₘ κ ∘ₘ μ
  _ = (Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ†μ) ∘ₘ (η ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ Kernel.copy 𝓧 ∘ₘ κ ∘ₘ μ := by
    rw [parallelProd_posterior_comp_copy_comp]
  _ = (η ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ (Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ†μ) ∘ₘ Kernel.copy 𝓧 ∘ₘ κ ∘ₘ μ := by
    rw [Measure.comp_assoc, Kernel.parallelComp_comm, ← Measure.comp_assoc]
  _ = (η ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ (κ ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ Kernel.copy Ω ∘ₘ μ := by
    rw [parallelProd_posterior_comp_copy_comp]
  _ = (Kernel.swap _ _) ∘ₘ (Kernel.id ∥ₖ η) ∘ₘ (Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ) ∘ₘ Kernel.copy Ω ∘ₘ μ := by
    simp_rw [Measure.comp_assoc]
    conv_rhs => rw [← Kernel.comp_assoc]
    rw [Kernel.swap_parallelComp, Kernel.comp_assoc, ← Kernel.comp_assoc (Kernel.swap Ω 𝓧),
      Kernel.swap_parallelComp, Kernel.comp_assoc, Kernel.swap_copy]

name: absolutelyContinuous_of_posterior
statement:
lemma absolutelyContinuous_of_posterior (h_ac : ∀ᵐ b ∂(κ ∘ₘ μ), (κ†μ) b ≪ μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, κ ω ≪ κ ∘ₘ μ
proof:
:= by
  suffices μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ μ.prod (κ ∘ₘ μ) by
    rw [← Measure.compProd_const] at this
    simpa using this.kernel_of_compProd
  suffices (κ ∘ₘ μ) ⊗ₘ κ†μ ≪ (κ ∘ₘ μ).prod μ by
    rw [← swap_compProd_posterior, ← Measure.prod_swap, Measure.swap_comp]
    exact this.map measurable_swap
  rw [← Measure.compProd_const]
  refine Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd_right ?_
  simpa

name: absolutelyContinuous_posterior_iff
statement: lemma absolutelyContinuous_posterior_iff : (∀ᵐ b ∂(κ ∘ₘ μ), (κ†μ) b ≪ μ) ↔ ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, κ ω ≪ κ ∘ₘ μ
proof:
:=
  ⟨absolutelyContinuous_of_posterior, absolutelyContinuous_posterior⟩

name: Kernel.absolutelyContinuous_comp_of_absolutelyContinuous
statement:
lemma Kernel.absolutelyContinuous_comp_of_absolutelyContinuous {ν : Measure 𝓧} [SFinite ν]
    (h_ac : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, κ ω ≪ ν) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, κ ω ≪ κ ∘ₘ μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← absolutelyContinuous_posterior_iff]
  exact absolutelyContinuous_posterior h_ac

name: rnDeriv_posterior_ae_prod
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_posterior_ae_prod (h_ac : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, κ ω ≪ κ ∘ₘ μ) :
    ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod (κ ∘ₘ μ)),
      (κ†μ).rnDeriv (Kernel.const _ μ) p.2 p.1 = κ.rnDeriv (Kernel.const _ (κ ∘ₘ μ)) p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  
  have h1 {s : Set Ω} {t : Set 𝓧} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
      ∫⁻ x in s ×ˢ t, (κ†μ).rnDeriv (Kernel.const _ μ) x.2 x.1 ∂μ.prod (⇑κ ∘ₘ μ)
        = (μ ⊗ₘ κ) (s ×ˢ t) := by
    rw [setLIntegral_prod_symm _ (by fun_prop), ← swap_compProd_posterior, Measure.swap_comp,
      Measure.map_apply measurable_swap (hs.prod ht), Set.preimage_swap_prod,
      Measure.compProd_apply_prod ht hs]
    refine lintegral_congr_ae <| ae_restrict_of_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [absolutelyContinuous_posterior h_ac] with x h_ac'
    change ∫⁻ ω in s, (κ†μ).rnDeriv (Kernel.const 𝓧 μ) x ω ∂(Kernel.const 𝓧 μ x) = _
    rw [Kernel.setLIntegral_rnDeriv h_ac' hs]
  have h2 {s : Set Ω} {t : Set 𝓧} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (ht : MeasurableSet t) :
  
      ∫⁻ x in s ×ˢ t, κ.rnDeriv (Kernel.const _ (κ ∘ₘ μ)) x.1 x.2 ∂μ.prod (⇑κ ∘ₘ μ)
        = (μ ⊗ₘ κ) (s ×ˢ t) := by
    rw [setLIntegral_prod _ (by fun_prop), Measure.compProd_apply_prod hs ht]
    refine lintegral_congr_ae <| ae_restrict_of_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [h_ac] with ω h_ac
    change ∫⁻ x in t, κ.rnDeriv (Kernel.const Ω (κ ∘ₘ μ)) ω x ∂(Kernel.const Ω (κ ∘ₘ μ) ω) = _
    rw [Kernel.setLIntegral_rnDeriv h_ac ht]
  
  refine ae_eq_of_setLIntegral_prod_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) ?_ ?_
  · refine ne_of_lt ?_
    calc ∫⁻ x, (κ†μ).rnDeriv (Kernel.const _ μ) x.2 x.1 ∂μ.prod (κ ∘ₘ μ)
    _ = (μ ⊗ₘ κ) Set.univ := by rw [← setLIntegral_univ, ← Set.univ_prod_univ, h1 .univ .univ]
    _ < ⊤ := measure_lt_top _ _
  · intro s hs t ht
    rw [h1 hs ht, h2 hs ht]

name: rnDeriv_posterior
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_posterior (h_ac : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, κ ω ≪ κ ∘ₘ μ) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, ∀ᵐ x ∂(κ ∘ₘ μ),
      (κ†μ).rnDeriv (Kernel.const _ μ) x ω = κ.rnDeriv (Kernel.const _ (κ ∘ₘ μ)) ω x
proof:
:= by
  convert!
    Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod
      (rnDeriv_posterior_ae_prod h_ac)

name: rnDeriv_posterior_symm
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_posterior_symm (h_ac : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, κ ω ≪ κ ∘ₘ μ) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(κ ∘ₘ μ), ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ,
      (κ†μ).rnDeriv (Kernel.const _ μ) x ω = κ.rnDeriv (Kernel.const _ (κ ∘ₘ μ)) ω x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.ae_ae_comm]
  · exact rnDeriv_posterior h_ac
  · measurability

name: posterior_eq_withDensity
statement:
lemma posterior_eq_withDensity (h_ac : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, κ ω ≪ κ ∘ₘ μ) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(κ ∘ₘ μ), (κ†μ) x = μ.withDensity (fun ω ↦ κ.rnDeriv (Kernel.const _ (κ ∘ₘ μ)) ω x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [rnDeriv_posterior_symm h_ac, absolutelyContinuous_posterior h_ac] with x h h_ac'
  ext s hs
  rw [← Measure.setLIntegral_rnDeriv h_ac', withDensity_apply _ hs]
  refine setLIntegral_congr_fun_ae hs ?_
  filter_upwards [h, Kernel.rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure (κ := κ†μ) (η := Kernel.const 𝓧 μ) (a := x)]
    with ω h h_eq hωs
  rw [← h, h_eq, Kernel.const_apply]

name: posterior_eq_withDensity_of_countable
statement:
lemma posterior_eq_withDensity_of_countable {Ω : Type*} [Countable Ω] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    [Nonempty Ω] [StandardBorelSpace Ω] (κ : Kernel Ω 𝓧) [IsFiniteKernel κ]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂(κ ∘ₘ μ), (κ†μ) x = μ.withDensity (fun ω ↦ (κ ω).rnDeriv (κ ∘ₘ μ) x)
proof:
:= by
  have h_rnDeriv ω := Kernel.rnDeriv_eq_rnDeriv_measure (κ := κ) (η := Kernel.const Ω (κ ∘ₘ μ))
    (a := ω)
  simp only [Filter.EventuallyEq, Kernel.const_apply] at h_rnDeriv
  rw [← ae_all_iff] at h_rnDeriv
  filter_upwards [posterior_eq_withDensity Measure.absolutelyContinuous_comp_of_countable,
    h_rnDeriv] with x hx hx_all
  simp_rw [hx, hx_all]

name: posterior_boolKernel_apply_false
statement:
lemma posterior_boolKernel_apply_false (μ ν : Measure 𝓧) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (π : Measure Bool) [IsFiniteMeasure π] :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂Kernel.boolKernel μ ν ∘ₘ π, ((Kernel.boolKernel μ ν)†π) x {false}
      = π {false} * μ.rnDeriv (Kernel.boolKernel μ ν ∘ₘ π) x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [posterior_eq_withDensity_of_countable (Kernel.boolKernel μ ν) π] with x hx
  rw [hx]
  simp

name: posterior_boolKernel_apply_true
statement:
lemma posterior_boolKernel_apply_true (μ ν : Measure 𝓧) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (π : Measure Bool) [IsFiniteMeasure π] :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂Kernel.boolKernel μ ν ∘ₘ π, ((Kernel.boolKernel μ ν)†π) x {true}
      = π {true} * ν.rnDeriv (Kernel.boolKernel μ ν ∘ₘ π) x
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [posterior_eq_withDensity_of_countable (Kernel.boolKernel μ ν) π] with x hx
  rw [hx]
  simp

name: measurableSet_predictable_singleton_bot_prod
statement:
lemma measurableSet_predictable_singleton_bot_prod [LinearOrder ι] [OrderBot ι]
    {𝓕 : Filtration ι m} {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet[𝓕 ⊥] s) :
    MeasurableSet[𝓕.predictable] <| {⊥} ×ˢ s
proof:
:=
  MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom <| Or.inl ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩

name: measurableSet_predictable_Ioi_prod
statement:
lemma measurableSet_predictable_Ioi_prod [LinearOrder ι] [OrderBot ι]
    {𝓕 : Filtration ι m} {i : ι} {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet[𝓕 i] s) :
    MeasurableSet[𝓕.predictable] <| Set.Ioi i ×ˢ s
proof:
:=
  MeasurableSpace.measurableSet_generateFrom <| Or.inr ⟨i, s, hs, rfl⟩

name: measurableSet_predictable_Ioc_prod
statement:
lemma measurableSet_predictable_Ioc_prod [LinearOrder ι] [OrderBot ι]
    {𝓕 : Filtration ι m} (i j : ι) {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet[𝓕 i] s) :
    MeasurableSet[𝓕.predictable] <| Set.Ioc i j ×ˢ s
proof:
:= by
  obtain hij | hij := le_total j i
  · simp [hij]
  · rw [← Set.Ioi_sdiff_Ioi, (by simp : (Set.Ioi i \ Set.Ioi j) ×ˢ s
      = Set.Ioi i ×ˢ (s \ s) ∪ (Set.Ioi i \ Set.Ioi j) ×ˢ s), ← Set.prod_sdiff_prod]
    exact (measurableSet_predictable_Ioi_prod hs).diff
      (measurableSet_predictable_Ioi_prod <| 𝓕.mono hij _ hs)

name: measurableSet_predictable_singleton_prod
statement:
lemma measurableSet_predictable_singleton_prod
    {𝓕 : Filtration ℕ m} {n : ℕ} {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet[𝓕 n] s) :
    MeasurableSet[𝓕.predictable] <| {n + 1} ×ˢ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [(_ : {n + 1} = Set.Ioc n (n + 1))]
  · exact measurableSet_predictable_Ioc_prod _ _ hs
  · ext m
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_Ioc]
    lia

name: measurableSet_prodMk_add_one_of_predictable
proof:
:= by
  rw [(by aesop : {ω | (n + 1, ω) ∈ s} = (Prod.mk (α := Set.singleton (n + 1)) (β := Ω)
      ⟨n + 1, rfl⟩) ⁻¹' ((fun (p : Set.singleton (n + 1) × Ω) ↦ ((p.1 : ℕ), p.2)) ⁻¹' s))]
  refine measurableSet_preimage (mβ := Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.prod (𝓕 n))
    measurable_prodMk_left <| measurableSet_preimage ?_ hs
  rw [measurable_iff_comap_le, MeasurableSpace.comap_le_iff_le_map]
  refine MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_le ?_
  rintro - (⟨A, hA, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, A, hA, rfl⟩)
  · rw [MeasurableSpace.map_def,
      (_ : (fun (p : Set.singleton (n + 1) × Ω) ↦ ((p.1 : ℕ), p.2)) ⁻¹' ({⊥} ×ˢ A) = ∅)]
    · simp
    · ext p
      simp only [Nat.bot_eq_zero, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
        Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and]
      exact fun hp1 ↦ False.elim <| Nat.succ_ne_zero n (hp1 ▸ p.1.2.symm)
  · rw [MeasurableSpace.map_def]
    obtain hni | hin := lt_or_ge n i
    · rw [(_ : (fun (p : Set.singleton (n + 1) × Ω) ↦ ((p.1 : ℕ), p.2)) ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi i ×ˢ A) = ∅)]
      · simp
      · ext p
        simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Ioi, Set.mem_empty_iff_false,
          iff_false, not_and]
        rw [p.1.2]
        grind
    · rw [(_ : (fun (p : Set.singleton (n + 1) × Ω) ↦ ((p.1 : ℕ), p.2)) ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi i ×ˢ A)
          = {⟨n + 1, rfl⟩} ×ˢ A)]
      · exact MeasurableSet.prod (MeasurableSet.of_subtype_image trivial) (𝓕.mono hin _ hA)
      · ext p
        simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_Ioi, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
          and_congr_left_iff]
        intro hp2
        rw [p.1.2]
        exact ⟨fun _ ↦ by aesop, fun _ ↦ lt_add_one_iff.2 hin⟩

name: measurableSpace_le_predictable_of_measurableSet
statement:
lemma measurableSpace_le_predictable_of_measurableSet [Preorder ι] [OrderBot ι]
    {𝓕 : Filtration ι m} {m' : MeasurableSpace (ι × Ω)}
    (hm'bot : ∀ A, MeasurableSet[𝓕 ⊥] A → MeasurableSet[m'] ({⊥} ×ˢ A))
    (hm' : ∀ i A, MeasurableSet[𝓕 i] A → MeasurableSet[m'] ((Set.Ioi i) ×ˢ A)) :
    𝓕.predictable ≤ m'
proof:
:= by
  refine MeasurableSpace.generateFrom_le ?_
  rintro - (⟨A, hA, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, A, hA, rfl⟩)
  · exact hm'bot A hA
  · exact hm' i A hA

name: measurable_inclusion_predictable
statement:
lemma measurable_inclusion_predictable [LinearOrder ι] [OrderBot ι] [MeasurableSpace ι]
    [TopologicalSpace ι] [OpensMeasurableSpace ι] [OrderClosedTopology ι] {𝓕 : Filtration ι m} {i} :
    @Measurable (Set.Iic i × Ω) (ι × Ω) (Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.prod (𝓕 i)) 𝓕.predictable
    fun x ↦ ⟨x.1.val, x.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [measurable_iff_comap_le]
  refine MeasurableSpace.comap_le_iff_le_map.2 <|
    measurableSpace_le_predictable_of_measurableSet ?_ ?_
  · intros A hA
    simp only [MeasurableSpace.map_def,
      (by aesop : (fun (p : Set.Iic i × Ω) ↦ ((p.1 : ι), p.2)) ⁻¹' ({⊥} ×ˢ A) = {⊥} ×ˢ A)]
    exact (measurableSet_singleton _).prod <| 𝓕.mono bot_le _ hA
  · intros j A hA
    simp only [MeasurableSpace.map_def]
    obtain hji | hij := le_total j i
    · rw [(by grind : (fun (p : Set.Iic i × Ω) ↦ ((p.1 : ι), p.2)) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi j ×ˢ A
        = (Subtype.val ⁻¹' (Set.Ioc j i)) ×ˢ A)]
      exact (measurable_subtype_coe measurableSet_Ioc).prod (𝓕.mono hji _ hA)
    · simp [(by grind : (fun (p : Set.Iic i × Ω) ↦ ((p.1 : ι), p.2)) ⁻¹' Set.Ioi j ×ˢ A = ∅)]

name: isStronglyProgressive
statement:
lemma isStronglyProgressive {𝓕 : Filtration ι m} {u : ι → Ω → E} (h𝓕 : IsStronglyPredictable 𝓕 u) :
    IsStronglyProgressive 𝓕 u
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  let : MeasurableSpace (ι × Ω) := 𝓕.predictable
  let : MeasurableSpace (Set.Iic i × Ω) := Subtype.instMeasurableSpace.prod (𝓕 i)
  let X m (x : Set.Iic i × Ω) := h𝓕.approx m ⟨x.1, x.2⟩
  refine ⟨fun m ↦ SimpleFunc.mk (X m) ?_ ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun e ↦ measurable_inclusion_predictable <| (h𝓕.approx m).measurableSet_fiber e
  · exact Set.Finite.subset (h𝓕.approx m).finite_range (by grind)
  · exact fun n ↦ by apply h𝓕.tendsto_approx

name: stronglyAdapted
statement:
lemma stronglyAdapted {𝓕 : Filtration ι m} {u : ι → Ω → E} (h𝓕 : IsStronglyPredictable 𝓕 u) :
    StronglyAdapted 𝓕 u
proof:
:=
  h𝓕.isStronglyProgressive.stronglyAdapted

name: measurable_add_one
statement:
lemma measurable_add_one {𝓕 : Filtration ℕ m} {u : ℕ → Ω → E}
    (h𝓕 : IsStronglyPredictable 𝓕 u) (n : ℕ) : StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 n] (u (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let : MeasurableSpace (ℕ × Ω) := 𝓕.predictable
  let : MeasurableSpace Ω := 𝓕 n
  let X m := (Function.curry (h𝓕.approx m) (n + 1))
  refine ⟨(fun m ↦ SimpleFunc.mk (X m) ?_ ?_), (fun ω ↦ h𝓕.tendsto_approx ⟨(n + 1), ω⟩)⟩
  · intro s
    rw [(by aesop : X m ⁻¹' {s} = {ω | (n + 1, ω) ∈ h𝓕.approx m ⁻¹' {s}})]
    apply measurableSet_prodMk_add_one_of_predictable
    apply (h𝓕.approx m).measurableSet_fiber
  · apply (h𝓕.approx m).finite_range.subset
    rw [Set.range_subset_iff]
    aesop

name: of_measurable_add_one
proof:
:= by
  let : MeasurableSpace (ℕ × Ω) := 𝓕.predictable
  
  let X m (x : ℕ × Ω) := match x.1 with
    | 0 => h₀.approx m x.2
    | n + 1 => (h n).approx m x.2
  
  let Y m (x : ℕ × Ω) := if x.1 ≤ m then X m x else X m ⟨0, x.2⟩
  refine ⟨fun m ↦ SimpleFunc.mk (Y m) ?_ ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s
    rw [(by aesop : Y m ⁻¹' {s} = ⋃ n : ℕ, {n} ×ˢ ((Function.curry (Y m) n) ⁻¹' {s}))]
    refine MeasurableSet.iUnion <| fun n ↦ ?_
    rcases n with rfl | n
    · apply measurableSet_predictable_singleton_bot_prod
      let : MeasurableSpace Ω := 𝓕 0
      exact (h₀.approx m).measurableSet_fiber s
    · apply measurableSet_predictable_singleton_prod
      by_cases! hmk : n + 1 ≤ m
      · rw [(by aesop : Function.curry (Y m) (n + 1) = Function.curry (X m) (n + 1))]
        let : MeasurableSpace Ω := 𝓕 n
        exact ((h n).approx m).measurableSet_fiber s
      · rw [(by aesop : Function.curry (Y m) (n + 1) = Function.curry (X m) 0)]
        apply 𝓕.mono (i := 0) (by simp)
        let : MeasurableSpace Ω := 𝓕 0
        exact (h₀.approx m).measurableSet_fiber s
  · apply Set.Finite.subset (s := ⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), Set.range (Function.curry (X m) k))
    · refine Set.Finite.biUnion' (by aesop) (fun n hn ↦ ?_)
      rcases n with rfl | n
      · exact @(h₀.approx m).finite_range
      · exact @((h n).approx m).finite_range
    · intro e he
      obtain ⟨⟨n, ω⟩, hnω⟩ := Set.mem_range.mp he
      simp_rw [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_range]
      exact ⟨if n ≤ m then n else 0, by aesop, ω, by aesop⟩
  · intro ⟨n, ω⟩
    rw [tendsto_congr' (f₂ := fun m ↦ X m ⟨n, ω⟩)]
    · rcases n with rfl | n
      · exact h₀.tendsto_approx ω
      · exact (h n).tendsto_approx ω
    · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop n] with m hm using by simp; grind

name: iff_measurable_add_one
statement:
lemma iff_measurable_add_one {𝓕 : Filtration ℕ m} {u : ℕ → Ω → E} :
    IsStronglyPredictable 𝓕 u ↔
    StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 0] (u 0) ∧ ∀ n, StronglyMeasurable[𝓕 n] (u (n + 1))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h𝓕 ↦ ⟨h𝓕.isStronglyProgressive.stronglyAdapted 0, h𝓕.measurable_add_one⟩,
    fun h ↦ .of_measurable_add_one h.1 h.2⟩

name: mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem mul [∀ i, Mul (β i)] [∀ i, MeasurableMul₂ (β i)]
    (hu : Adapted f u) (hv : Adapted f v) :
    Adapted f (u * v)
proof: := fun i => (hu i).mul (hv i)

name: div
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem div [∀ i, Div (β i)] [∀ i, MeasurableDiv₂ (β i)]
    (hu : Adapted f u) (hv : Adapted f v) :
    Adapted f (u / v)
proof: := fun i => (hu i).div (hv i)

name: inv
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem inv [∀ i, Group (β i)] [∀ i, MeasurableInv (β i)] (hu : Adapted f u) :
    Adapted f u⁻¹
proof: := fun i => (hu i).inv

name: smul
statement:
protected theorem smul {𝕂 : Type*} [MeasurableSpace 𝕂]
    [∀ i, SMul 𝕂 (β i)] [∀ i, MeasurableSMul 𝕂 (β i)] (c : 𝕂) (hu : Adapted f u) :
    Adapted f (c • u)
proof: := fun i => (hu i).const_smul c

name: measurable
statement: protected theorem measurable {i : ι} (hf : Adapted f u) : Measurable[m] (u i)

  (hf i).mono (f.le i) (by rfl)

name: measurable_le

name: Filtration.stronglyAdapted_natural
statement:
theorem Filtration.stronglyAdapted_natural [∀ i, MetrizableSpace (β i)]
    [mβ : ∀ i, MeasurableSpace (β i)] [∀ i, BorelSpace (β i)]
    (hum : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable[m] (u i)) :
    StronglyAdapted (Filtration.natural u hum) u
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  refine StronglyMeasurable.mono ?_ (le_iSup₂_of_le i (le_refl i) le_rfl)
  rw [stronglyMeasurable_iff_measurable_separable]
  exact ⟨measurable_iff_comap_le.2 le_rfl, (hum i).isSeparable_range⟩

name: isProgressive_const
statement:
theorem isProgressive_const {mi : MeasurableSpace ι} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} (f : Filtration ι m)
    (b : β) : IsProgressive f (fun _ _ => b : ι → Ω → β)
proof:
:=
  fun _ ↦ by exact measurable_const

name: adapted
statement: protected theorem adapted (h : IsProgressive f u) : Adapted f u
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have : u i = (fun p : Set.Iic i × Ω => u p.1 p.2) ∘ fun x => (⟨i, Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl⟩, x) :=
    rfl
  rw [this]
  exact (h i).comp measurable_prodMk_left

name: comp
statement:
protected theorem comp {t : ι → Ω → ι} (h : IsProgressive f u) (ht : IsProgressive f t)
    (ht_le : ∀ i ω, t i ω ≤ i) :
    IsProgressive f fun i ω => u (t i ω) ω
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have : (fun p : ↥(Set.Iic i) × Ω => u (t (p.fst : ι) p.snd) p.snd) =
    (fun p : ↥(Set.Iic i) × Ω => u (p.fst : ι) p.snd) ∘ fun p : ↥(Set.Iic i) × Ω =>
      (⟨t (p.fst : ι) p.snd, Set.mem_Iic.mpr ((ht_le _ _).trans p.fst.prop)⟩, p.snd) := rfl
  rw [this]
  exact (h i).comp ((ht i).subtype_mk.prodMk measurable_snd)

name: mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem mul [Mul β] [MeasurableMul₂ β] (hu : IsProgressive f u)
    (hv : IsProgressive f v) : IsProgressive f fun i ω ↦  (u i ω * v i ω)
proof:
:=
  fun i ↦ Measurable.mul (hu i) (hv i)

name: finsetProd
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem finsetProd {γ} [CommMonoid β] [MeasurableMul₂ β] {U : γ → ι → Ω → β}

    IsProgressive f fun i ω ↦ ∏ c ∈ s, U c i ω
proof:
:=
  fun i ↦ s.measurable_prod fun c hc ↦ h c hc i

name: inv
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem inv [Group β] [MeasurableInv β] (hu : IsProgressive f u) :

name: div

name: stronglyAdapted
statement: protected theorem stronglyAdapted (h : IsStronglyProgressive f u) : StronglyAdapted f u
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have : u i = (fun p : Set.Iic i × Ω => u p.1 p.2) ∘ fun x => (⟨i, Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl⟩, x) :=
    rfl
  rw [this]
  exact (h i).comp_measurable measurable_prodMk_left

name: comp
statement:
protected theorem comp {t : ι → Ω → ι} [TopologicalSpace ι] [BorelSpace ι] [PseudoMetrizableSpace ι]
    (h : IsStronglyProgressive f u) (ht : IsStronglyProgressive f t) (ht_le : ∀ i ω, t i ω ≤ i) :
    IsStronglyProgressive f fun i ω => u (t i ω) ω
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have : (fun p : ↥(Set.Iic i) × Ω => u (t (p.fst : ι) p.snd) p.snd) =
    (fun p : ↥(Set.Iic i) × Ω => u (p.fst : ι) p.snd) ∘ fun p : ↥(Set.Iic i) × Ω =>
      (⟨t (p.fst : ι) p.snd, Set.mem_Iic.mpr ((ht_le _ _).trans p.fst.prop)⟩, p.snd) := rfl
  rw [this]
  exact (h i).comp_measurable ((ht i).measurable.subtype_mk.prodMk measurable_snd)

name: mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem mul [Mul β] [ContinuousMul β] (hu : IsStronglyProgressive f u)

name: finsetProd'
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem finsetProd' {γ} [CommMonoid β] [ContinuousMul β] {U : γ → ι → Ω → β}

    IsStronglyProgressive f (∏ c ∈ s, U c)
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_induction U (IsStronglyProgressive f) (fun _ _ => .mul)
    (isStronglyProgressive_const _ 1) h

name: finsetProd
statement:
@[to_additive]
protected theorem finsetProd {γ} [CommMonoid β] [ContinuousMul β] {U : γ → ι → Ω → β}

    IsStronglyProgressive f fun i a => ∏ c ∈ s, U c i a

:= by
  convert! IsStronglyProgressive.finsetProd' h using 1; ext (i a); simp only [Finset.prod_apply]

lemma IsStronglyProgressive.isProgressive {mi : MeasurableSpace ι} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β}

name: isStronglyProgressive_of_tendsto'
statement:
theorem isStronglyProgressive_of_tendsto' {γ} [MeasurableSpace ι] [PseudoMetrizableSpace β]
    (fltr : Filter γ) [fltr.NeBot] [fltr.IsCountablyGenerated] {U : γ → ι → Ω → β}
    (h : ∀ l, IsStronglyProgressive f (U l)) (h_tendsto : Tendsto U fltr (𝓝 u)) :
    IsStronglyProgressive f u
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  apply @stronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto (Set.Iic i × Ω) β γ
    (MeasurableSpace.prod _ (f i)) _ _ fltr _ _ _ _ fun l => h l i
  rw [tendsto_pi_nhds] at h_tendsto ⊢
  exact fun _ ↦ Tendsto.apply_nhds (h_tendsto _) _

name: isStronglyProgressive_of_tendsto

theorem Filtration.condExp_condExp [Preorder ι] {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
