name: _root_.MeasureTheory.Measure.condKernel_apply_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma _root_.MeasureTheory.Measure.condKernel_apply_of_ne_zero [MeasurableSingletonClass α]
    {x : α} (hx : ρ.fst {x} ≠ 0) (s : Set Ω) :
    ρ.condKernel x s = (ρ.fst {x})⁻¹ * ρ ({x} ×ˢ s)
proof:
:=
  Measure.IsCondKernel.apply_of_ne_zero _ _ hx _

name: comp_apply
statement: theorem comp_apply (η : Kernel β γ) (κ : Kernel α β) (a : α) : (η ∘ₖ κ) a = (κ a).bind η
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: comp_apply'
statement:
theorem comp_apply' (η : Kernel β γ) (κ : Kernel α β) (a : α) {s : Set γ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (η ∘ₖ κ) a s = ∫⁻ b, η b s ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_apply, Measure.bind_apply hs (Kernel.aemeasurable _)]

name: comp_apply_univ_le
statement:
theorem comp_apply_univ_le (κ : Kernel α β) (η : Kernel β γ) (a : α) :
    (η ∘ₖ κ) a Set.univ ≤ κ a Set.univ * η.bound
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_apply' _ _ _ .univ]
  let Cη := η.bound
  calc
    ∫⁻ b, η b Set.univ ∂κ a ≤ ∫⁻ _, Cη ∂κ a :=
      lintegral_mono fun b => measure_le_bound η b Set.univ
    _ = Cη * κ a Set.univ := MeasureTheory.lintegral_const Cη
    _ = κ a Set.univ * Cη := mul_comm _ _

name: zero_comp
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_comp (κ : Kernel α β) : (0 : Kernel β γ) ∘ₖ κ = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [comp_apply, FunLike.coe_zero]

name: comp_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma comp_zero (κ : Kernel β γ) : κ ∘ₖ (0 : Kernel α β) = 0
proof: := by ext; simp [comp_apply]

name: id_comp
statement: @[simp] lemma id_comp (κ : Kernel α β) : Kernel.id ∘ₖ κ = κ
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  simpa [comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, id_apply, Measure.dirac_apply' _ hs]
    using lintegral_indicator_one hs

name: comp_id
statement: @[simp] lemma comp_id (κ : Kernel β γ) : κ ∘ₖ Kernel.id = κ
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  simp [comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, id_apply,
    lintegral_dirac' a <| κ.measurable_coe hs]

name: ae_lt_top_of_comp_ne_top
statement: theorem ae_lt_top_of_comp_ne_top (a : α) (hs : (η ∘ₖ κ) a s ≠ ∞) : ∀ᵐ b ∂κ a, η b s < ∞
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ᵐ b ∂κ a, η b (toMeasurable ((η ∘ₖ κ) a) s) < ∞ := by
    refine ae_lt_top (Kernel.measurable_coe η (measurableSet_toMeasurable ..)) ?_
    rwa [← Kernel.comp_apply' _ _ _ (measurableSet_toMeasurable ..), measure_toMeasurable]
  filter_upwards [h] with b hb using (measure_mono (subset_toMeasurable _ _)).trans_lt hb

name: comp_null
statement:
theorem comp_null (a : α) (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (η ∘ₖ κ) a s = 0 ↔ (fun y ↦ η y s) =ᵐ[κ a] 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, lintegral_eq_zero_iff (η.measurable_coe hs)]

name: ae_null_of_comp_null
statement: theorem ae_null_of_comp_null (h : (η ∘ₖ κ) a s = 0) : (η · s) =ᵐ[κ a] 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hst, mt, ht⟩ := exists_measurable_superset_of_null h
  simp_rw [comp_null a mt] at ht
  rw [Filter.eventuallyLE_antisymm_iff]
  exact ⟨Filter.EventuallyLE.trans_eq (ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ measure_mono hst) ht,
    ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ zero_le⟩

name: ae_ae_of_ae_comp
statement:
theorem ae_ae_of_ae_comp (h : ∀ᵐ z ∂(η ∘ₖ κ) a, p z) :
    ∀ᵐ y ∂κ a, ∀ᵐ z ∂η y, p z
proof: := ae_null_of_comp_null h

name: ae_comp_of_ae_ae
statement:
lemma ae_comp_of_ae_ae (hp : MeasurableSet {z | p z})
    (h : ∀ᵐ y ∂κ a, ∀ᵐ z ∂η y, p z) : ∀ᵐ z ∂(η ∘ₖ κ) a, p z
proof:
:= by
  rwa [ae_iff, comp_null] at *
  exact hp.compl

name: ae_comp_iff
statement:
lemma ae_comp_iff (hp : MeasurableSet {z | p z}) :
    (∀ᵐ z ∂(η ∘ₖ κ) a, p z) ↔ ∀ᵐ y ∂κ a, ∀ᵐ z ∂η y, p z
proof:
:=
  ⟨ae_ae_of_ae_comp, ae_comp_of_ae_ae hp⟩

name: comp_restrict
statement:
theorem comp_restrict {s : Set γ} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    η.restrict hs ∘ₖ κ = (η ∘ₖ κ).restrict hs
proof:
:= by
  ext a t ht
  simp_rw [comp_apply' _ _ _ ht, restrict_apply' _ _ _ ht, comp_apply' _ _ _ (ht.inter hs)]

name: lintegral_comp
statement:
theorem lintegral_comp (η : Kernel β γ) (κ : Kernel α β) (a : α) {g : γ → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hg : Measurable g) : ∫⁻ c, g c ∂(η ∘ₖ κ) a = ∫⁻ b, ∫⁻ c, g c ∂η b ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_apply, Measure.lintegral_bind (Kernel.aemeasurable _) hg.aemeasurable]

name: comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc {δ : Type*} {mδ : MeasurableSpace δ} (ξ : Kernel γ δ)
    (η : Kernel β γ) (κ : Kernel α β) : ξ ∘ₖ η ∘ₖ κ = ξ ∘ₖ (η ∘ₖ κ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_fun fun a f hf => ?_
  simp_rw [lintegral_comp _ _ _ hf, lintegral_comp _ _ _ hf.lintegral_kernel]

name: comp_discard'
statement:
lemma comp_discard' (κ : Kernel α β) :
    discard β ∘ₖ κ =
      { toFun a := κ a .univ • Measure.dirac PUnit.unit
        measurable' := (κ.measurable_coe .univ).smul_measure _ }
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  simp [comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, mul_comm]

name: comp_discard
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_discard (κ : Kernel α β) [IsMarkovKernel κ] : discard β ∘ₖ κ = discard α
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [comp_discard']

name: swap_copy
statement:
@[simp]
lemma swap_copy : (swap α α) ∘ₖ (copy α) = copy α
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  rw [comp_apply, copy_apply, Measure.dirac_bind (Kernel.measurable _), swap_apply' _ hs,
    Measure.dirac_apply' _ hs]
  congr

name: const_comp
statement:
lemma const_comp (μ : Measure γ) (κ : Kernel α β) :
    const β μ ∘ₖ κ = fun a ↦ (κ a) Set.univ • μ
proof:
:= by
  ext _ _ hs
  simp_rw [comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, const_apply, MeasureTheory.lintegral_const, Measure.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: const_comp'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma const_comp' (μ : Measure γ) (κ : Kernel α β) [IsMarkovKernel κ] :
    const β μ ∘ₖ κ = const α μ
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp_rw [const_comp, measure_univ, one_smul, const_apply]

name: comp_add_right
statement:
lemma comp_add_right (μ κ : Kernel α β) (η : Kernel β γ) :
    η ∘ₖ (μ + κ) = η ∘ₖ μ + η ∘ₖ κ
proof: := by ext _ _ hs; simp [comp_apply' _ _ _ hs]

name: comp_add_left
statement:
lemma comp_add_left (μ : Kernel α β) (κ η : Kernel β γ) :
    (κ + η) ∘ₖ μ = κ ∘ₖ μ + η ∘ₖ μ
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  simp_rw [comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, add_apply, Measure.add_apply, comp_apply' _ _ _ hs,
    lintegral_add_left (Kernel.measurable_coe κ hs)]

name: comp_sum_right
statement:
lemma comp_sum_right {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] (κ : ι → Kernel α β) (η : Kernel β γ) :
    η ∘ₖ Kernel.sum κ = Kernel.sum fun i ↦ η ∘ₖ (κ i)
proof:
:= by
  ext _ _ hs
  simp_rw [sum_apply, comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, Measure.sum_apply _ hs, sum_apply,
    lintegral_sum_measure, comp_apply' _ _ _ hs]

name: comp_sum_left
statement:
lemma comp_sum_left {ι : Type*} [Countable ι] (κ : Kernel α β) (η : ι → Kernel β γ) :
    (Kernel.sum η) ∘ₖ κ = Kernel.sum (fun i ↦ (η i) ∘ₖ κ)
proof:
:= by
  ext _ _ hs
  simp_rw [sum_apply, comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, sum_apply, Measure.sum_apply _ hs,
    comp_apply' _ _ _ hs]
  rw [lintegral_tsum]
  exact fun _ ↦ (Kernel.measurable_coe _ hs).aemeasurable

name: copy_comp_apply_prod
statement:
lemma copy_comp_apply_prod (κ : Kernel α β) (a : α) {s t : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (ht : MeasurableSet t) : (copy β ∘ₖ κ) a (s ×ˢ t) = κ a (s ∩ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_apply' _ _ _ <| hs.prod ht]
  simp_rw [copy_apply, Measure.dirac_apply' _ <| hs.prod ht, Set.indicator_prod_one]
  calc
  _ = ∫⁻ b, (s ∩ t).indicator 1 b ∂κ a := by
    congr with b
    simp [Set.inter_indicator_one]
  _ = κ a (s ∩ t) := lintegral_indicator_one <| hs.inter ht

name: pow_add
statement:
theorem pow_add (κ : Kernel α α) (m n : ℕ) :
    κ ^ (m + n) = (κ ^ m) ∘ₖ (κ ^ n)
proof: := _root_.pow_add κ m n

name: pow_add_apply_eq_lintegral
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm]; simp [pow_add, comp_apply' _ _ _ hs]

name: pow_succ_apply_eq_lintegral
proof:
:= by
  simpa using pow_add_apply_eq_lintegral _ n 1 _ hs

name: prod_prodMkLeft_comp_prod_deterministic
proof:
:= by
  ext ω s hs
  rw [prod_apply' _ _ _ hs, comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, lintegral_prod_deterministic,
    lintegral_comp, lintegral_prod_deterministic]
  · congr with b
    rw [prod_apply' _ _ _ hs, prodMkLeft_apply, comp_deterministic_eq_comap, comap_apply]
  · exact (measurable_measure_prodMk_left hs).lintegral_kernel
  · exact measurable_measure_prodMk_left hs
  · exact Kernel.measurable_coe _ hs

name: prod_prodMkRight_comp_deterministic_prod
proof:
:= by
  ext ω s hs
  rw [prod_apply' _ _ _ hs, comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, lintegral_deterministic_prod,
    lintegral_comp, lintegral_deterministic_prod]
  · congr with b
    rw [prod_apply' _ _ _ hs, prodMkRight_apply, comp_deterministic_eq_comap, comap_apply]
  · exact (measurable_measure_prodMk_left hs).lintegral_kernel
  · exact measurable_measure_prodMk_left hs
  · exact Kernel.measurable_coe _ hs

name: compProd_eq_parallelComp_comp_copy_comp
statement:
lemma compProd_eq_parallelComp_comp_copy_comp [SFinite μ] :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ = (Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ) ∘ₘ Kernel.copy α ∘ₘ μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hκ : IsSFiniteKernel κ
  swap; · simp [FunLike.coe_zero, hκ]
  rw [compProd_eq_comp_prod, ← Kernel.parallelComp_comp_copy, Measure.comp_assoc]

name: prod_comp_right
statement:
lemma prod_comp_right [SFinite ν] {κ : Kernel β γ} [IsSFiniteKernel κ] :
    μ.prod (κ ∘ₘ ν) = (Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ) ∘ₘ (μ.prod ν)
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.prod_apply hs, Measure.bind_apply hs (Kernel.aemeasurable _)]
  simp_rw [Measure.bind_apply (measurable_prodMk_left hs) (Kernel.aemeasurable _)]
  rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_prod]
  swap; · exact (Kernel.measurable_coe _ hs).aemeasurable
  congr with a
  congr with b
  rw [Kernel.parallelComp_apply, Kernel.id_apply, Measure.prod_apply hs, lintegral_dirac']
  exact measurable_measure_prodMk_left hs

name: prod_comp_left
statement:
lemma prod_comp_left [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] {κ : Kernel α γ} [IsSFiniteKernel κ] :
    (κ ∘ₘ μ).prod ν = (κ ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ (μ.prod ν)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (κ ∘ₘ μ).prod ν = (ν.prod (κ ∘ₘ μ)).map Prod.swap := by rw [Measure.prod_swap]
  have h2 : (κ ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ (μ.prod ν) = ((Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ) ∘ₘ (ν.prod μ)).map Prod.swap := by
    calc (κ ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ (μ.prod ν)
    _ = (κ ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ ((ν.prod μ).map Prod.swap) := by rw [Measure.prod_swap]
    _ = (κ ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₘ ((Kernel.swap _ _) ∘ₘ (ν.prod μ)) := by
      rw [Kernel.swap, Measure.deterministic_comp_eq_map]
    _ = (Kernel.swap _ _) ∘ₘ ((Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ) ∘ₘ (ν.prod μ)) := by
      rw [Measure.comp_assoc, Measure.comp_assoc, Kernel.swap_parallelComp]
    _ = ((Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ) ∘ₘ (ν.prod μ)).map Prod.swap := by
      rw [Kernel.swap, Measure.deterministic_comp_eq_map]
  rw [← Measure.prod_comp_right, ← h1] at h2
  exact h2.symm

name: parallelComp_comp_compProd
statement:
lemma parallelComp_comp_compProd [IsSFiniteKernel κ] {η : Kernel β γ} [IsSFiniteKernel η] :
    (Kernel.id ∥ₖ η) ∘ₘ (μ ⊗ₘ κ) = μ ⊗ₘ (η ∘ₖ κ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : SFinite μ
  swap; · simp [hμ]
  rw [Measure.compProd_eq_comp_prod, Measure.compProd_eq_comp_prod, Measure.comp_assoc,
    Kernel.parallelComp_comp_prod, Kernel.id_comp]

name: compProd_map
statement:
lemma compProd_map [SFinite μ] [IsSFiniteKernel κ] {f : β → γ} (hf : Measurable f) :
    μ ⊗ₘ (κ.map f) = (μ ⊗ₘ κ).map (Prod.map id f)
proof:
:= by
  calc μ ⊗ₘ (κ.map f)
  _ = (Kernel.id ∥ₖ Kernel.deterministic f hf) ∘ₘ (Kernel.id ×ₖ κ) ∘ₘ μ := by
    rw [comp_assoc, Kernel.parallelComp_comp_prod, compProd_eq_comp_prod,
      Kernel.id_comp, Kernel.deterministic_comp_eq_map]
  _ = (Kernel.id ∥ₖ Kernel.deterministic f hf) ∘ₘ (μ ⊗ₘ κ) := by rw [compProd_eq_comp_prod]
  _ = (μ ⊗ₘ κ).map (Prod.map id f) := by
    rw [Kernel.id, Kernel.deterministic_parallelComp_deterministic, deterministic_comp_eq_map]

name: parallelComp_comp_copy
statement:
lemma parallelComp_comp_copy (κ : Kernel α β) (η : Kernel α γ) :
    (κ ∥ₖ η) ∘ₖ copy α = κ ×ₖ η
proof: := rfl

name: zero_prod
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_prod (η : Kernel α γ) : (0 : Kernel α β) ×ₖ η = 0
proof: := by simp [prod]

name: prod_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma prod_zero (κ : Kernel α β) : κ ×ₖ (0 : Kernel α γ) = 0
proof: := by simp [prod]

name: prod_of_not_isSFiniteKernel_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma prod_of_not_isSFiniteKernel_left {κ : Kernel α β} (η : Kernel α γ) (h : ¬ IsSFiniteKernel κ) :
    κ ×ₖ η = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [prod, h]

name: prod_of_not_isSFiniteKernel_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma prod_of_not_isSFiniteKernel_right (κ : Kernel α β) {η : Kernel α γ}
    (h : ¬ IsSFiniteKernel η) :
    κ ×ₖ η = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [prod, h]

name: prod_apply'
statement:
theorem prod_apply' (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (η : Kernel α γ) [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    (a : α) {s : Set (β × γ)} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    (κ ×ₖ η) a s = ∫⁻ b : β, (η a) (Prod.mk b ⁻¹' s) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [prod, comp_apply, copy_apply, Measure.dirac_bind (Kernel.measurable _) (a, a),
    parallelComp_apply, Measure.prod_apply hs]

name: prod_apply
statement:
lemma prod_apply (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (η : Kernel α γ) [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    (a : α) :
    (κ ×ₖ η) a = (κ a).prod (η a)
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  rw [prod_apply' _ _ _ hs, Measure.prod_apply hs]

name: prod_apply_prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_apply, Measure.prod_prod]

name: prod_const
statement:
lemma prod_const (μ : Measure β) [SFinite μ] (ν : Measure γ) [SFinite ν] :
    const α μ ×ₖ const α ν = const α (μ.prod ν)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [const_apply, prod_apply, const_apply, const_apply]

name: lintegral_prod
statement:
theorem lintegral_prod (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (η : Kernel α γ) [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    (a : α) {g : β × γ → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g) :
    ∫⁻ c, g c ∂(κ ×ₖ η) a = ∫⁻ b, ∫⁻ c, g (b, c) ∂η a ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [prod, lintegral_comp _ _ _ hg, copy_apply]
  rw [lintegral_dirac' _ (by fun_prop)]
  simp_rw [parallelComp_apply, MeasureTheory.lintegral_prod _ hg.aemeasurable]

name: lintegral_prod_symm
statement:
theorem lintegral_prod_symm (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (η : Kernel α γ)
    [IsSFiniteKernel η] (a : α) {g : β × γ → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g) :
    ∫⁻ c, g c ∂(κ ×ₖ η) a = ∫⁻ c, ∫⁻ b, g (b, c) ∂κ a ∂η a
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_apply, MeasureTheory.lintegral_prod_symm _ hg.aemeasurable]

name: lintegral_deterministic_prod
statement:
theorem lintegral_deterministic_prod {f : α → β} (hf : Measurable f) (κ : Kernel α γ)
    [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (a : α) {g : (β × γ) → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g) :
    ∫⁻ p, g p ∂((deterministic f hf) ×ₖ κ) a = ∫⁻ c, g (f a, c) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_prod _ _ _ hg, lintegral_deterministic' _ hg.lintegral_prod_right']

name: lintegral_prod_deterministic
statement:
theorem lintegral_prod_deterministic {f : α → γ} (hf : Measurable f) (κ : Kernel α β)
    [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (a : α) {g : (β × γ) → ℝ≥0∞} (hg : Measurable g) :
    ∫⁻ p, g p ∂(κ ×ₖ (deterministic f hf)) a = ∫⁻ b, g (b, f a) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_prod_symm _ _ _ hg, lintegral_deterministic' _ hg.lintegral_prod_left']

name: lintegral_id_prod
statement:
theorem lintegral_id_prod {f : (α × β) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (κ : Kernel α β)
    [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (a : α) :
    ∫⁻ p, f p ∂(Kernel.id ×ₖ κ) a = ∫⁻ b, f (a, b) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kernel.id, lintegral_deterministic_prod _ _ _ hf, id_eq]

name: lintegral_prod_id
statement:
theorem lintegral_prod_id {f : (α × β) → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) (κ : Kernel β α)
    [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (b : β) :
    ∫⁻ p, f p ∂(κ ×ₖ Kernel.id) b = ∫⁻ a, f (a, b) ∂κ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kernel.id, lintegral_prod_deterministic _ _ _ hf, id_eq]

name: deterministic_prod_apply'
statement:
theorem deterministic_prod_apply' {f : α → β} (mf : Measurable f) (κ : Kernel α γ)
    [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (a : α) {s : Set (β × γ)} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    ((Kernel.deterministic f mf) ×ₖ κ) a s = κ a (Prod.mk (f a) ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_apply' _ _ _ hs, lintegral_deterministic']
  exact measurable_measure_prodMk_left hs

name: id_prod_apply'
statement:
theorem id_prod_apply' (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (a : α) {s : Set (α × β)}
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) : (Kernel.id ×ₖ κ) a s = κ a (Prod.mk a ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Kernel.id, deterministic_prod_apply' _ _ _ hs, id_eq]

name: fst_prod
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_prod (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (η : Kernel α γ) [IsMarkovKernel η] :
    fst (κ ×ₖ η) = κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod, fst_comp]
  ext a : 1
  rw [comp_apply, copy_apply, Measure.dirac_bind (by fun_prop), fst_apply, parallelComp_apply]
  simp

name: snd_prod
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_prod (κ : Kernel α β) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (η : Kernel α γ) [IsSFiniteKernel η] :
    snd (κ ×ₖ η) = η
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [snd_apply, prod_apply]

name: comap_prod
statement:
lemma comap_prod (κ : Kernel β γ) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (η : Kernel β δ) [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    {f : α → β} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (κ ×ₖ η).comap f hf = (κ.comap f hf) ×ₖ (η.comap f hf)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 x
  rw [comap_apply, prod_apply, prod_apply, comap_apply, comap_apply]

name: map_prod_map
proof:
:= by
  ext1 x
  rw [map_apply _ (hf.prodMap hg), prod_apply κ, ← Measure.map_prod_map _ _ hf hg, prod_apply,
    map_apply _ hf, map_apply _ hg]

name: map_prod_eq
statement:
lemma map_prod_eq (κ : Kernel α β) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (η : Kernel α γ) [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    {f : β → δ} (hf : Measurable f) : (κ.map f) ×ₖ η = (κ ×ₖ η).map (Prod.map f id)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_prod_map _ _ hf measurable_id, map_id]

name: comap_prod_swap
statement:
lemma comap_prod_swap (κ : Kernel α β) (η : Kernel γ δ) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] [IsSFiniteKernel η] :
    comap (prodMkRight α η ×ₖ prodMkLeft γ κ) Prod.swap measurable_swap
      = map (prodMkRight γ κ ×ₖ prodMkLeft α η) Prod.swap
proof:
:= by
  rw [ext_fun_iff]
  intro x f hf
  rw [lintegral_comap, lintegral_map _ measurable_swap _ hf, lintegral_prod _ _ _ hf,
    lintegral_prod]
  swap; · fun_prop
  simp only [prodMkRight_apply, Prod.fst_swap, Prod.swap_prod_mk, lintegral_prodMkLeft,
    Prod.snd_swap]
  refine (lintegral_lintegral_swap ?_).symm
  fun_prop

name: compProd_id
statement: lemma compProd_id [SFinite μ] : μ ⊗ₘ Kernel.id = μ.map Function.diag
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  rw [compProd_apply hs, map_apply (measurable_id.prod measurable_id) hs]
  have h_meas a : MeasurableSet (Prod.mk a ⁻¹' s) := measurable_prodMk_left hs
  simp_rw [Kernel.id_apply, dirac_apply' _ (h_meas _)]
  calc ∫⁻ a, (Prod.mk a ⁻¹' s).indicator 1 a ∂μ
  _ = ∫⁻ a, (Function.diag ⁻¹' s).indicator 1 a ∂μ := rfl
  _ = μ (Function.diag ⁻¹' s) := by
    rw [lintegral_indicator_one]
    exact (measurable_id.prod measurable_id) hs

@[simp]
lemma compProd_assoc {γ : Type*} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} {η : Kernel (α × β) γ} :

name: AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd_left
statement:
lemma AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd_left [SFinite ν] (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (κ : Kernel α β) :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ ν ⊗ₘ κ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hκ : IsSFiniteKernel κ
  · have : SFinite μ := sFinite_of_absolutelyContinuous hμν
    refine Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.mk fun s hs hs_zero ↦ ?_
    rw [Measure.compProd_apply hs, lintegral_eq_zero_iff (Kernel.measurable_kernel_prodMk_left hs)]
      at hs_zero ⊢
    exact hμν.ae_eq hs_zero
  · simp [compProd_of_not_isSFiniteKernel _ _ hκ]

name: AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd_right
statement:
lemma AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd_right [SFinite μ] [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    (hκη : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ a ≪ η a) :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ μ ⊗ₘ η
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hκ : IsSFiniteKernel κ
  · refine Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.mk fun s hs hs_zero ↦ ?_
    rw [Measure.compProd_apply hs, lintegral_eq_zero_iff (Kernel.measurable_kernel_prodMk_left hs)]
      at hs_zero ⊢
    filter_upwards [hs_zero, hκη] with a ha_zero ha_ac using ha_ac ha_zero
  · simp [compProd_of_not_isSFiniteKernel _ _ hκ]

name: AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd
statement:
lemma AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd [SFinite ν] [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (hκη : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ a ≪ η a) :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ ν ⊗ₘ η
proof:
:=
  have : SFinite μ := sFinite_of_absolutelyContinuous hμν
  (Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd_right hκη).trans (hμν.compProd_left _)

name: absolutelyContinuous_of_compProd
statement:
lemma absolutelyContinuous_of_compProd [SFinite μ] [IsSFiniteKernel κ] [h_zero : ∀ a, NeZero (κ a)]
    (h : μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ ν ⊗ₘ η) :
    μ ≪ ν
proof:
:= by
  refine Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.mk (fun s hs hs0 ↦ ?_)
  have h1 : (ν ⊗ₘ η) (s ×ˢ univ) = 0 := by
    by_cases hν : SFinite ν
    swap; · simp [compProd_of_not_sfinite _ _ hν]
    by_cases hη : IsSFiniteKernel η
    swap; · simp [compProd_of_not_isSFiniteKernel _ _ hη]
    rw [Measure.compProd_apply_prod hs MeasurableSet.univ]
    exact setLIntegral_measure_zero _ _ hs0
  have h2 : (μ ⊗ₘ κ) (s ×ˢ univ) = 0 := h h1
  rw [Measure.compProd_apply_prod hs MeasurableSet.univ, lintegral_eq_zero_iff] at h2
  swap; · exact Kernel.measurable_coe _ MeasurableSet.univ
  by_contra hμs
  have : Filter.NeBot (ae (μ.restrict s)) := by simp [hμs]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, κ a univ = 0 := h2.exists
  refine absurd ha ?_
  simp only [Measure.measure_univ_eq_zero]
  exact (h_zero a).out

name: absolutelyContinuous_compProd_left_iff
statement:
lemma absolutelyContinuous_compProd_left_iff [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    [IsSFiniteKernel κ] [∀ a, NeZero (κ a)] :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ ν ⊗ₘ κ ↔ μ ≪ ν
proof:
:=
  ⟨absolutelyContinuous_of_compProd, fun h ↦ h.compProd_left κ⟩

name: AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd_of_compProd
statement:
lemma AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd_of_compProd [SFinite ν] [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) (hκη : μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ μ ⊗ₘ η) :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ ν ⊗ₘ η
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : SFinite μ
  swap; · rw [compProd_of_not_sfinite _ _ hμ]; simp
  refine AbsolutelyContinuous.mk fun s hs hs_zero ↦ ?_
  suffices (μ ⊗ₘ η) s = 0 from hκη this
  rw [measure_eq_zero_iff_ae_notMem, ae_compProd_iff hs.compl] at hs_zero ⊢
  exact hμν.ae_le hs_zero

name: MutuallySingular.compProd_of_left
statement:
lemma MutuallySingular.compProd_of_left (hμν : μ ⟂ₘ ν) (κ η : Kernel α β) :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ⟂ₘ ν ⊗ₘ η
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : SFinite μ
  swap; · rw [compProd_of_not_sfinite _ _ hμ]; simp
  by_cases hν : SFinite ν
  swap; · rw [compProd_of_not_sfinite _ _ hν]; simp
  by_cases hκ : IsSFiniteKernel κ
  swap; · rw [compProd_of_not_isSFiniteKernel _ _ hκ]; simp
  by_cases hη : IsSFiniteKernel η
  swap; · rw [compProd_of_not_isSFiniteKernel _ _ hη]; simp
  refine ⟨hμν.nullSet ×ˢ univ, hμν.measurableSet_nullSet.prod .univ, ?_⟩
  rw [compProd_apply_prod hμν.measurableSet_nullSet .univ, compl_prod_eq_union]
  simp only [MutuallySingular.restrict_nullSet, lintegral_zero_measure, compl_univ,
    prod_empty, union_empty, true_and]
  rw [compProd_apply_prod hμν.measurableSet_nullSet.compl .univ]
  simp

name: mutuallySingular_of_mutuallySingular_compProd
statement:
lemma mutuallySingular_of_mutuallySingular_compProd {ξ : Measure α}
    [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] [IsSFiniteKernel κ] [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    (h : μ ⊗ₘ κ ⟂ₘ ν ⊗ₘ η) (hμ : ξ ≪ μ) (hν : ξ ≪ ν) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂ξ, κ x ⟂ₘ η x
proof:
:= by
  have hs : MeasurableSet h.nullSet := h.measurableSet_nullSet
  have hμ_zero : (μ ⊗ₘ κ) h.nullSet = 0 := h.measure_nullSet
  have hν_zero : (ν ⊗ₘ η) h.nullSetᶜ = 0 := h.measure_compl_nullSet
  rw [compProd_apply, lintegral_eq_zero_iff'] at hμ_zero hν_zero
  · filter_upwards [hμ hμ_zero, hν hν_zero] with x hxμ hxν
    exact ⟨Prod.mk x ⁻¹' h.nullSet, measurable_prodMk_left hs, ⟨hxμ, hxν⟩⟩
  · exact (Kernel.measurable_kernel_prodMk_left hs.compl).aemeasurable
  · exact (Kernel.measurable_kernel_prodMk_left hs).aemeasurable
  · exact hs.compl
  · exact hs

name: mutuallySingular_compProd_left_iff
statement:
lemma mutuallySingular_compProd_left_iff [SFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    [IsSFiniteKernel κ] [hκ : ∀ x, NeZero (κ x)] :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ⟂ₘ ν ⊗ₘ κ ↔ μ ⟂ₘ ν
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h.compProd_of_left _ _⟩
  rw [← withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero]
  have hh := mutuallySingular_of_mutuallySingular_compProd h ?_ ?_
    (ξ := ν.withDensity (μ.rnDeriv ν))
  rotate_left
  · exact absolutelyContinuous_of_le (μ.withDensity_rnDeriv_le ν)
  · exact withDensity_absolutelyContinuous _ _
  simp_rw [MutuallySingular.self_iff, (hκ _).ne] at hh
  exact ae_eq_bot.mp (Filter.eventually_false_iff_eq_bot.mp hh)

name: AbsolutelyContinuous.mutuallySingular_compProd_iff
statement:
lemma AbsolutelyContinuous.mutuallySingular_compProd_iff [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hμν : μ ≪ ν) :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ⟂ₘ ν ⊗ₘ η ↔ μ ⊗ₘ κ ⟂ₘ μ ⊗ₘ η
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [ν.haveLebesgueDecomposition_add μ]
  rw [compProd_add_left, MutuallySingular.add_right_iff]
  simp only [(mutuallySingular_singularPart ν μ).symm.compProd_of_left κ η, true_and]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.mono_ac .rfl ?_, fun h ↦ h.mono_ac .rfl ?_⟩
  · exact (absolutelyContinuous_withDensity_rnDeriv hμν).compProd_left _
  · exact (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous μ (ν.rnDeriv μ)).compProd_left _

name: mutuallySingular_compProd_iff
statement:
lemma mutuallySingular_compProd_iff [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν] :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ⟂ₘ ν ⊗ₘ η ↔ ∀ ξ, SFinite ξ → ξ ≪ μ → ξ ≪ ν → ξ ⊗ₘ κ ⟂ₘ ξ ⊗ₘ η
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [μ.haveLebesgueDecomposition_add ν]
  rw [compProd_add_left, MutuallySingular.add_left_iff]
  simp only [(mutuallySingular_singularPart μ ν).compProd_of_left κ η, true_and]
  rw [(withDensity_absolutelyContinuous ν (μ.rnDeriv ν)).mutuallySingular_compProd_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h ξ hξ hξμ hξν ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact h.mono_ac ((hξμ.withDensity_rnDeriv hξν).compProd_left _)
      ((hξμ.withDensity_rnDeriv hξν).compProd_left _)
  · refine h _ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · infer_instance
    · exact absolutelyContinuous_of_le (withDensity_rnDeriv_le _ _)
    · exact withDensity_absolutelyContinuous ν (μ.rnDeriv ν)

name: absolutelyContinuous_compProd_of_compProd
statement:
lemma absolutelyContinuous_compProd_of_compProd [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν]
    (hκη : μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ ν ⊗ₘ η) :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ μ ⊗ₘ η
proof:
:= by
  rw [ν.haveLebesgueDecomposition_add μ, compProd_add_left, add_comm] at hκη
  have h := absolutelyContinuous_of_add_of_mutuallySingular hκη
    ((mutuallySingular_singularPart _ _).symm.compProd_of_left _ _)
  refine h.trans (AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd_left ?_ _)
  exact withDensity_absolutelyContinuous _ _

name: absolutelyContinuous_compProd_iff
statement:
lemma absolutelyContinuous_compProd_iff
    [SigmaFinite μ] [SigmaFinite ν] [IsSFiniteKernel κ] [IsSFiniteKernel η] [∀ x, NeZero (κ x)] :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ ν ⊗ₘ η ↔ μ ≪ ν ∧ μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ μ ⊗ₘ η
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨absolutelyContinuous_of_compProd h, absolutelyContinuous_compProd_of_compProd h⟩,
    fun h ↦ h.1.compProd_of_compProd h.2⟩

name: rnDeriv_measure_compProd_left_of_ac
proof:
:= by
  refine ae_eq_of_forall_setLIntegral_eq_of_sigmaFinite (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) fun s hs _ ↦ ?_
  have h_key t₁ t₂ : MeasurableSet t₁ → MeasurableSet t₂ →
      ∫⁻ x in t₁ ×ˢ t₂, (μ ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ κ) x ∂ν ⊗ₘ κ =
        ∫⁻ x in t₁ ×ˢ t₂, μ.rnDeriv ν x.1 ∂ν ⊗ₘ κ := by
    intro ht₁ ht₂
    rw [Measure.setLIntegral_rnDeriv (hμν.compProd_left _),
      Measure.setLIntegral_compProd (by fun_prop) ht₁ ht₂]
    simp only [MeasureTheory.lintegral_const, MeasurableSet.univ, Measure.restrict_apply,
      univ_inter]
    rw [setLIntegral_rnDeriv_mul hμν (κ.measurable_coe ht₂).aemeasurable ht₁,
      Measure.compProd_apply_prod ht₁ ht₂]
  refine MeasurableSpace.induction_on_inter generateFrom_prod.symm isPiSystem_prod ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ s hs
  · simp
  · rintro _ ⟨t₁, ht₁, t₂, ht₂, rfl⟩
    exact h_key t₁ t₂ ht₁ ht₂
  · intro t ht ht_eq
    rw [setLIntegral_compl ht, ht_eq, setLIntegral_compl ht]
    · congr 1
      specialize h_key .univ .univ .univ .univ
      simpa only [univ_prod_univ, Measure.restrict_univ] using h_key
    · rw [← ht_eq]
      exact ((Measure.setLIntegral_rnDeriv_le _).trans_lt (measure_lt_top _ _)).ne
    · exact ((Measure.setLIntegral_rnDeriv_le _).trans_lt (measure_lt_top _ _)).ne
  · intro f' hf_disj hf_meas hf_eq
    rw [lintegral_iUnion hf_meas hf_disj, lintegral_iUnion hf_meas hf_disj]
    congr with i
    exact hf_eq i

name: rnDeriv_compProd_withDensity_rnDeriv
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_compProd_withDensity_rnDeriv (μ ν : Measure α) (κ η : Kernel α β)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] :
    (ν.withDensity (μ.rnDeriv ν) ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ η) =ᵐ[ν ⊗ₘ η] (μ ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ η)
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [Measure.haveLebesgueDecomposition_add μ ν]
  rw [Measure.compProd_add_left]
  have h := Measure.rnDeriv_add' (μ.singularPart ν ⊗ₘ κ) (ν.withDensity (μ.rnDeriv ν) ⊗ₘ κ)
    (ν ⊗ₘ η)
  have h2 : (μ.singularPart ν ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ η) =ᵐ[ν ⊗ₘ η] 0 := by
    refine Measure.rnDeriv_eq_zero_of_mutuallySingular ?_ ?_
    · exact Measure.MutuallySingular.compProd_of_left (μ.mutuallySingular_singularPart _) _ _
    · exact Measure.AbsolutelyContinuous.rfl
  filter_upwards [h, h2] with x hx hx2
  simp [hx, hx2]

name: rnDeriv_measure_compProd_left
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_measure_compProd_left (μ ν : Measure α) (κ : Kernel α β)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteKernel κ] :
    (μ ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ κ) =ᵐ[ν ⊗ₘ κ] fun p ↦ (μ.rnDeriv ν) p.1
proof:
:= by
  calc (μ ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ κ)
  _ =ᵐ[ν ⊗ₘ κ] (ν.withDensity (μ.rnDeriv ν) ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ κ) :=
    (rnDeriv_compProd_withDensity_rnDeriv μ ν κ κ).symm
  _ =ᵐ[ν ⊗ₘ κ] (fun p ↦ (ν.withDensity (μ.rnDeriv ν)).rnDeriv ν p.1) :=
    rnDeriv_measure_compProd_left_of_ac
      (MeasureTheory.withDensity_absolutelyContinuous ν (μ.rnDeriv ν)) κ
  _ =ᵐ[ν ⊗ₘ κ] fun p ↦ μ.rnDeriv ν p.1 :=
    Measure.ae_eq_compProd_of_ae_eq_fst _ (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
      (Measure.rnDeriv_withDensity ν (by fun_prop))

name: rnDeriv_compProd
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_compProd [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η]
    (h_ac : μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ μ ⊗ₘ η) (ν : Measure α) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    (μ ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ η) =ᵐ[ν ⊗ₘ η]
      (fun p ↦ μ.rnDeriv ν p.1 * (μ ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (μ ⊗ₘ η) p)
proof:
:= by
  refine Filter.EventuallyEq.trans (Measure.rnDeriv_mul_rnDeriv h_ac).symm ?_
  filter_upwards [rnDeriv_measure_compProd_left μ ν η] with p hp
  rw [Pi.mul_apply, hp, mul_comm]

name: rnDeriv_measure_compProd
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_measure_compProd (μ ν : Measure α) (κ η : Kernel α β)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] :
    (μ ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ η) =ᵐ[ν ⊗ₘ η] fun p ↦ μ.rnDeriv ν p.1 * κ.rnDeriv η p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  have h_add : μ ⊗ₘ κ = μ ⊗ₘ κ.singularPart η + μ ⊗ₘ η.withDensity (κ.rnDeriv η) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Kernel.rnDeriv_add_singularPart κ η]
    rw [Measure.compProd_add_right, add_comm]
  have h_sing : (μ ⊗ₘ κ.singularPart η).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ η) =ᵐ[ν ⊗ₘ η] 0 :=
    Measure.rnDeriv_eq_zero_of_mutuallySingular
      (Measure.MutuallySingular.compProd_of_right μ ν
        (.of_forall <| Kernel.mutuallySingular_singularPart κ η)) .rfl
  have h_ne_top : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ ⊗ₘ η), κ.rnDeriv η p.1 p.2 ≠ ∞ := by
    refine Measure.ae_compProd_of_ae_ae (p := fun p ↦ κ.rnDeriv η p.1 p.2 ≠ ∞)
      (Kernel.measurable_rnDeriv κ η (measurableSet_singleton ∞)).compl ?_
    exact ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ Kernel.rnDeriv_ne_top κ η
  have h_wd : (μ ⊗ₘ η.withDensity (κ.rnDeriv η)).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ η)
      =ᵐ[ν ⊗ₘ η] fun p ↦ κ.rnDeriv η p.1 p.2 * (μ ⊗ₘ η).rnDeriv (ν ⊗ₘ η) p := by
    rw [Measure.compProd_withDensity (Kernel.measurable_rnDeriv κ η)]
    exact Measure.rnDeriv_withDensity_left (Kernel.measurable_rnDeriv κ η).aemeasurable h_ne_top
  rw [h_add]
  have h_add' := Measure.rnDeriv_add' (μ ⊗ₘ κ.singularPart η)
    (μ ⊗ₘ η.withDensity (κ.rnDeriv η)) (ν ⊗ₘ η)
  filter_upwards [h_add', h_sing, h_wd, rnDeriv_measure_compProd_left μ ν η]
    with p h1 h2 h3 h4
  rw [h1, Pi.add_apply, h2, Pi.zero_apply, zero_add, h3, h4, mul_comm]

name: rnDeriv_measure_compProd_right
statement:
lemma rnDeriv_measure_compProd_right (μ : Measure α) (κ η : Kernel α β)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteKernel κ] [IsFiniteKernel η] :
    (μ ⊗ₘ κ).rnDeriv (μ ⊗ₘ η) =ᵐ[μ ⊗ₘ η] fun p ↦ κ.rnDeriv η p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [Measure.ae_compProd_of_ae_fst η (by measurability) μ.rnDeriv_self,
    rnDeriv_measure_compProd μ μ κ η]
  simp_all

name: hasFiniteIntegral_prodMk_left
statement:
theorem hasFiniteIntegral_prodMk_left (a : α) {s : Set (β × γ)} (h2s : (κ ⊗ₖ η) a s ≠ ∞) :
    HasFiniteIntegral (fun b => (η (a, b)).real (Prod.mk b ⁻¹' s)) (κ a)
proof:
:= by
  let t := toMeasurable ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a) s
  simp_rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm, measureReal_def, enorm_eq_ofReal toReal_nonneg]
  calc
    ∫⁻ b, ENNReal.ofReal (η (a, b) (Prod.mk b ⁻¹' s)).toReal ∂κ a
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ b, η (a, b) (Prod.mk b ⁻¹' t) ∂κ a := by
      refine lintegral_mono_ae ?_
      filter_upwards [ae_kernel_lt_top a h2s] with b hb
      rw [ofReal_toReal hb.ne]
      exact measure_mono (preimage_mono (subset_toMeasurable _ _))
    _ ≤ (κ ⊗ₖ η) a t := le_compProd_apply _ _ _ _
    _ = (κ ⊗ₖ η) a s := measure_toMeasurable s
    _ < ⊤ := h2s.lt_top

name: integrable_kernel_prodMk_left
statement:
theorem integrable_kernel_prodMk_left (a : α) {s : Set (β × γ)} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (h2s : (κ ⊗ₖ η) a s ≠ ∞) : Integrable (fun b => (η (a, b)).real (Prod.mk b ⁻¹' s)) (κ a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact (measurable_kernel_prodMk_left' hs a).ennreal_toReal.aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact hasFiniteIntegral_prodMk_left a h2s

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.integral_kernel_compProd
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.integral_kernel_compProd [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    ⦃f : β × γ → E⦄ (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x)) (κ a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x => ∫ y, hf.mk f (x, y) ∂η (a, x), hf.stronglyMeasurable_mk.integral_kernel_prod_right'', by
    filter_upwards [ae_ae_of_ae_compProd hf.ae_eq_mk] with _ hx using integral_congr_ae hx⟩

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.compProd_mk_left
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.compProd_mk_left {δ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace δ]
    {f : β × γ → δ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂κ a, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y => f (x, y)) (η (a, x))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ae_ae_of_ae_compProd hf.ae_eq_mk] with x hx using
    ⟨fun y => hf.mk f (x, y), hf.stronglyMeasurable_mk.comp_measurable measurable_prodMk_left, hx⟩

name: hasFiniteIntegral_compProd_iff
statement:
theorem hasFiniteIntegral_compProd_iff ⦃f : β × γ → E⦄ (h1f : StronglyMeasurable f) :
    HasFiniteIntegral f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a) ↔
      (∀ᵐ x ∂κ a, HasFiniteIntegral (fun y => f (x, y)) (η (a, x))) ∧
        HasFiniteIntegral (fun x => ∫ y, ‖f (x, y)‖ ∂η (a, x)) (κ a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm]
  rw [lintegral_compProd _ _ _ h1f.enorm]
  have : ∀ x, ∀ᵐ y ∂η (a, x), 0 ≤ ‖f (x, y)‖ := fun x => Eventually.of_forall fun y => norm_nonneg _
  simp_rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (this _)
      (h1f.norm.comp_measurable measurable_prodMk_left).aestronglyMeasurable,
    enorm_eq_ofReal toReal_nonneg, ofReal_norm]
  have : ∀ {p q r : Prop} (_ : r → p), (r ↔ p ∧ q) ↔ p → (r ↔ q) := fun {p q r} h1 => by
    rw [← and_congr_right_iff, and_iff_right_of_imp h1]
  rw [this]
  · intro h2f; rw [lintegral_congr_ae]
    filter_upwards [h2f] with x hx
    rw [ofReal_toReal]; finiteness
  · intro h2f; refine ae_lt_top ?_ h2f.ne; exact h1f.enorm.lintegral_kernel_prod_right''

name: hasFiniteIntegral_compProd_iff'
statement:
theorem hasFiniteIntegral_compProd_iff' ⦃f : β × γ → E⦄
    (h1f : AEStronglyMeasurable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    HasFiniteIntegral f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a) ↔
      (∀ᵐ x ∂κ a, HasFiniteIntegral (fun y => f (x, y)) (η (a, x))) ∧
        HasFiniteIntegral (fun x => ∫ y, ‖f (x, y)‖ ∂η (a, x)) (κ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasFiniteIntegral_congr h1f.ae_eq_mk,
    hasFiniteIntegral_compProd_iff h1f.stronglyMeasurable_mk]
  apply and_congr
  · apply eventually_congr
    filter_upwards [ae_ae_of_ae_compProd h1f.ae_eq_mk.symm] with x hx using
      hasFiniteIntegral_congr hx
  · apply hasFiniteIntegral_congr
    filter_upwards [ae_ae_of_ae_compProd h1f.ae_eq_mk.symm] with _ hx using
      integral_congr_ae (EventuallyEq.fun_comp hx _)

name: integrable_compProd_iff
statement:
theorem integrable_compProd_iff ⦃f : β × γ → E⦄ (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a) ↔
      (∀ᵐ x ∂κ a, Integrable (fun y => f (x, y)) (η (a, x))) ∧
        Integrable (fun x => ∫ y, ‖f (x, y)‖ ∂η (a, x)) (κ a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Integrable, hasFiniteIntegral_compProd_iff' hf, hf.norm.integral_kernel_compProd,
    hf, hf.compProd_mk_left, eventually_and, true_and]

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.ae_of_compProd
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.ae_of_compProd ⦃f : β × γ → E⦄
    (hf : Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) : ∀ᵐ x ∂κ a, Integrable (fun y => f (x, y)) (η (a, x))
proof:
:=
  ((integrable_compProd_iff hf.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hf).1

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_norm_compProd
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_norm_compProd ⦃f : β × γ → E⦄
    (hf : Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) : Integrable (fun x => ∫ y, ‖f (x, y)‖ ∂η (a, x)) (κ a)
proof:
:=
  ((integrable_compProd_iff hf.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hf).2

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_compProd
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_compProd [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    ⦃f : β × γ → E⦄ (hf : Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    Integrable (fun x => ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x)) (κ a)
proof:
:=
  Integrable.mono hf.integral_norm_compProd hf.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_kernel_compProd <|
    Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
      (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans_eq <|
        (norm_of_nonneg <|
            integral_nonneg_of_ae <|
              Eventually.of_forall fun y => (norm_nonneg (f (x, y)) :)).symm

name: Kernel.integral_fn_integral_add
statement:
theorem Kernel.integral_fn_integral_add ⦃f g : β × γ → E⦄ (F : E → E')
    (hf : Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) (hg : Integrable g ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    ∫ x, F (∫ y, f (x, y) + g (x, y) ∂η (a, x)) ∂κ a =
      ∫ x, F (∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) + ∫ y, g (x, y) ∂η (a, x)) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [hf.ae_of_compProd, hg.ae_of_compProd] with _ h2f h2g
  simp [integral_add h2f h2g]

name: Kernel.integral_fn_integral_sub
statement:
theorem Kernel.integral_fn_integral_sub ⦃f g : β × γ → E⦄ (F : E → E')
    (hf : Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) (hg : Integrable g ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    ∫ x, F (∫ y, f (x, y) - g (x, y) ∂η (a, x)) ∂κ a =
      ∫ x, F (∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) - ∫ y, g (x, y) ∂η (a, x)) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [hf.ae_of_compProd, hg.ae_of_compProd] with _ h2f h2g
  simp [integral_sub h2f h2g]

name: Kernel.lintegral_fn_integral_sub
statement:
theorem Kernel.lintegral_fn_integral_sub ⦃f g : β × γ → E⦄ (F : E → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hf : Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) (hg : Integrable g ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    ∫⁻ x, F (∫ y, f (x, y) - g (x, y) ∂η (a, x)) ∂κ a =
      ∫⁻ x, F (∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) - ∫ y, g (x, y) ∂η (a, x)) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [hf.ae_of_compProd, hg.ae_of_compProd] with _ h2f h2g
  simp [integral_sub h2f h2g]

name: Kernel.integral_integral_add
statement:
theorem Kernel.integral_integral_add ⦃f g : β × γ → E⦄ (hf : Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a))
    (hg : Integrable g ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    ∫ x, ∫ y, f (x, y) + g (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a =
      ∫ x, ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a + ∫ x, ∫ y, g (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a
proof:
:=
  (Kernel.integral_fn_integral_add id hf hg).trans <|
    integral_add hf.integral_compProd hg.integral_compProd

name: Kernel.integral_integral_add'
statement:
theorem Kernel.integral_integral_add' ⦃f g : β × γ → E⦄ (hf : Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a))
    (hg : Integrable g ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    ∫ x, ∫ y, (f + g) (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a =
      ∫ x, ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a + ∫ x, ∫ y, g (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a
proof:
:=
  Kernel.integral_integral_add hf hg

name: Kernel.integral_integral_sub
statement:
theorem Kernel.integral_integral_sub ⦃f g : β × γ → E⦄ (hf : Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a))
    (hg : Integrable g ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    ∫ x, ∫ y, f (x, y) - g (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a =
      ∫ x, ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a - ∫ x, ∫ y, g (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a
proof:
:=
  (Kernel.integral_fn_integral_sub id hf hg).trans <|
    integral_sub hf.integral_compProd hg.integral_compProd

name: Kernel.integral_integral_sub'
statement:
theorem Kernel.integral_integral_sub' ⦃f g : β × γ → E⦄ (hf : Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a))
    (hg : Integrable g ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    ∫ x, ∫ y, (f - g) (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a =
      ∫ x, ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a - ∫ x, ∫ y, g (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a
proof:
:=
  Kernel.integral_integral_sub hf hg

name: Kernel.continuous_integral_integral
statement:
theorem Kernel.continuous_integral_integral :
    Continuous fun f : β × γ →₁[(κ ⊗ₖ η) a] E => ∫ x, ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]; intro g
  refine
    tendsto_integral_of_L1 _ (L1.integrable_coeFn g).integral_compProd.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Eventually.of_forall fun h => (L1.integrable_coeFn h).integral_compProd) ?_
  simp_rw [← lintegral_fn_integral_sub (‖·‖ₑ) (L1.integrable_coeFn _) (L1.integrable_coeFn g)]
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds _ (fun i => zero_le) _
  · exact fun i => ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, ‖i (x, y) - g (x, y)‖ₑ ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a
  swap; · exact fun i => lintegral_mono fun x => enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm _
  have (i : Lp (α := β × γ) E 1 (((κ ⊗ₖ η) a) : Measure (β × γ))) :
      Measurable fun z => ‖i z - g z‖ₑ :=
    ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable i).sub (Lp.stronglyMeasurable g)).enorm
  simp_rw [← lintegral_compProd _ _ _ (this _), ← L1.ofReal_norm_sub_eq_lintegral, ← ofReal_zero]
  refine (continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp ?_
  rw [← tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
  exact tendsto_id

name: integral_compProd
statement:
theorem integral_compProd :
    ∀ {f : β × γ → E} (_ : Integrable f ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)),
      ∫ z, f z ∂(κ ⊗ₖ η) a = ∫ x, ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hE : CompleteSpace E; swap
  · simp [integral, hE]
  apply Integrable.induction
  · intro c s hs h2s
    simp_rw [integral_indicator hs, ← indicator_comp_right, Function.comp_def,
      integral_indicator (measurable_prodMk_left hs), MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const,
      integral_smul_const, measureReal_def]
    congr 1
    rw [integral_toReal]
    rotate_left
    · exact (Kernel.measurable_kernel_prodMk_left' hs _).aemeasurable
    · exact ae_kernel_lt_top a h2s.ne
    rw [Kernel.compProd_apply hs]
  · intro f g _ i_f i_g hf hg
    simp_rw [integral_add' i_f i_g, Kernel.integral_integral_add' i_f i_g, hf, hg]
  · exact isClosed_eq continuous_integral Kernel.continuous_integral_integral
  · intro f g hfg _ hf
    convert! hf using 1
    · exact integral_congr_ae hfg.symm
    · apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [ae_ae_of_ae_compProd hfg] with x hfgx using
        integral_congr_ae (ae_eq_symm hfgx)

name: setIntegral_compProd
statement:
theorem setIntegral_compProd {f : β × γ → E} {s : Set β} {t : Set γ} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (ht : MeasurableSet t) (hf : IntegrableOn f (s ×ˢ t) ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    ∫ z in s ×ˢ t, f z ∂(κ ⊗ₖ η) a = ∫ x in s, ∫ y in t, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [← Kernel.restrict_apply (κ ⊗ₖ η) (hs.prod ht), ← compProd_restrict hs ht, integral_compProd]
  · simp_rw [Kernel.restrict_apply]
  · rw [compProd_restrict, Kernel.restrict_apply]; exact hf

name: setIntegral_compProd_univ_right
statement:
theorem setIntegral_compProd_univ_right (f : β × γ → E) {s : Set β} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f (s ×ˢ univ) ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    ∫ z in s ×ˢ univ, f z ∂(κ ⊗ₖ η) a = ∫ x in s, ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [setIntegral_compProd hs MeasurableSet.univ hf, Measure.restrict_univ]

name: setIntegral_compProd_univ_left
statement:
theorem setIntegral_compProd_univ_left (f : β × γ → E) {t : Set γ} (ht : MeasurableSet t)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f (univ ×ˢ t) ((κ ⊗ₖ η) a)) :
    ∫ z in univ ×ˢ t, f z ∂(κ ⊗ₖ η) a = ∫ x, ∫ y in t, f (x, y) ∂η (a, x) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [setIntegral_compProd MeasurableSet.univ ht hf, Measure.restrict_univ]

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.integral_kernel_comp
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.integral_kernel_comp [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    ⦃f : γ → E⦄ (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ ∫ y, f y ∂η x) (κ a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x ↦ ∫ y, hf.mk f y ∂η x, hf.stronglyMeasurable_mk.integral_kernel, by
    filter_upwards [ae_ae_of_ae_comp hf.ae_eq_mk] with _ hx using integral_congr_ae hx⟩

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.comp
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.comp {δ : Type*} [TopologicalSpace δ]
    {f : γ → δ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂κ a, AEStronglyMeasurable f (η x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ae_ae_of_ae_comp hf.ae_eq_mk] with x hx using
    ⟨hf.mk f, hf.stronglyMeasurable_mk, hx⟩

name: hasFiniteIntegral_comp_iff
statement:
theorem hasFiniteIntegral_comp_iff ⦃f : γ → E⦄ (hf : StronglyMeasurable f) :
    HasFiniteIntegral f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a) ↔
    (∀ᵐ x ∂κ a, HasFiniteIntegral f (η x)) ∧ HasFiniteIntegral (fun x ↦ ∫ y, ‖f y‖ ∂η x) (κ a)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm, lintegral_comp _ _ _ hf.enorm]
  simp_rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ fun y ↦ norm_nonneg _)
      hf.norm.aestronglyMeasurable, enorm_eq_ofReal toReal_nonneg, ofReal_norm]
  have : ∀ {p q r : Prop} (_ : r → p), (r ↔ p ∧ q) ↔ p → (r ↔ q) := fun h ↦ by
    rw [← and_congr_right_iff, and_iff_right_of_imp h]
  rw [this]
  · intro h
    rw [lintegral_congr_ae]
    filter_upwards [h] with x hx
    rw [ofReal_toReal]
    finiteness
  · exact fun h ↦ ae_lt_top hf.enorm.lintegral_kernel h.ne

name: hasFiniteIntegral_comp_iff'
statement:
theorem hasFiniteIntegral_comp_iff' ⦃f : γ → E⦄ (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    HasFiniteIntegral f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a) ↔
    (∀ᵐ x ∂κ a, HasFiniteIntegral f (η x)) ∧ HasFiniteIntegral (fun x ↦ ∫ y, ‖f y‖ ∂η x) (κ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasFiniteIntegral_congr hf.ae_eq_mk, hasFiniteIntegral_comp_iff hf.stronglyMeasurable_mk]
  refine and_congr (eventually_congr ?_) (hasFiniteIntegral_congr ?_)
  · filter_upwards [ae_ae_of_ae_comp hf.ae_eq_mk.symm] with _ hx using
      hasFiniteIntegral_congr hx
  · filter_upwards [ae_ae_of_ae_comp hf.ae_eq_mk.symm] with _ hx using
      integral_congr_ae (EventuallyEq.fun_comp hx _)

name: integrable_comp_iff
statement:
theorem integrable_comp_iff ⦃f : γ → E⦄ (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a) ↔
    (∀ᵐ y ∂κ a, Integrable f (η y)) ∧ Integrable (fun y ↦ ∫ z, ‖f z‖ ∂η y) (κ a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Integrable, hf, hasFiniteIntegral_comp_iff' hf, true_and, eventually_and, hf.comp,
    hf.norm.integral_kernel_comp]

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.Measure.integrable_comp_iff
statement:
protected lemma _root_.MeasureTheory.Measure.integrable_comp_iff {μ : Measure α} {f : β → E}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (κ ∘ₘ μ)) :
    Integrable f (κ ∘ₘ μ)
      ↔ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Integrable f (κ x)) ∧ Integrable (fun x ↦ ∫ y, ‖f y‖ ∂κ x) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.comp_eq_comp_const_apply, ProbabilityTheory.integrable_comp_iff]
  · simp
  · simpa [Kernel.comp_apply]

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.ae_of_comp
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.ae_of_comp ⦃f : γ → E⦄ (hf : Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂κ a, Integrable f (η x)
proof: := ((integrable_comp_iff hf.1).1 hf).1

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_norm_comp
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_norm_comp ⦃f : γ → E⦄
    (hf : Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) : Integrable (fun x ↦ ∫ y, ‖f y‖ ∂η x) (κ a)
proof:
:=
  ((integrable_comp_iff hf.1).1 hf).2

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_comp
statement:
theorem _root_.MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_comp [NormedSpace ℝ E] ⦃f : γ → E⦄
    (hf : Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) : Integrable (fun x ↦ ∫ y, f y ∂η x) (κ a)
proof:
:=
  Integrable.mono hf.integral_norm_comp hf.1.integral_kernel_comp <|
    ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans_eq
    (norm_of_nonneg <| integral_nonneg_of_ae <| ae_of_all _ fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _).symm

name: integral_fn_integral_add_comp
statement:
theorem integral_fn_integral_add_comp ⦃f g : γ → E⦄ (F : E → E')
    (hf : Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) (hg : Integrable g ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    ∫ x, F (∫ y, f y + g y ∂η x) ∂κ a = ∫ x, F (∫ y, f y ∂η x + ∫ y, g y ∂η x) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [hf.ae_of_comp, hg.ae_of_comp] with _ h2f h2g
  simp [integral_add h2f h2g]

name: integral_fn_integral_sub_comp
statement:
theorem integral_fn_integral_sub_comp ⦃f g : γ → E⦄ (F : E → E')
    (hf : Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) (hg : Integrable g ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    ∫ x, F (∫ y, f y - g y ∂η x) ∂κ a = ∫ x, F (∫ y, f y ∂η x - ∫ y, g y ∂η x) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [hf.ae_of_comp, hg.ae_of_comp] with _ h2f h2g
  simp [integral_sub h2f h2g]

name: lintegral_fn_integral_sub_comp
statement:
theorem lintegral_fn_integral_sub_comp ⦃f g : γ → E⦄ (F : E → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hf : Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) (hg : Integrable g ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    ∫⁻ x, F (∫ y, f y - g y ∂η x) ∂κ a = ∫⁻ x, F (∫ y, f y ∂η x - ∫ y, g y ∂η x) ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [hf.ae_of_comp, hg.ae_of_comp] with _ h2f h2g
  simp [integral_sub h2f h2g]

name: integral_integral_add_comp
statement:
theorem integral_integral_add_comp ⦃f g : γ → E⦄ (hf : Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a))
    (hg : Integrable g ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    ∫ x, ∫ y, f y + g y ∂η x ∂κ a = ∫ x, ∫ y, f y ∂η x ∂κ a + ∫ x, ∫ y, g y ∂η x ∂κ a
proof:
:=
  (integral_fn_integral_add_comp id hf hg).trans <| integral_add hf.integral_comp hg.integral_comp

name: integral_integral_add'_comp
statement:
theorem integral_integral_add'_comp ⦃f g : γ → E⦄ (hf : Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a))
    (hg : Integrable g ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    ∫ x, ∫ y, (f + g) y ∂η x ∂κ a = ∫ x, ∫ y, f y ∂η x ∂κ a + ∫ x, ∫ y, g y ∂η x ∂κ a
proof:
:=
  integral_integral_add_comp hf hg

name: integral_integral_sub_comp
statement:
theorem integral_integral_sub_comp ⦃f g : γ → E⦄ (hf : Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a))
    (hg : Integrable g ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    ∫ x, ∫ y, f y - g y ∂η x ∂κ a = ∫ x, ∫ y, f y ∂η x ∂κ a - ∫ x, ∫ y, g y ∂η x ∂κ a
proof:
:=
  (integral_fn_integral_sub_comp id hf hg).trans <| integral_sub hf.integral_comp hg.integral_comp

name: integral_integral_sub'_comp
statement:
theorem integral_integral_sub'_comp ⦃f g : γ → E⦄ (hf : Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a))
    (hg : Integrable g ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    ∫ x, ∫ y, (f - g) y ∂η x ∂κ a = ∫ x, ∫ y, f y ∂η x ∂κ a - ∫ x, ∫ y, g y ∂η x ∂κ a
proof:
:=
  integral_integral_sub_comp hf hg

name: continuous_integral_integral_comp
statement:
theorem continuous_integral_integral_comp :
    Continuous fun f : γ →₁[(η ∘ₖ κ) a] E ↦ ∫ x, ∫ y, f y ∂η x ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun g ↦ ?_
  refine tendsto_integral_of_L1 _ (L1.integrable_coeFn g).integral_comp.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Eventually.of_forall fun h ↦ (L1.integrable_coeFn h).integral_comp) ?_
  simp_rw [← lintegral_fn_integral_sub_comp (‖·‖ₑ) (L1.integrable_coeFn _) (L1.integrable_coeFn g)]
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le
    (h := fun i ↦ ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, ‖i y - g y‖ₑ ∂η x ∂κ a)
    tendsto_const_nhds ?_ (fun _ ↦ zero_le) ?_
  swap; · exact fun _ ↦ lintegral_mono fun _ ↦ enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm _
  have (i : γ →₁[(η ∘ₖ κ) a] E) : Measurable fun z ↦ ‖i z - g z‖ₑ :=
    ((Lp.stronglyMeasurable i).sub (Lp.stronglyMeasurable g)).enorm
  simp_rw [← lintegral_comp _ _ _ (this _), ← L1.ofReal_norm_sub_eq_lintegral, ← ofReal_zero]
  exact (continuous_ofReal.tendsto 0).comp (tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.1 tendsto_id)

name: integral_comp
statement:
theorem integral_comp : ∀ {f : γ → E} (_ : Integrable f ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)),
    ∫ z, f z ∂(η ∘ₖ κ) a = ∫ x, ∫ y, f y ∂η x ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hE : CompleteSpace E; swap
  · simp [integral, hE]
  apply Integrable.induction
  · intro c s hs ms
    simp_rw [integral_indicator hs, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, integral_smul_const,
      measureReal_def]
    congr
    rw [integral_toReal, Kernel.comp_apply' _ _ _ hs]
    · exact (Kernel.measurable_coe _ hs).aemeasurable
    · exact ae_lt_top_of_comp_ne_top a ms.ne
  · rintro f g - i_f i_g hf hg
    simp_rw [integral_add' i_f i_g, integral_integral_add'_comp i_f i_g, hf, hg]
  · exact isClosed_eq continuous_integral Kernel.continuous_integral_integral_comp
  · rintro f g hfg - hf
    convert! hf using 1
    · exact integral_congr_ae hfg.symm
    · apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [ae_ae_of_ae_comp hfg] with x hfgx using integral_congr_ae (ae_eq_symm hfgx)

name: setIntegral_comp
statement:
theorem setIntegral_comp {f : γ → E} {s : Set γ} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    (hf : IntegrableOn f s ((η ∘ₖ κ) a)) :
    ∫ z in s, f z ∂(η ∘ₖ κ) a = ∫ x, ∫ y in s, f y ∂η x ∂κ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrict_apply (η ∘ₖ κ) hs, ← comp_restrict hs, integral_comp]
  · simp_rw [restrict_apply]
  · rwa [comp_restrict, restrict_apply]

name: _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.ae_of_compProd
statement:
lemma _root_.MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.ae_of_compProd [SFinite μ] [IsSFiniteKernel κ]
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] {f : α → β → E}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f.uncurry (μ ⊗ₘ κ)) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, AEStronglyMeasurable (f x) (κ x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hf.compProd_mk_left

name: integrable_compProd_iff
statement:
lemma integrable_compProd_iff [SFinite μ] [IsSFiniteKernel κ] {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    {f : α × β → E} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (μ ⊗ₘ κ)) :
    Integrable f (μ ⊗ₘ κ) ↔
      (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Integrable (fun y => f (x, y)) (κ x)) ∧
        Integrable (fun x => ∫ y, ‖f (x, y)‖ ∂(κ x)) μ
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Measure.compProd, ProbabilityTheory.integrable_compProd_iff hf, Kernel.prodMkLeft_apply,
    Kernel.const_apply]

name: integral_compProd
statement:
lemma integral_compProd [SFinite μ] [IsSFiniteKernel κ] {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {f : α × β → E} (hf : Integrable f (μ ⊗ₘ κ)) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂(μ ⊗ₘ κ) = ∫ a, ∫ b, f (a, b) ∂(κ a) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.compProd, ProbabilityTheory.integral_compProd hf]
  simp

name: setIntegral_compProd
statement:
lemma setIntegral_compProd [SFinite μ] [IsSFiniteKernel κ] {E : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {s : Set α} (hs : MeasurableSet s) {t : Set β} (ht : MeasurableSet t)
    {f : α × β → E} (hf : IntegrableOn f (s ×ˢ t) (μ ⊗ₘ κ)) :
    ∫ x in s ×ˢ t, f x ∂(μ ⊗ₘ κ) = ∫ a in s, ∫ b in t, f (a, b) ∂(κ a) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.compProd, ProbabilityTheory.setIntegral_compProd hs ht hf]
  simp

name: integrable_compProd_snd_iff
statement:
lemma integrable_compProd_snd_iff [SFinite μ] [IsSFiniteKernel κ]
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (κ ∘ₘ μ)) :
    Integrable (fun p ↦ f p.2) (μ ⊗ₘ κ) ↔ Integrable f (κ ∘ₘ μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Measure.snd_compProd, Measure.snd, integrable_map_measure _ measurable_snd.aemeasurable,
    Function.comp_def]
  rwa [← Measure.snd, Measure.snd_compProd]

name: ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp
statement:
lemma ae_integrable_of_integrable_comp (h_int : Integrable f (κ ∘ₘ μ)) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Integrable f (κ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.comp_eq_comp_const_apply, integrable_comp_iff h_int.1] at h_int
  exact h_int.1

name: integrable_integral_norm_of_integrable_comp
statement:
lemma integrable_integral_norm_of_integrable_comp (h_int : Integrable f (κ ∘ₘ μ)) :
    Integrable (fun x ↦ ∫ y, ‖f y‖ ∂κ x) μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.comp_eq_comp_const_apply, integrable_comp_iff h_int.1] at h_int
  exact h_int.2

name: MutuallySingular.compProd_of_right
statement:
lemma MutuallySingular.compProd_of_right (μ ν : Measure α) (hκη : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ a ⟂ₘ η a) :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ⟂ₘ ν ⊗ₘ η
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hμ : SFinite μ
  swap; · rw [compProd_of_not_sfinite _ _ hμ]; simp
  by_cases hν : SFinite ν
  swap; · rw [compProd_of_not_sfinite _ _ hν]; simp
  let s := κ.mutuallySingularSet η
  have hs : MeasurableSet s := Kernel.measurableSet_mutuallySingularSet κ η
  symm
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  rw [compProd_apply hs, compProd_apply hs.compl]
  have h_eq a : Prod.mk a ⁻¹' s = Kernel.mutuallySingularSetSlice κ η a := rfl
  have h1 a : η a (Prod.mk a ⁻¹' s) = 0 := by rw [h_eq, Kernel.measure_mutuallySingularSetSlice]
  have h2 : ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ a (Prod.mk a ⁻¹' s)ᶜ = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hκη] with a ha
    rwa [h_eq, ← Kernel.withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero_iff_measure_eq_zero κ η a,
      Kernel.withDensity_rnDeriv_eq_zero_iff_mutuallySingular]
  simp [h1, lintegral_congr_ae h2]

name: MutuallySingular.compProd_of_right'
statement:
lemma MutuallySingular.compProd_of_right' (μ ν : Measure α) (hκη : ∀ᵐ a ∂ν, κ a ⟂ₘ η a) :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ⟂ₘ ν ⊗ₘ η
proof:
:= by
  refine (MutuallySingular.compProd_of_right _ _ ?_).symm
  simp_rw [MutuallySingular.comm, hκη]

name: mutuallySingular_compProd_right_iff
statement:
lemma mutuallySingular_compProd_right_iff [SFinite μ] :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ⟂ₘ μ ⊗ₘ η ↔ ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ a ⟂ₘ η a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ mutuallySingular_of_mutuallySingular_compProd h AbsolutelyContinuous.rfl
    AbsolutelyContinuous.rfl, MutuallySingular.compProd_of_right _ _⟩

name: AbsolutelyContinuous.kernel_of_compProd
statement:
lemma AbsolutelyContinuous.kernel_of_compProd [SFinite μ] (h : μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ ν ⊗ₘ η) :
    ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ a ≪ η a
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ.singularPart η a = 0 by
    filter_upwards [this] with a ha
    rwa [Kernel.singularPart_eq_zero_iff_absolutelyContinuous] at ha
  rw [← κ.rnDeriv_add_singularPart η, compProd_add_right, AbsolutelyContinuous.add_left_iff] at h
  have : μ ⊗ₘ κ.singularPart η ⟂ₘ ν ⊗ₘ η :=
    MutuallySingular.compProd_of_right μ ν (.of_forall <| Kernel.mutuallySingular_singularPart _ _)
  refine compProd_eq_zero_iff.mp ?_
  exact eq_zero_of_absolutelyContinuous_of_mutuallySingular h.2 this

name: absolutelyContinuous_compProd_iff'
statement:
lemma absolutelyContinuous_compProd_iff' [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] [∀ a, NeZero (κ a)] :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ ν ⊗ₘ η ↔ μ ≪ ν ∧ ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ a ≪ η a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨absolutelyContinuous_of_compProd h, h.kernel_of_compProd⟩, fun h ↦ h.1.compProd h.2⟩

name: absolutelyContinuous_compProd_right_iff
statement:
lemma absolutelyContinuous_compProd_right_iff [SFinite μ] :
    μ ⊗ₘ κ ≪ μ ⊗ₘ η ↔ ∀ᵐ a ∂μ, κ a ≪ η a
proof:
:=
  ⟨AbsolutelyContinuous.kernel_of_compProd, AbsolutelyContinuous.compProd_right⟩

name: comp_eq_snd_compProd
statement:
theorem comp_eq_snd_compProd (η : Kernel Y Z) [IsSFiniteKernel η] (κ : Kernel X Y)
    [IsSFiniteKernel κ] : η ∘ₖ κ = snd (κ ⊗ₖ prodMkLeft X η)
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  rw [comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, snd_apply' _ _ hs, compProd_apply (measurable_snd hs)]
  simp [← Set.preimage_comp]

name: snd_compProd_prodMkLeft
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_compProd_prodMkLeft
    (κ : Kernel X Y) (η : Kernel Y Z) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] [IsSFiniteKernel η] :
    snd (κ ⊗ₖ prodMkLeft X η) = η ∘ₖ κ
proof: := (comp_eq_snd_compProd η κ).symm

name: compProd_prodMkLeft_eq_comp
statement:
lemma compProd_prodMkLeft_eq_comp
    (κ : Kernel X Y) [IsSFiniteKernel κ] (η : Kernel Y Z) [IsSFiniteKernel η] :
    κ ⊗ₖ (prodMkLeft X η) = (Kernel.id ×ₖ η) ∘ₖ κ
proof:
:= by
  ext a s hs
  rw [comp_eq_snd_compProd, compProd_apply hs, snd_apply' _ _ hs, compProd_apply]
  swap; · exact measurable_snd hs
  simp only [prodMkLeft_apply, ← Set.preimage_comp, Prod.snd_comp_mk, Set.preimage_id_eq, id_eq,
    prod_apply' _ _ _ hs, id_apply]
  congr with b
  rw [lintegral_dirac']
  exact measurable_measure_prodMk_left hs

name: swap_parallelComp
statement: lemma swap_parallelComp : swap Y T ∘ₖ (κ ∥ₖ η) = η ∥ₖ κ ∘ₖ swap X Z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hκ : IsSFiniteKernel κ
  swap; · simp [hκ]
  by_cases hη : IsSFiniteKernel η
  swap; · simp [hη]
  ext ac s hs
  simp_rw [comp_apply, parallelComp_apply, Measure.bind_apply hs (Kernel.aemeasurable _),
    swap_apply, lintegral_dirac' _ (Kernel.measurable_coe _ hs), parallelComp_apply' hs,
    Prod.fst_swap, Prod.snd_swap]
  rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_prod_symm]
  swap; · exact ((Kernel.id.measurable_coe hs).comp measurable_swap).aemeasurable
  congr with d
  simp_rw [Prod.swap_prod_mk, Measure.dirac_apply' _ hs, ← Set.indicator_comp_right,
    lintegral_indicator (measurable_prodMk_left hs)]
  simp

name: parallelComp_id_left_comp_parallelComp
statement:
lemma parallelComp_id_left_comp_parallelComp
    {η : Kernel X' Z} [IsSFiniteKernel η] {ξ : Kernel Z T} [IsSFiniteKernel ξ] :
    (Kernel.id ∥ₖ ξ) ∘ₖ (κ ∥ₖ η) = κ ∥ₖ (ξ ∘ₖ η)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hκ : IsSFiniteKernel κ
  swap; · simp [hκ]
  ext a s hs
  rw [comp_apply' _ _ _ hs, parallelComp_apply,
    MeasureTheory.lintegral_prod _ (Kernel.measurable_coe _ hs).aemeasurable]
  rw [parallelComp_apply, Measure.prod_apply hs]
  congr with x
  rw [comp_apply' _ _ _ (measurable_prodMk_left hs)]
  congr with y
  rw [parallelComp_apply' hs, Kernel.id_apply,
    lintegral_dirac' _ (measurable_measure_prodMk_left hs)]

name: parallelComp_id_right_comp_parallelComp
statement:
lemma parallelComp_id_right_comp_parallelComp {η : Kernel X' Z} [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    {ξ : Kernel Z T} [IsSFiniteKernel ξ] :
    (ξ ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₖ (η ∥ₖ κ) = (ξ ∘ₖ η) ∥ₖ κ
proof:
:= by
  suffices swap T Y ∘ₖ (ξ ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₖ (η ∥ₖ κ) = swap T Y ∘ₖ ((ξ ∘ₖ η) ∥ₖ κ) by
    calc ξ ∥ₖ Kernel.id ∘ₖ (η ∥ₖ κ)
    _ = swap Y T ∘ₖ (swap T Y ∘ₖ (ξ ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₖ (η ∥ₖ κ)) := by
      simp_rw [← comp_assoc, swap_swap, id_comp]
    _ = swap Y T ∘ₖ (swap T Y ∘ₖ ((ξ ∘ₖ η) ∥ₖ κ)) := by rw [this]
    _ = ξ ∘ₖ η ∥ₖ κ := by simp_rw [← comp_assoc, swap_swap, id_comp]
  simp_rw [swap_parallelComp, comp_assoc, swap_parallelComp, ← comp_assoc,
    parallelComp_id_left_comp_parallelComp]

name: parallelComp_comp_parallelComp
statement:
lemma parallelComp_comp_parallelComp [IsSFiniteKernel κ] {η : Kernel Y Z} [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    {κ' : Kernel X' Y'} [IsSFiniteKernel κ'] {η' : Kernel Y' Z'} [IsSFiniteKernel η'] :
    (η ∥ₖ η') ∘ₖ (κ ∥ₖ κ') = (η ∘ₖ κ) ∥ₖ (η' ∘ₖ κ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← parallelComp_id_left_comp_parallelComp, ← parallelComp_id_right_comp_parallelComp,
    ← comp_assoc, parallelComp_id_left_comp_parallelComp, comp_id]

name: parallelComp_comp_prod
statement:
lemma parallelComp_comp_prod [IsSFiniteKernel κ] {η : Kernel Y Z} [IsSFiniteKernel η]
    {κ' : Kernel X Y'} [IsSFiniteKernel κ'] {η' : Kernel Y' Z'} [IsSFiniteKernel η'] :
    (η ∥ₖ η') ∘ₖ (κ ×ₖ κ') = (η ∘ₖ κ) ×ₖ (η' ∘ₖ κ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← parallelComp_comp_copy, ← comp_assoc, parallelComp_comp_parallelComp,
    ← parallelComp_comp_copy]

name: parallelComp_comm
statement:
lemma parallelComp_comm :
    (Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ) ∘ₖ (η ∥ₖ Kernel.id) = (η ∥ₖ Kernel.id) ∘ₖ (Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hκ : IsSFiniteKernel κ
  swap; · simp [hκ]
  by_cases hη : IsSFiniteKernel η
  swap; · simp [hη]
  rw [parallelComp_id_left_comp_parallelComp, parallelComp_id_right_comp_parallelComp,
    comp_id, comp_id]

name: id_parallelComp_comp_parallelComp_id
statement:
lemma id_parallelComp_comp_parallelComp_id [IsSFiniteKernel κ] :
    Kernel.id ∥ₖ κ ∘ₖ (η ∥ₖ Kernel.id) = η ∥ₖ κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [parallelComp_id_left_comp_parallelComp]
  congr
  exact comp_id κ

name: parallelComp_of_not_isSFiniteKernel_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma parallelComp_of_not_isSFiniteKernel_left (η : Kernel γ δ) (h : ¬ IsSFiniteKernel κ) :
    κ ∥ₖ η = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [parallelComp, dite_eq_right (not_and_of_not_left _ h)]

name: parallelComp_of_not_isSFiniteKernel_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma parallelComp_of_not_isSFiniteKernel_right (κ : Kernel α β) (h : ¬ IsSFiniteKernel η) :
